local repo = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/white558/Obsidian/main/"
local librarySource = game:HttpGet(repo .. "Library.lua")

-- Minimal switch patch: OFF = dark graphite, ON = white, with a contrasting knob.
-- These patches are deliberately tolerant of upstream source changes so a library update
-- does not prevent the entire hub from loading.
local function patchLibrarySource(pattern, replacement)
    local updated, count = string.gsub(librarySource, pattern, replacement)
    if count > 0 then librarySource = updated end
    return count
end

patchLibrarySource(
    'local Switch = New%("Frame", {%s*',
    'local Switch = New("Frame", { Name = "OwnerSigmaToggleTrack", '
)
patchLibrarySource(
    'local Ball = New%("Frame", {%s*',
    'local Ball = New("Frame", { Name = "OwnerSigmaToggleKnob", '
)
patchLibrarySource(
    'Switch%.BackgroundColor3 = Toggle%.Value and Library%.Scheme%.AccentColor or Library%.Scheme%.FontColor',
    'Switch.BackgroundColor3 = Toggle.Value and Color3.fromRGB(230, 180, 65) or Color3.fromRGB(31, 27, 19)'
)
patchLibrarySource(
    'Library%.Registry%[Switch%]%.BackgroundColor3 = Toggle%.Value and "AccentColor" or "FontColor"',
    'Library.Registry[Switch].BackgroundColor3 = "AccentColor"'
)
patchLibrarySource(
    'SwitchGradient%.Color = Toggle%.Value%s+and ColorSequence%.new%(SWITCH_ON_GRADIENT_FROM, SWITCH_ON_GRADIENT_TO%)%s+or ColorSequence%.new%(SWITCH_OFF_GRADIENT_FROM, SWITCH_OFF_GRADIENT_TO%)',
    'SwitchGradient.Color = Toggle.Value and ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(245, 205, 95), Color3.fromRGB(230, 180, 65)) or ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(12, 11, 9), Color3.fromRGB(31, 27, 19)); Ball.BackgroundColor3 = Toggle.Value and Color3.fromRGB(25, 22, 16) or Color3.fromRGB(184, 169, 137)'
)
patchLibrarySource(
    'Ball%.BackgroundColor3 = Library%.Scheme%.FontColor%s+Library%.Registry%[Ball%]%.BackgroundColor3 = "FontColor"',
    'Ball.BackgroundColor3 = Toggle.Value and Color3.fromRGB(25, 22, 16) or Color3.fromRGB(184, 169, 137)\n            Library.Registry[Ball].BackgroundColor3 = "FontColor"'
)
-- Native Lucide.dev icons for dropdown values. Player selectors keep their existing avatar portraits.

local iconsLucide = {}

local iconsISGETCUSTOMASSETBROKEN = false

if writefile and isfolder and makefolder and getcustomasset then
	if not isfolder("lucide-icons") then
		makefolder("lucide-icons")
	end

	if not isfile("lucide-icons/version.txt") then
		writefile("lucide-icons/version.txt", "2026-09-01T03:49:17.713242330+00:00")
	end

	local iconsShouldUpdate = readfile("lucide-icons/version.txt") ~= "2026-09-01T03:49:17.713242330+00:00"

	if iconsShouldUpdate then
		writefile("lucide-icons/version.txt", "2026-09-01T03:49:17.713242330+00:00")
	end

	for iconsSpritesheet = 1, 2 do
		if isfile(`lucide-icons/{iconsSpritesheet}.png`) and not iconsShouldUpdate then
			continue
		end

		writefile(
			`lucide-icons/{iconsSpritesheet}.png`,
			game:HttpGet(
				`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mstudio45/lucide-roblox-direct/1c37dd176d79ab42388597aa9dc9e3a1b0dd7416/spritesheets/{iconsSpritesheet}.png`
			)
		)
	end

	local iconsSuccess, _iconsError = pcall(function()
		return getcustomasset("lucide-icons/1.png")
	end)

	iconsISGETCUSTOMASSETBROKEN = not iconsSuccess
end

local iconsIconIndices: { string } = icons[1]
local iconsIdIndices: { string } = icons[2]
local iconsIconRegistry: { [number]: { number | { number } } } = icons[3]

iconsLucide.Icons = iconsIconIndices
function iconsLucide.GetAsset(getAssetName: string)
	local getAssetSize = 48

	local getAssetIconIndex = table.find(iconsIconIndices, getAssetName)

	if not getAssetIconIndex then
		return nil
	end

	local getAssetCurrentDifference = math.huge
	local getAssetCurrentSize = getAssetSize

	for getAssetRegistrySize, _getAssetUnused1 in iconsIconRegistry do
		local getAssetDiff = math.abs(getAssetSize - getAssetRegistrySize)

		if getAssetDiff < getAssetCurrentDifference then
			getAssetCurrentDifference = getAssetDiff
			getAssetCurrentSize = getAssetRegistrySize
		end
	end

	local getAssetIcon = iconsIconRegistry[getAssetCurrentSize][getAssetIconIndex]
	if getAssetIcon then
		return {
			IconName = getAssetName,
			Url = iconsIdIndices[getAssetIcon[1]],
			ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(getAssetIcon[2][1], getAssetIcon[2][2]),
			ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(getAssetIcon[3][1], getAssetIcon[3][2]),
		}
	end

	return nil
end

return iconsLucide

    local function mainGetCharacter(mainPlayer)
        local mainCharacter = mainPlayer and mainPlayer.Character
        local mainRoot = mainCharacter and (mainCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or mainCharacter:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
        local mainHumanoid = mainCharacter and mainCharacter:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
        return mainCharacter, mainRoot, mainHumanoid
    end

    local function mainIsAlive(mainPlayer)
        local _, mainRoot, mainHumanoid = mainGetCharacter(mainPlayer)
        return mainRoot ~= nil and mainHumanoid ~= nil and mainHumanoid.Health > 0
    end

    local function mainFindTool(mainPlayer, mainWord)
        if not mainPlayer then return nil end
        local mainNeedle = string.lower(mainWord)
        for _, mainContainer in ipairs({ mainPlayer.Character, mainPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") }) do
            if mainContainer then
                for _, mainChild in ipairs(mainContainer:GetChildren()) do
                    if mainChild:IsA("Tool") and string.find(string.lower(mainChild.Name), mainNeedle, 1, true) then return mainChild end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function mainGetRole(mainPlayer)
        if mainFindTool(mainPlayer, "knife") then return "Murderer" end
        if mainFindTool(mainPlayer, "gun") or mainFindTool(mainPlayer, "revolver") then return "Sheriff" end
        return "Innocent"
    end

    local function mainGetMurderer()
        for _, mainPlayer in ipairs(mainPlayers:GetPlayers()) do
            if mainPlayer ~= mainLocalPlayer and mainIsAlive(mainPlayer) and mainGetRole(mainPlayer) == "Murderer" then return mainPlayer end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function mainClosestPlayer(mainRoleFilter)
        local _, mainRoot = mainGetCharacter(mainLocalPlayer)
        if not mainRoot then return nil end
        local mainClosest, mainDistance = nil, math.huge
        for _, mainPlayer in ipairs(mainPlayers:GetPlayers()) do
            if mainPlayer ~= mainLocalPlayer and mainIsAlive(mainPlayer) and (not mainRoleFilter or mainGetRole(mainPlayer) == mainRoleFilter) then
                local _, mainTargetRoot = mainGetCharacter(mainPlayer)
                local mainMagnitude = mainTargetRoot and (mainRoot.Position - mainTargetRoot.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
                if mainMagnitude < mainDistance then mainClosest, mainDistance = mainPlayer, mainMagnitude end
            end
        end
        return mainClosest, mainDistance
    end

    local mainVisualObjects = { Marks = {}, Labels = {}, StaticMarks = {}, Headwear = nil, Aura = nil, Weapon = nil, Beam = nil, World = {}, TargetHud = nil }

    local function mainClearObject(mainObject)
        if mainObject then pcall(function() mainObject:Destroy() end) end
    end

    local function mainCharacterPart(mainPlayer, mainName)
        local mainCharacter = mainPlayer and mainPlayer.Character
        return mainCharacter and mainCharacter:FindFirstChild(mainName)
    end

    local function mainClearPlayerMark(mainPlayer)
        mainClearObject(mainVisualObjects.Marks[mainPlayer])
        mainClearObject(mainVisualObjects.Labels[mainPlayer])
        mainVisualObjects.Marks[mainPlayer], mainVisualObjects.Labels[mainPlayer] = nil, nil
    end

    local function mainApplyPlayerMark(mainPlayer, mainColor, mainCaption)
        local mainCharacter, mainRoot = mainGetCharacter(mainPlayer)
        if not mainCharacter or not mainRoot then return end
        local mainMark = mainVisualObjects.Marks[mainPlayer]
        if not mainMark or not mainMark.Parent then
            mainMark = Instance.new("Highlight")
            mainMark.Name = "OwnerSigmaHubSceneMarker"
            mainMark.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            mainMark.FillTransparency, mainMark.OutlineTransparency = 0.73, 0.1
            mainMark.Parent = mainCharacter
            mainVisualObjects.Marks[mainPlayer] = mainMark
        end
        mainMark.Adornee, mainMark.FillColor, mainMark.OutlineColor = mainCharacter, mainColor, mainColor
        local mainLabel = mainVisualObjects.Labels[mainPlayer]
        if not mainLabel or not mainLabel.Parent then
            mainLabel = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            mainLabel.Name, mainLabel.AlwaysOnTop, mainLabel.Size, mainLabel.StudsOffset = "OwnerSigmaHubSceneCaption", true, UDim2.fromOffset(190, 24), Vector3.new(0, 3.35, 0)
            local mainText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            mainText.Name, mainText.BackgroundTransparency, mainText.Size = "Text", 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            mainText.Font, mainText.TextSize, mainText.TextStrokeTransparency = Enum.Font.GothamBold, 13, 0.35
            mainText.Parent = mainLabel
            mainLabel.Parent = mainCharacter
            mainVisualObjects.Labels[mainPlayer] = mainLabel
        end
        mainLabel.Adornee = mainCharacter:FindFirstChild("Head") or mainRoot
        local mainText = mainLabel:FindFirstChild("Text")
        if mainText then mainText.Text, mainText.TextColor3 = mainCaption, mainColor end
    end

    local function mainSetStaticMark(mainKey, mainAdornee, mainColor)
        mainClearObject(mainVisualObjects.StaticMarks[mainKey])
        if not mainAdornee then mainVisualObjects.StaticMarks[mainKey] = nil; return end
        local mainMark = Instance.new("Highlight")
        mainMark.Name, mainMark.Adornee, mainMark.DepthMode = "OwnerSigmaHubWorldMarker", mainAdornee, Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        mainMark.FillColor, mainMark.OutlineColor, mainMark.FillTransparency, mainMark.OutlineTransparency = mainColor, mainColor, 0.58, 0
        mainMark.Parent = mainAdornee
        mainVisualObjects.StaticMarks[mainKey] = mainMark
    end

    local function mainFindDroppedGun()
        for _, mainObject in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if mainObject:IsA("Tool") then
                local mainName = string.lower(mainObject.Name)
                if string.find(mainName, "gun", 1, true) or string.find(mainName, "revolver", 1, true) then return mainObject end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function mainRefreshSceneMarks()
        for _, mainPlayer in ipairs(mainPlayers:GetPlayers()) do
            if mainPlayer ~= mainLocalPlayer and mainIsAlive(mainPlayer) and mainVisualFlags.PlayerSilhouettes then
                local mainRole = mainGetRole(mainPlayer)
                mainApplyPlayerMark(mainPlayer, mainRoleColors[mainRole] or Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235), mainPlayer.DisplayName .. " • " .. mainRole)
            else
                mainClearPlayerMark(mainPlayer)
            end
        end
        if mainVisualFlags.DroppedWeapon then mainSetStaticMark("DroppedWeapon", mainFindDroppedGun(), Color3.fromRGB(78, 170, 255)) else mainSetStaticMark("DroppedWeapon", nil) end
        if mainVisualFlags.TrapSignals then
            local mainIndex = 0
            for _, mainObject in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                local mainName = string.lower(mainObject.Name)
                if (mainObject:IsA("Model") or mainObject:IsA("BasePart")) and string.find(mainName, "trap", 1, true) then
                    mainIndex += 1
                    mainSetStaticMark("Trap" .. mainIndex, mainObject, Color3.fromRGB(255, 167, 69))
                end
            end
        else
            for mainKey in pairs(mainVisualObjects.StaticMarks) do if string.sub(mainKey, 1, 4) == "Trap" then mainSetStaticMark(mainKey, nil) end end
        end
        local mainFocus = mainSettings.FlingTarget
        if mainVisualFlags.FocusBeacon and mainFocus and mainIsAlive(mainFocus) then
            mainApplyPlayerMark(mainFocus, Color3.fromRGB(255, 231, 93), mainFocus.DisplayName .. " • Focus")
        end
    end

    local function mainBuildHeadwear(mainStyle)
        mainVisualSettings.Headwear = mainStyle or "None"
        mainClearHeadwear()
        if mainVisualSettings.Headwear == "None" then return end
        local mainCharacter = mainLocalPlayer.Character
        local mainHead = mainCharacter and mainCharacter:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not mainHead then return end
        local mainModel = Instance.new("Model")
        mainModel.Name, mainModel.Parent = "OwnerSigmaHubHeadwear", mainCharacter
        mainVisualObjects.Headwear = mainModel
        local function mainPart(mainName, mainSize, mainColor, mainOffset, mainShape, mainMaterial)
            local mainNewPart = Instance.new("Part")
            mainNewPart.Name, mainNewPart.Size, mainNewPart.Color = mainName, mainSize, mainColor
            mainNewPart.Shape, mainNewPart.Material = mainShape or Enum.PartType.Block, mainMaterial or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            mainNewPart.CanCollide, mainNewPart.CanQuery, mainNewPart.Massless, mainNewPart.CastShadow = false, false, true, false
            mainNewPart.CFrame, mainNewPart.Parent = mainHead.CFrame * mainOffset, mainModel
            local mainWeld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
            mainWeld.Part0, mainWeld.Part1, mainWeld.Parent = mainHead, mainNewPart, mainNewPart
            return mainNewPart
        end
        if mainStyle == "Bamboo Hat" then
            mainPart("Brim", Vector3.new(0.16, 3.3, 3.3), Color3.fromRGB(168, 45, 38), CFrame.new(0, 0.72, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
            mainPart("Top", Vector3.new(0.35, 1.35, 1.35), Color3.fromRGB(231, 181, 55), CFrame.new(0, 0.89, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
        elseif mainStyle == "Royal Crest" then
            mainPart("Band", Vector3.new(0.22, 2.2, 2.2), Color3.fromRGB(243, 194, 49), CFrame.new(0, 0.7, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
            for mainIndex = 1, 5 do
                local mainAngle = (mainIndex - 1) * math.pi * 2 / 5
                mainPart("Gem" .. mainIndex, Vector3.new(0.33, 0.33, 0.33), Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 99), CFrame.new(math.cos(mainAngle) * 0.82, 1.05, math.sin(mainAngle) * 0.82), Enum.PartType.Ball, Enum.Material.Neon)
            end
        elseif mainStyle == "Solar Ring" then
            mainPart("Ring", Vector3.new(0.14, 2.5, 2.5), Color3.fromRGB(255, 227, 77), CFrame.new(0, 1.2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Enum.Material.Neon)
        elseif mainStyle == "Night Cap" then
            mainPart("Brim", Vector3.new(0.14, 2.65, 2.65), Color3.fromRGB(23, 24, 31), CFrame.new(0, 0.58, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
            mainPart("Top", Vector3.new(1.1, 1.45, 1.45), Color3.fromRGB(17, 18, 24), CFrame.new(0, 1.15, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
        elseif mainStyle == "Petal Ears" then
            mainPart("Left", Vector3.new(0.48, 0.7, 0.45), Color3.fromRGB(247, 138, 190), CFrame.new(-0.52, 0.88, 0), Enum.PartType.Ball)
            mainPart("Right", Vector3.new(0.48, 0.7, 0.45), Color3.fromRGB(247, 138, 190), CFrame.new(0.52, 0.88, 0), Enum.PartType.Ball)
        end
    end

    local function mainApplyWeaponFrame(mainStyle)
        mainVisualSettings.WeaponFrame = mainStyle or "Standard"
        mainClearWeaponFrame()
        if mainVisualSettings.WeaponFrame == "Standard" then return end
        local mainCharacter = mainLocalPlayer.Character
        local mainHand = mainCharacter and (mainCharacter:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or mainCharacter:FindFirstChild("Right Arm"))
        if not mainHand then return end
        local mainModel = Instance.new("Model")
        mainModel.Name, mainModel.Parent = "OwnerSigmaHubWeaponFrame", mainCharacter
        mainVisualObjects.Weapon = mainModel
        local mainColor = mainStyle == "Gold Scope" and Color3.fromRGB(244, 191, 48) or (mainStyle == "Neon Scope" and Color3.fromRGB(59, 232, 255) or (mainStyle == "Ghost Scope" and Color3.fromRGB(190, 130, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(47, 48, 57)))

            local mainPart = Instance.new("Part")
            mainPart.Name, mainPart.Size, mainPart.Color, mainPart.Material = mainName, mainSize, mainColor, mainMaterial or Enum.Material.Metal
            mainPart.CanCollide, mainPart.CanQuery, mainPart.Massless, mainPart.CastShadow = false, false, true, false
            mainPart.CFrame, mainPart.Parent = mainHand.CFrame * mainOffset, mainModel
            local mainWeld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
            mainWeld.Part0, mainWeld.Part1, mainWeld.Parent = mainHand, mainPart, mainPart
        end
        mainWeaponPart("Body", Vector3.new(0.38, 0.42, 2.7), CFrame.new(0, -0.12, -1.12))
        mainWeaponPart("Barrel", Vector3.new(0.18, 0.18, 1.55), CFrame.new(0, 0.02, -3.06), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
        mainWeaponPart("Scope", Vector3.new(0.23, 0.25, 0.95), CFrame.new(0, 0.34, -1.25), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)

            mainAttachmentA.Position, mainAttachmentB.Position, mainAttachmentA.Parent, mainAttachmentB.Parent = Vector3.new(0, 0, -3.8), Vector3.new(0, 0, -85), mainHand, mainHand

    local function mainApplyWorldTone(mainTone)
        mainVisualSettings.WorldTone = mainTone or "Clear"
        mainClearWorld()
        if mainVisualSettings.WorldTone == "Clear" then return end
        local mainLighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
        local mainCorrection = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
        mainCorrection.Name, mainCorrection.Parent = "OwnerSigmaHubSceneTone", mainLighting
        local mainBloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
        mainBloom.Name, mainBloom.Parent, mainBloom.Intensity, mainBloom.Size, mainBloom.Threshold = "OwnerSigmaHubSceneBloom", mainLighting, 0.24, 28, 1.2
        table.insert(mainVisualObjects.World, mainCorrection); table.insert(mainVisualObjects.World, mainBloom)
        if mainTone == "Neon Dusk" then mainCorrection.TintColor, mainCorrection.Contrast, mainCorrection.Saturation = Color3.fromRGB(101, 137, 255), 0.22, 0.18
        elseif mainTone == "Gold Hour" then mainCorrection.TintColor, mainCorrection.Brightness, mainCorrection.Contrast = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 110), 0.04, 0.15
        elseif mainTone == "Mono Film" then mainCorrection.Saturation, mainCorrection.Contrast = -1, 0.24
        elseif mainTone == "Candy Glow" then mainCorrection.TintColor, mainCorrection.Saturation, mainBloom.Intensity = Color3.fromRGB(255, 159, 222), 0.42, 0.48
        elseif mainTone == "Cinema Cool" then mainCorrection.TintColor, mainCorrection.Contrast, mainCorrection.Saturation, mainBloom.Intensity = Color3.fromRGB(152, 187, 201), 0.35, -0.18, 0.1 end
    end

    local function mainCreateLandingRing()
        if not mainVisualFlags.LandingRing then return end
        local _, mainRoot = mainGetCharacter(mainLocalPlayer)
        if not mainRoot then return end
        local mainRing = Instance.new("Part")
        mainRing.Name, mainRing.Shape, mainRing.Size = "OwnerSigmaHubLandingRing", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(0.13, 1.4, 1.4)
        mainRing.Material, mainRing.Color, mainRing.Anchored, mainRing.CanCollide = Enum.Material.Neon, Color3.fromRGB(138, 183, 255), true, false
        mainRing.CFrame, mainRing.Parent = CFrame.new(mainRoot.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), workspace
        task.spawn(function()
            for mainStep = 1, 18 do
                if not mainRing.Parent then break end
                mainRing.Size = mainRing.Size + Vector3.new(0, 0.45, 0.45)
                mainRing.Transparency = mainStep / 18
                task.wait(0.03)
            end
            mainClearObject(mainRing)
        end)
    end

    local function mainClearSceneVisuals()
        for _, mainPlayer in ipairs(mainPlayers:GetPlayers()) do mainClearPlayerMark(mainPlayer) end
        for _, mainObject in pairs(mainVisualObjects.StaticMarks) do mainClearObject(mainObject) end
        mainVisualObjects.StaticMarks = {}
        mainClearHeadwear(); mainClearAura(); mainClearWeaponFrame(); mainClearWorld()
        mainClearObject(mainVisualObjects.TargetHud)
        mainVisualObjects.TargetHud = nil
        for _, mainSky in ipairs(game:GetService("Lighting"):GetChildren()) do if mainSky.Name == "OwnerSigmaHubSceneSky" then mainSky:Destroy() end end
    end

    local function mainClearFlight()
        for _, mainObject in pairs(mainFlight) do if mainObject then pcall(function() mainObject:Destroy() end) end end
        mainFlight = { Velocity = nil, Gyro = nil }
    end

    local function mainSetFly(mainEnabled)
        mainFlags.Fly = mainEnabled and true or false
        if not mainFlags.Fly then mainClearFlight(); return end
        local _, mainRoot = mainGetCharacter(mainLocalPlayer)
        if not mainRoot then return end
        mainClearFlight()
        local mainVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        mainVelocity.Name, mainVelocity.MaxForce, mainVelocity.P = "OwnerSigmaHubMM2FlyVelocity", Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6), 15000
        mainVelocity.Parent = mainRoot
        local mainGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        mainGyro.Name, mainGyro.MaxTorque, mainGyro.P = "OwnerSigmaHubMM2FlyGyro", Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6), 15000
        mainGyro.Parent = mainRoot
        mainFlight = { Velocity = mainVelocity, Gyro = mainGyro }
    end

    local function mainUpdateFly()
        if not mainFlags.Fly then return end
        local _, mainRoot, mainHumanoid = mainGetCharacter(mainLocalPlayer)
        if not mainRoot or not mainHumanoid or not mainFlight.Velocity or not mainFlight.Velocity.Parent then mainSetFly(true); return end
        local mainMove = mainHumanoid.MoveDirection
        local mainVertical = (mainFlags.FlyUp and 1 or 0) - (mainFlags.FlyDown and 1 or 0)
        mainFlight.Velocity.Velocity = mainMove * mainSettings.FlySpeed + Vector3.new(0, mainVertical * mainSettings.FlySpeed, 0)
        if mainCamera then mainFlight.Gyro.CFrame = mainCamera.CFrame end
    end

    local function mainTryKnifeRemote(mainTarget)
        local mainTargetCharacter, mainTargetRoot = mainGetCharacter(mainTarget)
        if not mainTargetCharacter or not mainTargetRoot then return end
        local mainKnife = mainFindTool(mainLocalPlayer, "knife")
        if not mainKnife then return end
        pcall(function()
            if mainKnife.Parent ~= mainLocalPlayer.Character then mainKnife.Parent = mainLocalPlayer.Character end
            mainKnife:Activate()
            if mainVirtualInputManager and mainCamera then
                local mainPoint, mainVisible = mainCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(mainTargetRoot.Position)
                if mainVisible then
                    mainVirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(mainPoint.X, mainPoint.Y, 0, true, game, 0)
                    mainVirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(mainPoint.X, mainPoint.Y, 0, false, game, 0)
                end
            end
        end)
        for _, mainRemote in ipairs(mainKnife:GetDescendants()) do
            if mainRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then pcall(function() mainRemote:FireServer(mainTargetCharacter, mainTargetRoot.Position) end)
            elseif mainRemote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then pcall(function() mainRemote:InvokeServer(mainTargetCharacter, mainTargetRoot.Position) end) end
        end
        for _, mainRemote in ipairs(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):GetDescendants()) do
            local mainName = string.lower(mainRemote.Name)
            if (mainRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") or mainRemote:IsA("RemoteFunction")) and (string.find(mainName, "knife", 1, true) or string.find(mainName, "stab", 1, true) or string.find(mainName, "melee", 1, true) or string.find(mainName, "kill", 1, true)) then
                pcall(function()
                    if mainRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then mainRemote:FireServer(mainTargetCharacter, mainTargetRoot.Position) else mainRemote:InvokeServer(mainTargetCharacter, mainTargetRoot.Position) end
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    local function mainKillAllNoTeleport()
        if not mainFindTool(mainLocalPlayer, "knife") then return mainNotify("Equip the knife first.") end
        task.spawn(function()
            for _, mainPlayer in ipairs(mainPlayers:GetPlayers()) do
                if mainPlayer ~= mainLocalPlayer and mainIsAlive(mainPlayer) then mainTryKnifeRemote(mainPlayer); task.wait(0.08) end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function mainDefend()
        local _, mainRoot = mainGetCharacter(mainLocalPlayer)
        if not mainRoot then return end
        if mainFlags.AntiFling and mainRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 85 then
            mainRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            mainRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
        if mainFlags.AntiKill then
            local mainMurderer = mainGetMurderer()
            local _, mainMurdererRoot = mainGetCharacter(mainMurderer)
            if mainMurdererRoot and (mainRoot.Position - mainMurdererRoot.Position).Magnitude < 18 then
                local mainDirection = mainRoot.Position - mainMurdererRoot.Position
                if mainDirection.Magnitude < 0.1 then mainDirection = mainCamera and mainCamera.CFrame.LookVector or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
                mainRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = mainDirection.Unit * 120 + Vector3.new(0, 45, 0)
            end
        end
    end

    local function mainAttack(mainTarget)
        local mainKnife = mainFindTool(mainLocalPlayer, "knife")
        local _, mainRoot = mainGetCharacter(mainLocalPlayer)
        local _, mainTargetRoot = mainGetCharacter(mainTarget)
        if not mainKnife or not mainRoot or not mainTargetRoot then return end
        local mainNow = os.clock()
        if mainNow - mainLastAttack < mainSettings.KillDelay then return end
        mainLastAttack = mainNow
        pcall(function()
            if mainKnife.Parent ~= mainLocalPlayer.Character then mainKnife.Parent = mainLocalPlayer.Character end
            mainRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(mainTargetRoot.Position - mainTargetRoot.CFrame.LookVector * 2, mainTargetRoot.Position)
            mainKnife:Activate()
        end)
    end

    local function mainShootMurderer()
        local mainGun = mainFindTool(mainLocalPlayer, "gun") or mainFindTool(mainLocalPlayer, "revolver")
        local mainTarget = mainGetMurderer()
        local _, mainTargetRoot = mainGetCharacter(mainTarget)
        if not mainGun or not mainTargetRoot or not mainCamera then return end
        local mainNow = os.clock()
        if mainNow - mainLastShot < mainSettings.ShootDelay then return end
        mainLastShot = mainNow
        pcall(function()
            if mainGun.Parent ~= mainLocalPlayer.Character then mainGun.Parent = mainLocalPlayer.Character end
            mainCamera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(mainCamera.CFrame.Position, mainTargetRoot.Position)
            local mainViewportPoint, mainVisible = mainCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(mainTargetRoot.Position)
            if mainVisible and mainVirtualInputManager then
                mainVirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(mainViewportPoint.X, mainViewportPoint.Y, 0, true, game, 0)
                mainVirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(mainViewportPoint.X, mainViewportPoint.Y, 0, false, game, 0)
            else
                mainGun:Activate()
            end
        end)
    end

    local function mainFling(mainTarget)
        local _, mainRoot = mainGetCharacter(mainLocalPlayer)
        local _, mainTargetRoot = mainGetCharacter(mainTarget)
        if not mainRoot or not mainTargetRoot then return end
        local mainNow = os.clock()
        if mainNow - mainLastFling < 0.6 then return end
        mainLastFling = mainNow
        task.spawn(function()
            local mainVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            mainVelocity.Name = "OwnerSigmaHubMM2FlingVelocity"
            mainVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
            mainVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            mainVelocity.Parent = mainRoot
            for mainStep = 1, 14 do
                if mainUnloaded or not mainTargetRoot.Parent or not mainRoot.Parent then break end
                local mainAngle = mainStep * math.pi * 1.65
                mainRoot.CFrame = mainTargetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(math.cos(mainAngle) * 1.5, 0.2, math.sin(mainAngle) * 1.5)
                mainVelocity.Velocity = (mainTargetRoot.Position - mainRoot.Position).Unit * 8500
                task.wait()
            end
            pcall(function() mainVelocity:Destroy() end)
        end)
    end

    local function mainSetNoclip(mainEnabled)
        local mainCharacter = mainLocalPlayer.Character
        if mainCharacter and mainEnabled then
            for _, mainPart in ipairs(mainCharacter:GetDescendants()) do if mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then mainPart.CanCollide = false end end
        end
    end

    local function mainNotify(mainText)
        pcall(function() mainUiLibrary:Notify(mainText, 4) end)
    end

    local mainTargetInfoLabel, mainMapInfoLabel, mainVoteInfoLabel, mainRoleInfoLabel
    local mainAimLock = false
    local mainAutoCollect = false
    local mainAutoCollectRadius = 35
    local mainLastRouteUpdate = 0

    local function mainMoveLocal(mainCFrame)
        local _, mainRoot = mainGetCharacter(mainLocalPlayer)
        if mainRoot and mainCFrame then pcall(function() mainRoot.CFrame = mainCFrame end) end
    end

    local function mainCopyValue(mainValue)
        local mainClipboard = setclipboard or toclipboard
        if type(mainClipboard) == "function" then pcall(mainClipboard, tostring(mainValue or "")) end
    end

    local function mainMapModel()
        return workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") or workspace:FindFirstChild("CurrentMap") or workspace:FindFirstChild("MapModel")
    end

    local function mainMapName()
        local mainMap = mainMapModel()
        return mainMap and mainMap.Name or "Waiting for map"
    end

    local function mainFindSpawn(mainLobby)
        local mainCandidate = nil
        for _, mainObject in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if mainObject:IsA("SpawnLocation") or (mainObject:IsA("BasePart") and string.find(string.lower(mainObject.Name), "spawn", 1, true)) then
                local mainName = string.lower(mainObject.Name)
                local mainIsLobby = string.find(mainName, "lobby", 1, true) or string.find(mainName, "waiting", 1, true)
                if mainLobby == mainIsLobby then return mainObject end
                mainCandidate = mainCandidate or mainObject
            end
        end
        return mainCandidate
    end

    local function mainTeleportDroppedWeapon()
        local mainWeapon = mainFindDroppedGun()
        if mainWeapon then
            local mainPart = mainWeapon:FindFirstChild("Handle") or mainWeapon:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if mainPart then mainMoveLocal(mainPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)) end
        end
    end

    local function mainTeleportRandomSpawn()
        local mainChoices = {}
        for _, mainObject in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if mainObject:IsA("SpawnLocation") or (mainObject:IsA("BasePart") and string.find(string.lower(mainObject.Name), "spawn", 1, true)) then table.insert(mainChoices, mainObject) end
        end
        if #mainChoices > 0 then mainMoveLocal(mainChoices[math.random(1, #mainChoices)].CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) end
    end

    local function mainSetFocus(mainPlayer)
        if mainPlayer and mainPlayer ~= mainLocalPlayer then mainSettings.FlingTarget = mainPlayer end
    end

    local function mainFocusRole(mainRole)
        if mainRole == "Nearest" then mainSetFocus(mainClosestPlayer())
        elseif mainRole == "Murderer" then mainSetFocus(mainGetMurderer())
        elseif mainRole == "Sheriff" then mainSetFocus(mainClosestPlayer("Sheriff")) end
    end

    local function mainFlingFocus()
        mainFling(mainSettings.FlingTarget or mainClosestPlayer())
    end

    local function mainFlingRole(mainRole)
        local mainTarget = mainRole == "Murderer" and mainGetMurderer() or mainClosestPlayer("Sheriff")
        mainFling(mainTarget)
    end

    local function mainCollectNearestToken()
        if not mainAutoCollect then return end
        local _, mainRoot = mainGetCharacter(mainLocalPlayer)
        if not mainRoot then return end
        local mainNearest, mainDistance = nil, math.huge
        for _, mainObject in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if mainObject:IsA("BasePart") then
                local mainName = string.lower(mainObject.Name)
                if string.find(mainName, "coin", 1, true) or string.find(mainName, "token", 1, true) then
                    local mainDistanceHere = (mainRoot.Position - mainObject.Position).Magnitude
                    if mainDistanceHere < mainDistance and mainDistanceHere <= mainAutoCollectRadius then mainNearest, mainDistance = mainObject, mainDistanceHere end
                end
            end
        end
        if mainNearest then mainMoveLocal(mainNearest.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)) end
    end

    local function mainUpdateDashboard()
        local mainFocus = mainSettings.FlingTarget
        local mainFocusText = mainFocus and mainFocus.Parent and (mainFocus.DisplayName .. " (@" .. mainFocus.Name .. ")") or "None"
        if mainTargetInfoLabel then pcall(function() mainTargetInfoLabel:SetText("Focus: <b>" .. mainFocusText .. "</b>") end) end
        if mainMapInfoLabel then pcall(function() mainMapInfoLabel:SetText("Map: <b>" .. mainMapName() .. "</b>") end) end
        if mainVoteInfoLabel then pcall(function() mainVoteInfoLabel:SetText("Route Scan: <b>" .. tostring(#mainPlayers:GetPlayers()) .. " players</b>") end) end
        if mainRoleInfoLabel then
            local mainMurderer, mainSheriff = mainGetMurderer(), mainClosestPlayer("Sheriff")
            local mainMurderText = mainMurderer and mainMurderer.DisplayName or "Unknown"
            local mainSheriffText = mainSheriff and mainSheriff.DisplayName or "Unknown"
            pcall(function() mainRoleInfoLabel:SetText("Murderer: <b>" .. mainMurderText .. "</b> | Sheriff: <b>" .. mainSheriffText .. "</b>") end)
        end
    end

        local mainHumanoid = mainCharacter:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)

        mainClearSceneVisuals()
        mainClearFlight()
        if not mainUiLibrary.Unloaded then pcall(function() mainUiLibrary:Unload() end) end
        local mainEnvironment = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
        mainEnvironment.OwnerSigmaHubRunning = false
    end

    mainUiLibrary:OnUnload(mainCleanup)
    mainNotify("MM2 support loaded.")
    return { Window = mainWindow, Cleanup = mainCleanup }
end

						mainActions.PacketHandler = function(packetHandlerParameter, packetHandlerSecondValue, packetHandlerThirdValue)
							if packetHandlerParameter == mainLocalPlayer then

							if #packetHandlerText6 < 400 then
								return

							local packetHandlerState16 = mainRuntimeData.PacketData[packetHandlerParameter]

							if not packetHandlerState16 then

							end

								packetHandlerState16.IsLagging = true

								mainNotify("Player: " .. packetHandlerValue24 .. "\n" .. "Status: Started packet lagging\n" .. "Method: " .. packetHandlerMethod .. "\n" .. "Packet Size: " .. packetHandlerText7 .. " MB\n" .. "Preview: " .. packetHandlerPreview, "Packet Lag Detected", nil, 7)
							end

							if packetHandlerState16.LastSize then
								local packetHandlerNumber36 = math.abs(packetHandlerLastSize - packetHandlerState16.LastSize)

								if packetHandlerNumber36 >= 25000 and not packetHandlerState16.SizeChanged then
									packetHandlerState16.SizeChanged = true

" MB\n" .. "Difference: " .. math.floor(packetHandlerNumber36 / 1024) .. " KB\n" .. "Preview: " .. packetHandlerPreview, "Packet Size Changed", nil, 6)
								end

							packetHandlerState16.LastSize = packetHandlerLastSize

					mainActions.LineLagHandler = function(lineLagHandlerParameter, lineLagHandlerLastPart, lineLagHandlerSecondValue)
						if typeof(lineLagHandlerLastPart) ~= "Instance" or typeof(lineLagHandlerSecondValue) ~= "CFrame" or lineLagHandlerParameter == mainLocalPlayer then
							return

						local lineLagHandlerState16 = mainRuntimeData.LineData[lineLagHandlerParameter]

								Count = 0,
								FirstTime = 0,
								LastPart = nil,
								PartSwitches = 0,
								IsLagging = false,
								LastTime = 0,

								NotificationCooldown = 0,

						local lineLagHandlerNumber37 = 3

							lineLagHandlerState16.Initialized = true

						end

						if lineLagHandlerNow3 - lineLagHandlerState16.FirstTime < 1 then
							return
						end
						local lineLagHandlerPosition = lineLagHandlerSecondValue.Position
						local lineLagHandlerNumber38 = math.abs(lineLagHandlerPosition.X) + math.abs(lineLagHandlerPosition.Y) + math.abs(lineLagHandlerPosition.Z)
						local lineLagHandlerFlag12 = lineLagHandlerLastPart and lineLagHandlerLastPart:IsA("BasePart") and lineLagHandlerLastPart.CanQuery == false

						if lineLagHandlerState16.LastPart and lineLagHandlerState16.LastPart ~= lineLagHandlerLastPart then
							lineLagHandlerState16.PartSwitches = lineLagHandlerState16.PartSwitches + 1
						end

						lineLagHandlerState16.LastPart = lineLagHandlerLastPart

						if lineLagHandlerNow3 - lineLagHandlerState16.FirstTime > 2 then
							lineLagHandlerState16.FirstTime = lineLagHandlerNow3
							lineLagHandlerState16.Count = 0
							lineLagHandlerState16.PartSwitches = 0
						end

						lineLagHandlerState16.Count = lineLagHandlerState16.Count + 1
						lineLagHandlerState16.LastTime = lineLagHandlerNow3

						if lineLagHandlerState16.Count >= 20 and (lineLagHandlerNumber38 > 10000 or lineLagHandlerState16.PartSwitches >= 10 or lineLagHandlerFlag12) and not lineLagHandlerState16.IsLagging and lineLagHandlerNow3 - lineLagHandlerState16.NotificationCooldown >= lineLagHandlerNumber37 then

							lineLagHandlerState16.NotificationCooldown = lineLagHandlerNow3
							mainNotify("Player: " .. lineLagHandlerValue24 .. "\nStatus: Line lag started", "Line Lag Detected")
						end

						if lineLagHandlerState16.LagCheck then
							task.cancel(lineLagHandlerState16.LagCheck)
							lineLagHandlerState16.LagCheck = nil
						end

						if lineLagHandlerState16.IsLagging then
							lineLagHandlerState16.LagCheck = task.delay(2, function()
								if not mainRuntimeData.LineData[lineLagHandlerParameter] then
									return
								end

								if not lineLagHandlerState16.IsLagging then
									return
								end

								if tick() - (lineLagHandlerState16.LastTime or 0) >= lineLagHandlerNumber36 then
									lineLagHandlerState16.IsLagging = false
									lineLagHandlerState16.Count = 0
									lineLagHandlerState16.PartSwitches = 0
									local lineLagHandlerNotificationCooldown = lineLagHandlerState16.NotificationCooldown

									if tick() - lineLagHandlerNotificationCooldown >= lineLagHandlerNumber37 then
										lineLagHandlerState16.NotificationCooldown = tick()
										mainNotify("Player: " .. lineLagHandlerValue24 .. "\nStatus: Line lag stopped", "Line Lag Ended")
									end
								end
							end)
						end
					end

                    mainActions.QueueTeleport = function(queueTeleportAntiLag, queueTeleportReload)

                            return false

repeat task.wait() until game:IsLoaded()
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
if not player then return end
local scripts = player:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts", 15)
if scripts then
    for _, name in ipairs({"CharacterAndBeamMove", "StickyPartsTouchDetection"}) do
        local item = scripts:WaitForChild(name, 10)
        if item then item.Enabled = not %s end
    end
end
if %s then
    local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
    env.OwnerSigmaHubRunning = false
    env.OwnerSigmaHubStarting = false
    local source = assert(readfile, "readfile unavailable")(%q)
    local run, message = loadstring(source, "@OwnerSigmaHub")
    assert(run, message)
    run()
end
]], tostring(queueTeleportAntiLag == true), tostring(queueTeleportReload == true), mainReloadPath or "")
                        local queueTeleportSucceeded, queueTeleportError = pcall(queueTeleportQueue, queueTeleportSource)
                        if not queueTeleportSucceeded then mainNotify("Unable to queue teleport: " .. tostring(queueTeleportError)) end
                        return queueTeleportSucceeded
                    end

							mainTeleportService:Teleport(mainPlaceId, mainLocalPlayer)
						else
							mainTeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(mainPlaceId, mainJobId, mainLocalPlayer)
						end
					end

					mainConnections.Compact = function(compactParameter)
						local compactItems = {}
						local compactTail = 0

						for compactIndex = compactParameter.Head, compactParameter.Tail do
							local compactValue24 = compactParameter.Items[compactIndex]

							if compactValue24 then
								compactTail += 1
								compactItems[compactTail] = compactValue24
							end
						end

						compactParameter.Items = compactItems
						compactParameter.Head = 1
						compactParameter.Tail = compactTail
					end

					mainConnections.Enqueue = function(enqueueParameter, enqueueSecondValue, enqueueThirdValue, enqueueFourthValue)
						if not (enqueueParameter and enqueueSecondValue and enqueueThirdValue) then
							return
						end
						enqueueFourthValue = enqueueFourthValue or enqueueParameter
						local enqueueState16 = mainConnections.Workers[enqueueParameter]

						if not enqueueState16 then
							enqueueState16 = { Items = {}, Pending = {}, Head = 1, Tail = 0, Running = false }
							mainConnections.Workers[enqueueParameter] = enqueueState16
						end

						local enqueueNumber36 = mainConnections.Generations[enqueueFourthValue] or 0
						local enqueueValue24 = enqueueState16.Pending[enqueueThirdValue]
						if enqueueValue24 and enqueueValue24.Owner == enqueueFourthValue and enqueueValue24.Epoch == mainConnections.Epoch and enqueueValue24.Generation == enqueueNumber36 then
							return
						end
						local enqueueState17 = { Callback = enqueueSecondValue, Player = enqueueThirdValue, Owner = enqueueFourthValue, Epoch = mainConnections.Epoch, Generation = enqueueNumber36 }
						enqueueState16.Tail = enqueueState16.Tail + 1
						enqueueState16.Items[enqueueState16.Tail] = enqueueState17
						enqueueState16.Pending[enqueueThirdValue] = enqueueState17
						if enqueueState16.Running then
							return
						end
						enqueueState16.Running = true

						task.spawn(function()
							while not mainUnloaded do
								local enqueueValue25 = enqueueState16.Items[enqueueState16.Head]

								if enqueueValue25 then
									enqueueState16.Items[enqueueState16.Head] = nil
									enqueueState16.Head = enqueueState16.Head + 1
									local enqueueFlag12 = enqueueValue25.Epoch == mainConnections.Epoch

									if enqueueFlag12 then
										enqueueFlag12 = enqueueValue25.Generation == (mainConnections.Generations[enqueueValue25.Owner] or 0)
									end

									if enqueueFlag12 and enqueueValue25.Player.Parent then
										local enqueueSucceeded, enqueueResult = pcall(enqueueValue25.Callback, enqueueValue25.Player)

										if not enqueueSucceeded then
											warn(("[OwnerSigmaHub] %s failed: %s"):format(enqueueParameter, tostring(enqueueResult)))
										end

										task.wait()
									end

									if enqueueState16.Pending[enqueueValue25.Player] == enqueueValue25 then
										enqueueState16.Pending[enqueueValue25.Player] = nil
									end

									if enqueueState16.Head > 128 and enqueueState16.Head > enqueueState16.Tail / 2 then
										mainConnections.Compact(enqueueState16)
									end

									continue
								end

								break
							end

							enqueueState16.Items = {}
							enqueueState16.Pending = {}
							enqueueState16.Head = 1
							enqueueState16.Tail = 0
							enqueueState16.Running = false
						end)
					end

								return false
							end
							local playTriggerTrickNumber39 = math.min(playTriggerTrickNumber36 / playTriggerTrickNumber38, 1)
							local playTriggerTrickNumber40 = playTriggerTrickCFrame2.Position + playTriggerTrickValue25.Position - playTriggerTrickPosition
							if (playTriggerTrickValue28.Position - playTriggerTrickNumber40).Magnitude < 0.001 then
								return false
							end
							local playTriggerTrickValue32 = playTriggerTrickCFrame2.Rotation:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(playTriggerTrickNumber40, playTriggerTrickValue28.Position).Rotation, playTriggerTrickNumber39)
							local playTriggerTrickNumber41

							if playTriggerTrickTriggerTrick == "180 Flick" then
								playTriggerTrickNumber41 = math.sin(playTriggerTrickNumber39 * 3.1415926535897931) * 3.1415926535897931
							else
								playTriggerTrickNumber41 = playTriggerTrickNumber39 * 3.1415926535897931 * 2 * playTriggerTrickValue30
							end

							playTriggerTrickCurrentCamera2.CFrame = CFrame.new(playTriggerTrickNumber40) * CFrame.Angles(0, playTriggerTrickNumber41, 0) * playTriggerTrickValue32
							local playTriggerTrickNumber42 = playTriggerTrickCurrentCamera2.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)

							if playTriggerTrickNumber42.Magnitude > 0.001 then
								playTriggerTrickValue25.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(playTriggerTrickValue25.Position, playTriggerTrickValue25.Position + playTriggerTrickNumber42)
							end
						until playTriggerTrickNumber36 >= playTriggerTrickNumber38

						return true
					end)

					playTriggerTrickAimSettings.TriggerSpinning = false

					if playTriggerTrickValue26.Parent then
						playTriggerTrickValue26.AutoRotate = playTriggerTrickAutoRotate
					end

					if not (playTriggerTrickSucceeded and playTriggerTrickResult) and playTriggerTrickValue25.Parent then
						playTriggerTrickValue25.CFrame = CFrame.new(playTriggerTrickValue25.Position) * playTriggerTrickRotation
					end

					if playTriggerTrickCurrentCamera2.Parent then
						if not (playTriggerTrickSucceeded and playTriggerTrickResult) then
							playTriggerTrickCurrentCamera2.CFrame = playTriggerTrickCFrame2 + playTriggerTrickValue25.Position - playTriggerTrickPosition
						end

						playTriggerTrickCurrentCamera2.CameraType = playTriggerTrickCameraType
					end

					return playTriggerTrickSucceeded and playTriggerTrickResult
				end

						return
					end
					getSilentAimHitThirdValue = getSilentAimHitThirdValue or getSilentAimHitCurrentCamera2.CFrame.Position
					local getSilentAimHitNumber36 = getSilentAimHitCurrentCamera2.ViewportSize / 2
					local getSilentAimHitNumber37 = mainFeatureSettings.SAIMRadius ^ 2
					local getSilentAimHitValue24 = nil

					for _getSilentAimHitUnused1, getSilentAimHitValue25 in ipairs(mainRuntimeData.PlayerList) do
						if mainActions.IsSilentAimTarget(getSilentAimHitValue25) then
							local getSilentAimHitValue26, getSilentAimHitValue27, getSilentAimHitValue28 = mainActions.Char(getSilentAimHitValue25)

							if getSilentAimHitValue27 and getSilentAimHitValue28 and getSilentAimHitValue28.Health > 0 then
								local getSilentAimHitValue29, getSilentAimHitValue30 = getSilentAimHitCurrentCamera2:WorldToViewportPoint(getSilentAimHitValue27.Position)

								if getSilentAimHitValue30 then
									local getSilentAimHitNumber38 = getSilentAimHitValue29.X - getSilentAimHitNumber36.X
									local getSilentAimHitNumber39 = getSilentAimHitValue29.Y - getSilentAimHitNumber36.Y
									local getSilentAimHitNumber40 = getSilentAimHitNumber38 * getSilentAimHitNumber38 + getSilentAimHitNumber39 * getSilentAimHitNumber39
									local getSilentAimHitNumber41 = getSilentAimHitValue27.Position - getSilentAimHitThirdValue
									local getSilentAimHitMagnitude = getSilentAimHitNumber41.Magnitude

									if getSilentAimHitNumber40 <= getSilentAimHitNumber37 and getSilentAimHitMagnitude > 0.001 and getSilentAimHitMagnitude <= getSilentAimHitParameter + getSilentAimHitValue27.Size.Magnitude / 2 then
										local getSilentAimHitHit = workspace:Raycast(getSilentAimHitThirdValue, getSilentAimHitNumber41.Unit * math.min(getSilentAimHitParameter, getSilentAimHitMagnitude + getSilentAimHitValue27.Size.Magnitude / 2), getSilentAimHitSecondValue)

										if getSilentAimHitHit and getSilentAimHitHit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(getSilentAimHitValue26) then
											getSilentAimHitNumber37 = getSilentAimHitNumber40
											getSilentAimHitValue24 = getSilentAimHitHit
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end

					return getSilentAimHitValue24

					setSilentAimParameter = setSilentAimParameter and not mainUnloaded

					if setSilentAimParameter then

						if setSilentAimSilentAimState.Dirty then
							setSilentAimSilentAimState.Dirty = nil
							mainActions.RefreshSilentAim()
						end
					end)

					if mainUnloaded then
						local setSilentAimPatch = setSilentAimSilentAimState.Patch

						if setSilentAimPatch and getrawmetatable then
							local setSilentAimSucceeded, setSilentAimResult = pcall(getrawmetatable, game)

							if setSilentAimSucceeded and setSilentAimResult.__namecall == setSilentAimPatch.Wrapper then
								pcall(hookmetamethod, game, "__namecall", setSilentAimPatch.Original)
							end
						end

						setSilentAimSilentAimState.Patch = nil
						setSilentAimSilentAimState.Dirty = nil
						setSilentAimSilentAimState.Failed = nil
					elseif not setSilentAimSilentAimState.Patch and type(hookmetamethod) == "function" and type(getnamecallmethod) == "function" then
						local setSilentAimPatch = {}

						local function setSilentAimWrapper(wrapperSecondValue, ...)
							local wrapperValue24 = table.pack(...)
							if mainUnloaded or not mainFeatureFlags.SilentAim or not setSilentAimSilentAimState.RaycastActive or wrapperSecondValue ~= workspace or getnamecallmethod() ~= "Raycast" or checkcaller and checkcaller() then
								return setSilentAimPatch.Original(wrapperSecondValue, ...)
							end
							local wrapperValue25 = ...
							local wrapperValue = select(2, ...)
							local wrapperValue2 = select(3, ...)
							local wrapperCurrentCamera2 = workspace.CurrentCamera
							if not wrapperCurrentCamera2 or typeof(wrapperValue25) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(wrapperValue) ~= "Vector3" or wrapperValue.Magnitude <= 0 or (wrapperValue25 - wrapperCurrentCamera2.CFrame.Position).Magnitude >= 0.1 or wrapperValue.Unit:Dot(wrapperCurrentCamera2.CFrame.LookVector) <= 0.999 then
								return setSilentAimPatch.Original(wrapperSecondValue, table.unpack(wrapperValue24, 1, wrapperValue24.n))
							end
							local wrapperSucceeded, wrapperResult = pcall(getcallingscript)
							if wrapperSucceeded and wrapperResult and wrapperResult.Name ~= "GrabbingScript" and wrapperResult.Name ~= "RaycastModule" then
								return setSilentAimPatch.Original(wrapperSecondValue, table.unpack(wrapperValue24, 1, wrapperValue24.n))
							end
							local wrapperOk2, wrapperHit = pcall(mainActions.GetSilentAimHit, wrapperValue.Magnitude, wrapperValue2, wrapperValue25)

							if wrapperOk2 and wrapperHit then
								local wrapperValue26 = setSilentAimSilentAimState
								local wrapperValue27 = setSilentAimSilentAimState
								local wrapperNow3 = os.clock()
								wrapperValue26.Hit = wrapperHit
								wrapperValue27.HitTime = wrapperNow3
								return wrapperHit
							end

							if not wrapperOk2 then
								setSilentAimSilentAimState.Failed = true
								setSilentAimSilentAimState.RaycastActive = false
								setSilentAimSilentAimState.Dirty = true
							end

							local wrapperValue26 = workspace.Raycast(wrapperSecondValue, table.unpack(wrapperValue24, 1, wrapperValue24.n))
							local wrapperValue27 = setSilentAimSilentAimState
							local wrapperValue28 = setSilentAimSilentAimState
							local wrapperNow3 = os.clock()
							wrapperValue27.Hit = wrapperValue26
							wrapperValue28.HitTime = wrapperNow3
							return wrapperValue26
						end

						if newcclosure then
							setSilentAimWrapper = newcclosure(setSilentAimWrapper)
						end

						setSilentAimPatch.Wrapper = setSilentAimWrapper
						local setSilentAimSucceeded, setSilentAimOriginal = pcall(hookmetamethod, game, "__namecall", setSilentAimPatch.Wrapper)

						if setSilentAimSucceeded and type(setSilentAimOriginal) == "function" then
							setSilentAimPatch.Original = setSilentAimOriginal
							setSilentAimSilentAimState.Patch = setSilentAimPatch
						end
					end

					setSilentAimSilentAimState.RaycastActive = not mainUnloaded and setSilentAimSilentAimState.Patch ~= nil and not setSilentAimSilentAimState.Failed
					mainActions.RefreshSilentAim()
				end

				local mainRagdollDuplicateDeletes = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
				mainActions.Ragdoll = function(ragdollParameter)
					if not ragdollParameter or not ragdollParameter.Parent or mainRuntimeData.States.Ragdolling then
						return
					end
					local ragdollHead = ragdollParameter:FindFirstChild("Head")
					local ragdollTorso = ragdollHead and ragdollParameter:FindFirstChild("Torso")
					local ragdollHumanoid = ragdollTorso and ragdollParameter:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
					ragdollHumanoid = ragdollHumanoid and ragdollHumanoid:FindFirstChild("Ragdolled")

					if ragdollHumanoid and ragdollHumanoid.Value == false then
						mainRuntimeData.States.Ragdolling = true
						local ragdollRSC = mainValue17:FindFirstChild("RagdollRSC") or mainActions.SpawnToy("PalletLightBrown")
						local ragdollSoundPart = ragdollRSC and ragdollRSC:WaitForChild("SoundPart", 0.5)
						local ragdollMain = ragdollSoundPart and ragdollRSC:WaitForChild("Main", 0.5)
						if not ragdollMain or not mainActions.SNO(ragdollSoundPart) then
							mainRuntimeData.States.Ragdolling = false
							return mainActions.DestroyToy(ragdollRSC)
						end
						ragdollRSC.Name = "RagdollRSC"
						
						for _, ragdollCandidate in ipairs(mainValue17:GetChildren()) do
							if ragdollCandidate ~= ragdollRSC and ragdollCandidate.Name == "RagdollRSC" and not mainRagdollDuplicateDeletes[ragdollCandidate] then
								mainRagdollDuplicateDeletes[ragdollCandidate] = true
								pcall(mainActions.DestroyToy, ragdollCandidate)
								task.delay(0.4, function()
									mainRagdollDuplicateDeletes[ragdollCandidate] = nil
								end)
							end
						end

						for _ragdollUnused1, ragdollChild in pairs(ragdollRSC:GetChildren()) do
							if ragdollChild:IsA("BasePart") then
								ragdollChild.CanCollide = false
							end
						end

						if not ragdollMain:FindFirstChild("RagdollBP") then
							local ragdollBodyPosition = Instance.new("BodyPosition")
							ragdollBodyPosition.Name = "RagdollBP"
							ragdollBodyPosition.D = 1500
							ragdollBodyPosition.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
							ragdollBodyPosition.Position = Vector3.new(0, 100000, 0)
							ragdollBodyPosition.Parent = ragdollMain
						end

						local ragdollNow3 = tick()

						while true do
							ragdollSoundPart.Position = ragdollTorso.Position
							ragdollSoundPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, -10, 0)
							task.wait(0.1)
							if not (ragdollHumanoid.Value or not ragdollMain.Parent or not ragdollParameter.Parent or not ragdollHead:FindFirstChild("PartOwner") or tick() - ragdollNow3 > 0.5) then
								continue
							end
							break
						end

						mainRuntimeData.States.Ragdolling = false
						return ragdollHumanoid.Value
					end
				end

				mainActions.RemoveSticky = function(removeStickyParameter, removeStickySecondValue)
					if not removeStickyParameter or not removeStickyParameter.Parent then
						return
					end

					for _removeStickyUnused1, removeStickyValue24 in pairs(removeStickyParameter:QueryDescendants("BasePart")) do
						if removeStickyValue24.Parent then
							for _removeStickyUnused2, removeStickyValue25 in pairs(removeStickyValue24:GetConnectedParts()) do
								if removeStickyValue25.Name == "StickyPart" then
									for _removeStickyUnused3, removeStickyChild in pairs(removeStickyValue25:GetChildren()) do
										if removeStickyChild:IsA("TouchInterest") then
											removeStickyChild:Destroy()

								end
							end

											removeStickyBodyVelocity2.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, -50000, 0)
											removeStickyBodyVelocity2.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
											removeStickyBodyVelocity2.Name = "RscBV"
											removeStickyBodyVelocity2.Parent = removeStickyValue26
										end

										mainActions.PivotTo(removeStickyValue25, CFrame.new(0, -50000, 0))
										task.delay(1, mainActions.RNO, removeStickyValue26)
									end
								end
							end

					end

				mainActions.BreakLimb = function(breakLimbParameter, breakLimbSecondValue)
					local breakLimbFlag12 = breakLimbParameter == mainLocalPlayer

								continue
							end
							break
						end

						return
					end

					if not breakLimbRagdolled.Value then

				mainActions.UpdateFlight = function()
					local updateFlightValue24, updateFlightValue25, updateFlightValue26 = mainActions.Char()

					if not (updateFlightValue24 and updateFlightValue25 and updateFlightValue26 and updateFlightValue26.Health > 0) then

							mainActions.StopFly()
						end

					end

						mainActions.StopFly()
						mainActions.StartFly(updateFlightValue25)
					end

						updateFlightValue26.PlatformStand = true
					end

					local updateFlightNumber36 = 0

					if mainUserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
						updateFlightNumber36 = 1
					end

					if mainUserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
						updateFlightNumber36 -= 1
					end

					local updateFlightNumber37 = 0

					if mainUserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
						updateFlightNumber37 = -1
					end

					if mainUserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
						updateFlightNumber37 += 1
					end

					local updateFlightNumber38 = 0

					if mainUserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
						updateFlightNumber38 = 2
					end

					if mainUserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or mainUserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
						updateFlightNumber38 -= 2
					end

					if mainUserInputService.TouchEnabled and not mainUserInputService.KeyboardEnabled then
						local updateFlightValue27 = mainValue23
						local updateFlightControlModule

						if mainValue23 then
							updateFlightControlModule = updateFlightValue27
						else
							updateFlightControlModule = require(mainLocalPlayer.PlayerScripts:WaitForChild("PlayerModule"):WaitForChild("ControlModule"))
						end

						mainValue23 = updateFlightControlModule
						local updateFlightMoveVector = mainValue23:GetMoveVector()
						updateFlightNumber37 += updateFlightMoveVector.X
						updateFlightNumber36 -= updateFlightMoveVector.Z

						if updateFlightValue26.Jump then
							updateFlightNumber38 += 2
						end
					end

					local updateFlightNumber39 = mainCurrentCamera.CFrame.RightVector * updateFlightNumber37 + mainCurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector * updateFlightNumber36 + Vector3.new(0, updateFlightNumber38, 0)

					if updateFlightNumber39.Magnitude > 1 then
						updateFlightNumber39 = updateFlightNumber39.Unit
					end

					local updateFlightValue27 = mainBodyVelocity
					local updateFlightVelocity = mainBodyVelocity.Velocity
					local updateFlightLerp = updateFlightVelocity.Lerp
					local updateFlightNumber40 = updateFlightNumber39 * mainFeatureSettings.FlightSpeed * 50
					local updateFlightNumber41

					if updateFlightNumber39.Magnitude > 0 then
						updateFlightNumber41 = 0.22
					else
						updateFlightNumber41 = 0.12
					end

					updateFlightValue27.Velocity = updateFlightLerp(updateFlightVelocity, updateFlightNumber40, updateFlightNumber41)
					mainBodyGyro.CFrame = mainCurrentCamera.CFrame
				end

				mainActions.UpdateWallClimb = function()
					local mainChar, mainRoot, mainHumanoid = mainActions.Char()
					if not (mainChar and mainRoot and mainHumanoid and mainHumanoid.Health > 0) then
						return
					end

					if mainHumanoid.Sit or mainHumanoid.PlatformStand then
						return
					end

					local moveDir = mainHumanoid.MoveDirection
					local isMoving = moveDir.Magnitude > 0.05
					local isJumping = mainHumanoid.Jump or mainUserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)

					if not isMoving and not isJumping then
						return
					end

					local forwardDir = isMoving and moveDir.Unit or mainRoot.CFrame.LookVector
					local rayDistance = 2.8
					local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
					rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
					rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { mainChar }
					rayParams.IgnoreWater = true

					local origins = {
						mainRoot.Position - Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0),
						mainRoot.Position,
						mainRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0),
					}

					local hitResult = nil
					for _, origin in ipairs(origins) do
						local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, forwardDir * rayDistance, rayParams)
						if result and result.Instance and result.Instance.CanCollide and result.Normal.Y < 0.7 then
							local isPlayer = false
							local checkObj = result.Instance
							while checkObj and checkObj ~= workspace do
								if mainPlayers:GetPlayerFromCharacter(checkObj) then
									isPlayer = true
									break
								end
								checkObj = checkObj.Parent
							end
							if not isPlayer then
								hitResult = result
								break
							end
						end
					end

					if hitResult then
						local climbSpeed = mainFeatureSettings.WallClimbSpeed or 30
						local topCheck = workspace:Raycast(mainRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.8, 0), forwardDir * rayDistance, rayParams)
						local topClear = true
						if topCheck and topCheck.Instance and topCheck.Instance.CanCollide and topCheck.Normal.Y < 0.7 then
							local isPlayer = false
							local checkObj = topCheck.Instance
							while checkObj and checkObj ~= workspace do
								if mainPlayers:GetPlayerFromCharacter(checkObj) then
									isPlayer = true
									break
								end
								checkObj = checkObj.Parent
							end
							if not isPlayer then
								topClear = false
							end
						end

						if topClear then
							mainRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(forwardDir.X * 12, climbSpeed * 0.6, forwardDir.Z * 12)
						else
							local wallNormal = hitResult.Normal
							local wallHorizontal = Vector3.new(wallNormal.X, 0, wallNormal.Z)
							local stick = Vector3.zero
							if wallHorizontal.Magnitude > 0.001 then
								stick = -wallHorizontal.Unit * 3
							else
								stick = forwardDir * 3
							end
							mainRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(stick.X, climbSpeed, stick.Z)
						end
					end
				end

					local mainFlag12 = nil
					local mainNumber36 = nil
					local mainNum = nil
					local mainNumber37 = nil
					local mainNumber38 = 0

						for _mainUnused4, mainValue25 in ipairs({ tostring(mainParameter2), mainParameter2 }) do

					end

						mainNumber38 += 1

						if mainUnloaded or not mainFeatureFlags.Desync then
							return
						end

							if (not updateDesyncSucceeded or tonumber(updateDesyncResult) ~= 1000) and not mainFunction21(1000) then

								mainFunction22()
							end

							return
						end

							mainFunction22()
							mainValue24 = updateDesyncValue26
							mainNumber36 = updateDesyncNow3 + 0.14
						end

						if mainFlag12 then
							return
						end

						if updateDesyncNow3 < mainNumber36 then
							if not pcall(sethiddenproperty, mainValue24, "PhysicsRepRootPart", mainValue24) then
								return mainFunction23()
							end
							return
						end

							return mainFunction23()
						end
						task.wait(0.1)
						if updateDesyncValue29 ~= mainNumber38 or mainUnloaded or not mainFeatureFlags.Desync or updateDesyncValue28 ~= mainValue24 then
							return

							return mainFunction22()
						end

							return mainFunction23()
						end
						mainFlag12 = false
						mainNumber36 = os.clock() + 0.14
					end

						if mainFeatureFlags.Desync == setDesyncDesync then
							return
						end

						mainFeatureFlags.Desync = setDesyncDesync

						if setDesyncDesync then
							local setDesyncSucceeded, setDesyncResult = pcall(getfflag, "S2PhysicsSenderRate")

							if setDesyncSucceeded and tonumber(setDesyncResult) then
								mainNum = tonumber(setDesyncResult)
							end

							if mainNum == nil then
								return mainFunction23()
							end
							mainNumber37 = os.clock() + 1
							if not mainFunction21(1000) then
								return mainFunction23()
							end
						else
							mainFunction22()

							if mainNum ~= nil then
								mainFunction21(mainNum)
							end
						end

						mainActions.SetRuntimeConnection("Desync", mainRunService.Heartbeat, setDesyncDesync, mainActions.UpdateDesync)
					end
				end
			end

						if mainIsHeld.Value and mainFeatureFlags.AntiGrab and not mainRuntimeData.States["Anti Grab"] then

							local antiGrabValue23, antiGrabValue24, antiGrabValue25 = mainActions.Char()
							local antiGrabTorso = antiGrabValue23 and (antiGrabValue23:FindFirstChild("Torso") or antiGrabValue24)

							local antiGrabOriginalRequiresNeck = antiGrabValue25.RequiresNeck
							local antiGrabOriginalAutoRotate = antiGrabValue25.AutoRotate
							local antiGrabOriginalSit = antiGrabValue25.Sit
							local antiGrabOriginalPlatformStand = antiGrabValue25.PlatformStand
							antiGrabValue25.RequiresNeck = false
							antiGrabValue25.AutoRotate = false
							antiGrabValue25.PlatformStand = false
							mainActions.ResetVelocity(antiGrabValue24 or antiGrabTorso)
							local antiGrabPosition = antiGrabTorso.Position
							local antiGrabHardLock = false
							local antiGrabLookVector = antiGrabTorso.CFrame.LookVector

								if removePlayerESPValue23 then
									removePlayerESPValue23:Disconnect()
								end

								local removePlayerESPValue24 = mainObj2
								mainObj[removePlayerESPParameter] = nil
								removePlayerESPValue24[removePlayerESPParameter] = nil

								for removePlayerESPKey, removePlayerESPPlayer in pairs(mainState16.Players) do
									if removePlayerESPPlayer.Player == removePlayerESPParameter then
										mainFunction22(removePlayerESPKey, removePlayerESPPlayer)
									end
								end
							end

							local function createESPLine(parent, name)
								local line = Instance.new("Frame")
								line.Name = name
								line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
								line.BorderSizePixel = 0
								line.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
								line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1.5)
								line.Visible = false
								line.ZIndex = 20
								line.Parent = parent
								return line
							end
							local function setESPLine(line, fromPoint, toPoint, visible, color)
								if not line then return end
								local delta = toPoint - fromPoint
								line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((fromPoint.X + toPoint.X) * 0.5, (fromPoint.Y + toPoint.Y) * 0.5)
								line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(delta.Magnitude, 1), 1.5)
								line.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(delta.Y, delta.X))
								line.BackgroundColor3 = color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
								line.Visible = visible and delta.Magnitude > 1
							end
							local function makePlayerESPOverlay(character)
								local overlay = { Corner = {}, Tracers = {}, Skeet = {} }
								for index = 1, 8 do overlay.Corner[index] = createESPLine(mainScreenGui, "PlayerESPCorner") end
								for index = 1, 1 do overlay.Tracers[index] = createESPLine(mainScreenGui, "PlayerESPTracer") end
								for index = 1, 14 do overlay.Skeet[index] = createESPLine(mainScreenGui, "PlayerESPSkeleton") end
								local connection
								connection = mainRunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
									if mainUnloaded or not character.Parent then
										if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
										for _, group in pairs(overlay) do for _, line in ipairs(group) do line:Destroy() end end
										return
									end
									local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
									local style = mainFeatureSettings.PlayerESPStyle or "Corner"
									local color = mainEspConfig.Player.OutlineColor or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
									for _, group in pairs(overlay) do for _, line in ipairs(group) do line.Visible = false end end
									if not camera or not mainFeatureFlags.PlayerESP or style == "Classic" or mainLocalPlayer.Character == character then return end
									local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
									local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
									local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
									if not root or not head or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
									local function project(part, offset)
										if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end
										local point, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position + (offset or Vector3.zero))
										if point.Z <= 0 or not onScreen then return nil end
										return Vector2.new(point.X, point.Y)
									end
									if style == "Tracers" then
										local rootPoint, rootDepth = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
										if rootDepth and rootPoint.Z > 0 then
											local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
											setESPLine(overlay.Tracers[1], Vector2.new(viewport.X * 0.5, viewport.Y - 2), Vector2.new(rootPoint.X, rootPoint.Y), true, color)
										end
									elseif style == "Corner" then
										local boxCF, boxSize = character:GetBoundingBox()
										local half = boxSize * 0.5
										local minX, minY, maxX, maxY = math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
										local valid = 0
										for _, x in ipairs({-half.X, half.X}) do
											for _, y in ipairs({-half.Y, half.Y}) do
												for _, z in ipairs({-half.Z, half.Z}) do
													local p = camera:WorldToViewportPoint((boxCF * CFrame.new(x, y, z)).Position)
													if p.Z > 0 then minX, minY, maxX, maxY = math.min(minX,p.X), math.min(minY,p.Y), math.max(maxX,p.X), math.max(maxY,p.Y); valid += 1 end
												end
											end
										end
										if valid < 2 or maxX - minX < 2 or maxY - minY < 4 then return end
										local width, height = maxX-minX, maxY-minY
										local len = math.clamp(math.min(width, height) * 0.24, 5, 18)
										local tl, tr = Vector2.new(minX,minY), Vector2.new(maxX,minY)
										local bl, br = Vector2.new(minX,maxY), Vector2.new(maxX,maxY)
										local pairs = {{tl,tl+Vector2.new(len,0)},{tl,tl+Vector2.new(0,len)},{tr-Vector2.new(len,0),tr},{tr,tr+Vector2.new(0,len)},{bl,bl+Vector2.new(len,0)},{bl-Vector2.new(0,len),bl},{br-Vector2.new(len,0),br},{br-Vector2.new(0,len),br}}
										for i, pair in ipairs(pairs) do setESPLine(overlay.Corner[i], pair[1], pair[2], true, color) end
									elseif style == "Skeet" then
										local function findPart(...)
											for _, name in ipairs({...}) do local part = character:FindFirstChild(name); if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then return part end end
										end
										local isR15 = character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") ~= nil
										local parts = {
											Head = head, Upper = findPart("UpperTorso", "Torso"), Lower = findPart("LowerTorso", "HumanoidRootPart", "Torso"),
											LShoulder = findPart("LeftUpperArm", "Left Arm"), LElbow = findPart("LeftLowerArm"), LHand = findPart("LeftHand"),
											RShoulder = findPart("RightUpperArm", "Right Arm"), RElbow = findPart("RightLowerArm"), RHand = findPart("RightHand"),
											LHip = findPart("LeftUpperLeg", "Left Leg"), LKnee = findPart("LeftLowerLeg"), LFoot = findPart("LeftFoot"),
											RHip = findPart("RightUpperLeg", "Right Leg"), RKnee = findPart("RightLowerLeg"), RFoot = findPart("RightFoot"),
										}
										local links
										if isR15 then
											links = {{"Head","Upper"},{"Upper","Lower"},{"Upper","LShoulder"},{"LShoulder","LElbow"},{"LElbow","LHand"},{"Upper","RShoulder"},{"RShoulder","RElbow"},{"RElbow","RHand"},{"Lower","LHip"},{"LHip","LKnee"},{"LKnee","LFoot"},{"Lower","RHip"},{"RHip","RKnee"},{"RKnee","RFoot"}}
										else
											links = {{"Head","Upper"},{"Upper","LShoulder"},{"Upper","RShoulder"},{"Upper","LHip"},{"Upper","RHip"}}
										end
										for i, link in ipairs(links) do
											local a, b = project(parts[link[1]], Vector3.zero), project(parts[link[2]], Vector3.zero)
											if a and b then setESPLine(overlay.Skeet[i], a, b, true, color) end
										end
							end
							end)
							return overlay, connection
						end
						mainActions.CreatePlayerESP = function(createPlayerESPParameter)
								local createPlayerESPValue23 = mainObj2[createPlayerESPParameter]
								if createPlayerESPValue23 then
									task.spawn(createPlayerESPValue23, createPlayerESPParameter.Character)
									return
								end
								local createPlayerESPValue24 = nil

								task.spawn(function()
									createPlayerESPValue24 = mainActions.GetPlayerIcon(createPlayerESPParameter)
									local createPlayerESPValue25 = mainObj3[createPlayerESPParameter]

									if createPlayerESPValue25 then
										createPlayerESPValue25.Thumbnail = createPlayerESPValue24

										if createPlayerESPValue24 and createPlayerESPValue25.Icon.Image ~= createPlayerESPValue24 then
											createPlayerESPValue25.Icon.Image = createPlayerESPValue24
										end

										mainActions.UpdatePlayerESP(createPlayerESPValue25.Character)
									end
								end)

								local function createPlayerESPFunction24(createPlayerESPCharacter)
									if mainUnloaded or not mainFeatureFlags.PlayerESP or not createPlayerESPCharacter then
										return
									end

									if mainState16.Players[createPlayerESPCharacter] then
										return
									end
									local createPlayerESPHead = createPlayerESPCharacter:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
									if not createPlayerESPHead or mainUnloaded or not mainFeatureFlags.PlayerESP or not createPlayerESPCharacter.Parent then
										return
									end
									local createPlayerESPClone = mainHighlight:Clone()
									createPlayerESPClone.Adornee = createPlayerESPCharacter
									createPlayerESPClone.Parent = createPlayerESPCharacter
									local createPlayerESPBillboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
									createPlayerESPBillboardGui.Enabled = false
