									createPlayerESPBillboardGui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 150)
									createPlayerESPBillboardGui.SizeOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
									createPlayerESPBillboardGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
									createPlayerESPBillboardGui.Parent = mainScreenGui
									local createPlayerESPUiListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
									createPlayerESPUiListLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
									createPlayerESPUiListLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
									createPlayerESPUiListLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
									createPlayerESPUiListLayout.Parent = createPlayerESPBillboardGui
									local createPlayerESPImageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
									createPlayerESPImageLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
									createPlayerESPImageLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(35, 35)
									createPlayerESPImageLabel.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
									createPlayerESPImageLabel.Image = createPlayerESPValue24 or ""
									createPlayerESPImageLabel.Parent = createPlayerESPBillboardGui
									local createPlayerESPTextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
									createPlayerESPTextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
									createPlayerESPTextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
									createPlayerESPTextLabel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
									createPlayerESPTextLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
									createPlayerESPTextLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
									createPlayerESPTextLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
									createPlayerESPTextLabel.Text = mainActions.FormatPlayer(createPlayerESPParameter, true)
									createPlayerESPTextLabel.Parent = createPlayerESPBillboardGui

									local createPlayerESPState19 = {
										Character = createPlayerESPCharacter,
										Player = createPlayerESPParameter,
										Head = createPlayerESPHead,
										Highlight = createPlayerESPClone,
										Billboard = createPlayerESPBillboardGui,
										Icon = createPlayerESPImageLabel,
										Label = createPlayerESPTextLabel,
										Thumbnail = createPlayerESPValue24,
										Connections = {},
										Instances = { createPlayerESPBillboardGui, createPlayerESPClone },
									}

									local overlay, overlayConnection = makePlayerESPOverlay(createPlayerESPCharacter)
								createPlayerESPState19.Overlay = overlay
								createPlayerESPState19.Connections[#createPlayerESPState19.Connections + 1] = overlayConnection
								for _, group in pairs(overlay) do for _, line in ipairs(group) do table.insert(createPlayerESPState19.Instances, line) end end
								mainState16.Players[createPlayerESPCharacter] = createPlayerESPState19
									mainObj3[createPlayerESPParameter] = createPlayerESPState19

									createPlayerESPState19.Connections[1] = createPlayerESPCharacter.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(createPlayerESPChild, createPlayerESPParent2)
										if not createPlayerESPParent2 then
											mainFunction22(createPlayerESPCharacter, createPlayerESPState19)
										end
									end)

									mainActions.UpdatePlayerESP(createPlayerESPCharacter)
								end

								mainObj2[createPlayerESPParameter] = createPlayerESPFunction24
								mainObj[createPlayerESPParameter] = createPlayerESPParameter.CharacterAdded:Connect(createPlayerESPFunction24)
								task.spawn(createPlayerESPFunction24, createPlayerESPParameter.Character)
							end
						end
					end

					local mainFunction23, mainFunction24

					do
						mainFunction23 = function(mainParameter2, mainSecondValue)
							mainState17[mainSecondValue] = nil
							if mainParameter2 and mainParameter2.Parent and mainSecondValue and mainSecondValue.OriginalLocalTransparencyModifier ~= nil then
								pcall(function()
									mainParameter2.LocalTransparencyModifier = mainSecondValue.OriginalLocalTransparencyModifier
								end)
							end
							mainFunction21(mainState16.PCLDs, mainParameter2, mainSecondValue)

							if mainActions.SetSmoothPCLDConnection then
								mainActions.SetSmoothPCLDConnection()
							end
						end

						mainActions.UpdatePCLDESP = function(updatePCLDESPParameter)
							local updatePCLDESPValue23 = mainState16.PCLDs[updatePCLDESPParameter]
							local updatePCLDESPServer = mainEspConfig.Server
							if not updatePCLDESPValue23 then
								return
							end

							if espIsFadingOut.Server then
								return
							end

							if not (updatePCLDESPParameter.Parent and updatePCLDESPValue23.Clone.Parent and updatePCLDESPValue23.Box.Parent and updatePCLDESPValue23.Billboard.Parent) then
								return mainFunction23(updatePCLDESPParameter, updatePCLDESPValue23)
							end
							local updatePCLDESPValue24 = mainActions.IsWaitingPCLD(updatePCLDESPParameter)
							updatePCLDESPValue23.Waiting = updatePCLDESPValue24
							-- Only the detector currently selected by the tracker for its player is visible.
							-- Other detector parts can briefly exist during respawn/streaming and must not
							-- create a second visible PCLD for the same character.
							local updatePCLDESPTrackerState = mainRuntimeData.PCLDTracker.PartStates[updatePCLDESPParameter]
							local updatePCLDESPPlayer = updatePCLDESPTrackerState and updatePCLDESPTrackerState.Player
							local updatePCLDESPIsAssigned = updatePCLDESPPlayer and mainRuntimeData.PCLD[updatePCLDESPPlayer] == updatePCLDESPParameter
							updatePCLDESPValue23.Box.Color3 = updatePCLDESPServer.OutlineColor
							updatePCLDESPValue23.Box.SurfaceColor3 = updatePCLDESPServer.FillColor
							updatePCLDESPValue23.Box.Transparency = updatePCLDESPServer.OutlineTransparency
							updatePCLDESPValue23.Box.SurfaceTransparency = updatePCLDESPServer.FillTransparency
							updatePCLDESPValue23.Box.LineThickness = updatePCLDESPServer.OutlineThickness
							local pcldStyle = mainFeatureSettings.PCLDStyle or "Neon"
							local pcldMaterials = { Neon = Enum.Material.Neon, Glass = Enum.Material.Glass, Brick = Enum.Material.Brick, Holographic = Enum.Material.ForceField, Crystal = Enum.Material.Ice }
							updatePCLDESPValue23.Clone.Material = pcldMaterials[pcldStyle] or Enum.Material.Neon
							updatePCLDESPValue23.Clone.Color = updatePCLDESPServer.FillColor
							local pcldVisible = mainFeatureFlags.PCLDESP and not updatePCLDESPValue24 and updatePCLDESPIsAssigned == true
							-- Render only the SmoothPCLD visual. Keep the original detector's local visibility
							-- value so disabling ESP or losing assignment restores the original appearance.
							if updatePCLDESPValue23.OriginalLocalTransparencyModifier == nil then
								updatePCLDESPValue23.OriginalLocalTransparencyModifier = updatePCLDESPParameter.LocalTransparencyModifier
							end
							updatePCLDESPParameter.LocalTransparencyModifier = pcldVisible and 1 or updatePCLDESPValue23.OriginalLocalTransparencyModifier
							updatePCLDESPValue23.Clone.Transparency = pcldVisible and ((pcldStyle == "Glass" and 0.45) or (pcldStyle == "Brick" and 0.2) or (pcldStyle == "Crystal" and 0.3) or (pcldStyle == "Holographic" and 0.35) or 0.18) or 1
							updatePCLDESPValue23.Box.Visible = pcldVisible
							local updatePCLDESPValue = updatePCLDESPPlayer and select(2, mainActions.Char(updatePCLDESPPlayer))
							updatePCLDESPValue = updatePCLDESPValue and updatePCLDESPValue.Position - updatePCLDESPParameter.Position
							local updatePCLDESPFlag12 = updatePCLDESPServer.NameEnabled and mainFeatureFlags.PCLDESP and not updatePCLDESPValue24 and updatePCLDESPValue and updatePCLDESPValue:Dot(updatePCLDESPValue) >= updatePCLDESPServer.NameDistance * updatePCLDESPServer.NameDistance
							updatePCLDESPValue23.Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, updatePCLDESPServer.NameYOffset, 0)
							updatePCLDESPValue23.Billboard.Enabled = updatePCLDESPFlag12 == true
							if not updatePCLDESPFlag12 then
								return
							end

							if updatePCLDESPValue23.CachedPlayer ~= updatePCLDESPPlayer then
								updatePCLDESPValue23.CachedPlayer = updatePCLDESPPlayer
								updatePCLDESPValue23.CachedName = mainActions.FormatPlayer(updatePCLDESPPlayer, true, true)
							end

							updatePCLDESPValue23.NameLabel.Text = updatePCLDESPValue23.CachedName
							updatePCLDESPValue23.NameLabel.TextSize = updatePCLDESPServer.NameSize
							updatePCLDESPValue23.NameLabel.TextColor3 = updatePCLDESPServer.NameColor
							updatePCLDESPValue23.NameLabel.TextTransparency = updatePCLDESPServer.NameTransparency
							updatePCLDESPValue23.NameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = updatePCLDESPServer.NameOutlineColor
							updatePCLDESPValue23.NameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = updatePCLDESPServer.NameOutlineTransparency
							updatePCLDESPValue23.NameLabel.FontFace = mainActions.GetFont(updatePCLDESPServer.NameFont)
						end

						mainActions.CreatePCLDESP = function(createPCLDESPParameter)
							if not createPCLDESPParameter or not createPCLDESPParameter.Parent or createPCLDESPParameter.Name ~= "PlayerCharacterLocationDetector" or mainActions.IsWaitingPCLD(createPCLDESPParameter) then
								return
							end
							mainRuntimeData.PCLDParts[createPCLDESPParameter] = true

							-- A previous state is reusable only while every visual instance is still alive.
							local previousPCLDState = mainState16.PCLDs[createPCLDESPParameter]
							if previousPCLDState then
								if previousPCLDState.Clone and previousPCLDState.Clone.Parent
									and previousPCLDState.Box and previousPCLDState.Box.Parent
									and previousPCLDState.Billboard and previousPCLDState.Billboard.Parent then
									return
								end
								mainFunction23(createPCLDESPParameter, previousPCLDState)
							end

							-- Remove stale clones left by earlier versions. Those versions added the
							-- ObjectValue BEFORE ClearAllChildren(), which immediately deleted the link.
							-- Therefore an unlinked SmoothPCLD is an orphan, not a usable tracked clone.
							local createPCLDESPParent = createPCLDESPParameter.Parent
							for _, existingPCLDClone in ipairs(createPCLDESPParent:GetChildren()) do
								if existingPCLDClone ~= createPCLDESPParameter and existingPCLDClone.Name == "SmoothPCLD" then
									local sourceLink = existingPCLDClone:FindFirstChild("OwnerSigmaSourcePCLD")
									local hasValidSourceLink = sourceLink and sourceLink:IsA("ObjectValue") and sourceLink.Value ~= nil
									local cloneIsTracked = false
									for trackedSource, trackedState in pairs(mainState16.PCLDs) do
										if trackedState.Clone == existingPCLDClone and trackedSource.Parent then
											cloneIsTracked = true
											break
										end
									end
									local linkTargetsThisSource = hasValidSourceLink and sourceLink.Value == createPCLDESPParameter
									local linkMatchesTrackedSource = false
									if cloneIsTracked and hasValidSourceLink then
										local trackedSourceState = mainState16.PCLDs[sourceLink.Value]
										linkMatchesTrackedSource = trackedSourceState ~= nil and trackedSourceState.Clone == existingPCLDClone
									end
									-- Remove unlinked, stale, or mis-linked clones; preserve only a clone whose live state
									-- explicitly points back to this exact clone and source.
									if linkTargetsThisSource or not linkMatchesTrackedSource then
										existingPCLDClone:Destroy()
									end
								end
							end

							local createPCLDESPClone = createPCLDESPParameter:Clone()
							createPCLDESPClone:ClearAllChildren()
							createPCLDESPClone.Name = "SmoothPCLD"
							createPCLDESPClone.CFrame = createPCLDESPParameter.CFrame
							createPCLDESPClone.Anchored = true
							createPCLDESPClone.CanCollide = false
							createPCLDESPClone.CanTouch = false
							createPCLDESPClone.CanQuery = false
							createPCLDESPClone.CastShadow = false
							createPCLDESPClone.Transparency = 1
							-- Add the source reference only AFTER ClearAllChildren(), otherwise it is erased.
							local sourceLink = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
							sourceLink.Name = "OwnerSigmaSourcePCLD"
							sourceLink.Value = createPCLDESPParameter
							sourceLink.Parent = createPCLDESPClone
							createPCLDESPClone.Parent = createPCLDESPParent
							local createPCLDESPClone2 = mainSelectionBox:Clone()
							createPCLDESPClone2.Adornee = createPCLDESPClone
							createPCLDESPClone2.Visible = not mainActions.IsWaitingPCLD(createPCLDESPParameter)
							createPCLDESPClone2.Parent = createPCLDESPClone
							local createPCLDESPBillboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
							createPCLDESPBillboardGui.Enabled = false
							createPCLDESPBillboardGui.Adornee = createPCLDESPClone
							createPCLDESPBillboardGui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 150)
							createPCLDESPBillboardGui.SizeOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
							createPCLDESPBillboardGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
							createPCLDESPBillboardGui.Parent = mainScreenGui
							local createPCLDESPTextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
							createPCLDESPTextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
							createPCLDESPTextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
							createPCLDESPTextLabel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
							createPCLDESPTextLabel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
							createPCLDESPTextLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
							createPCLDESPTextLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
							createPCLDESPTextLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
							createPCLDESPTextLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
							createPCLDESPTextLabel.Parent = createPCLDESPBillboardGui
							local createPCLDESPNow3 = tick()

							local createPCLDESPState18 = {
								Part = createPCLDESPParameter,
								Clone = createPCLDESPClone,
								Box = createPCLDESPClone2,
								Billboard = createPCLDESPBillboardGui,
								NameLabel = createPCLDESPTextLabel,
								From = createPCLDESPClone.CFrame,
								Target = createPCLDESPParameter.CFrame,
								StartedAt = createPCLDESPNow3,
								LastUpdate = createPCLDESPNow3,
								Duration = 0.32,
								Waiting = false,
								Moving = false,
								OriginalLocalTransparencyModifier = createPCLDESPParameter.LocalTransparencyModifier,
								Connections = {},
								Instances = { createPCLDESPBillboardGui, createPCLDESPClone },
							}

							mainState16.PCLDs[createPCLDESPParameter] = createPCLDESPState18

							createPCLDESPState18.Connections[1] = createPCLDESPParameter:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
								if mainUnloaded or not createPCLDESPClone.Parent then
									return
								end
								local createPCLDESPValue23 = mainActions.IsWaitingPCLD(createPCLDESPParameter)
								createPCLDESPState18.Waiting = createPCLDESPValue23

								if createPCLDESPValue23 then
									createPCLDESPState18.Moving = false
									mainState17[createPCLDESPState18] = nil
								else
									if not mainFeatureFlags.PCLDESP then
										mainActions.UpdatePCLDESP(createPCLDESPParameter)
										return
									end

									if not mainFeatureFlags.SmoothPCLD then
										local createPCLDESPCFrame2 = createPCLDESPParameter.CFrame
										createPCLDESPState18.Moving = false
										mainState17[createPCLDESPState18] = nil
										createPCLDESPClone.CFrame = createPCLDESPCFrame2
										createPCLDESPState18.From = createPCLDESPCFrame2
										createPCLDESPState18.Target = createPCLDESPCFrame2
										createPCLDESPState18.LastUpdate = tick()
									elseif createPCLDESPParameter.CFrame ~= createPCLDESPState18.Target then
										local createPCLDESPNow4 = tick()
										local createPCLDESPNumber36 = createPCLDESPNow4 - createPCLDESPState18.LastUpdate
										createPCLDESPState18.From = createPCLDESPClone.CFrame
										createPCLDESPState18.Target = createPCLDESPParameter.CFrame
										createPCLDESPState18.StartedAt = createPCLDESPNow4
										createPCLDESPState18.LastUpdate = createPCLDESPNow4
										createPCLDESPState18.Duration = math.clamp(createPCLDESPNumber36 * 1.05, 0.08, 0.5)
										createPCLDESPState18.Moving = true
										mainState17[createPCLDESPState18] = true
										mainActions.SetSmoothPCLDConnection()
									end
								end

								mainActions.UpdatePCLDESP(createPCLDESPParameter)
							end)

						mainActions.RefreshESP = function(refreshESPParameter)
							task.spawn(function()
								if refreshESPParameter == "Player" then
									for _refreshESPUnused1, refreshESPValue23 in ipairs(mainRuntimeData.PlayerList) do
										if refreshESPValue23 ~= mainLocalPlayer then
											mainActions.CreatePlayerESP(refreshESPValue23)
										end
									end
								elseif refreshESPParameter == "Server" then
									for refreshESPKey in pairs(mainRuntimeData.PCLDParts) do
										if not refreshESPKey.Parent or refreshESPKey.Name ~= "PlayerCharacterLocationDetector" then
											mainRuntimeData.PCLDParts[refreshESPKey] = nil
										elseif not mainActions.IsWaitingPCLD(refreshESPKey) then
											mainActions.CreatePCLDESP(refreshESPKey)
										end
									end
								elseif refreshESPParameter == "Sticky" then
									for _refreshESPUnused2, refreshESPValue23 in ipairs(workspace:QueryDescendants("BasePart#StickyPart")) do
										if refreshESPValue23.Parent then
											mainActions.CreateStickyESP(refreshESPValue23.Parent)
										end
									end
								end

								mainActions.UpdateESP(refreshESPParameter)
							end)
						end

						mainActions.UpdateESP = function(updateESPParameter)
							if espIsFadingOut[updateESPParameter] then
								return
							end
							local updateESPValue23 = mainEspConfig[updateESPParameter]
							if not updateESPValue23 then
								return
							end

							for updateESPKey in pairs(updateESPValue23.Objects) do
								if updateESPParameter == "Player" then
									mainActions.UpdatePlayerESP(updateESPKey)
								elseif updateESPParameter == "Server" then
									mainActions.UpdatePCLDESP(updateESPKey)
								elseif updateESPParameter == "Sticky" then
									mainActions.UpdateStickyESP(updateESPKey)
								elseif updateESPParameter == "Blackhole" then
									mainActions.UpdateBlackHoleESP(updateESPKey)
								end
							end
						end

						local function calcTrans(target, factor)
							return 1 - (1 - (target or 0)) * factor
						end

						local function applyCategoryFade(category, factor)
							if category == "Player" then
								local cfg = mainEspConfig.Player
								for _, entry in pairs(mainState16.Players) do
									if entry.Highlight and entry.Highlight.Parent then
										entry.Highlight.Enabled = cfg.HighlightEnabled
										entry.Highlight.FillTransparency = calcTrans(cfg.FillTransparency, factor)
										entry.Highlight.OutlineTransparency = calcTrans(cfg.OutlineTransparency, factor)
									end
									if entry.Billboard and entry.Billboard.Parent then
										entry.Billboard.Enabled = cfg.NameEnabled
										if entry.Label and entry.Label.Parent then
											entry.Label.TextTransparency = calcTrans(cfg.NameTransparency, factor)
											entry.Label.TextStrokeTransparency = calcTrans(cfg.NameOutlineTransparency, factor)
										end
										if entry.Icon and entry.Icon.Parent then
											entry.Icon.Visible = cfg.NameShowIcon and entry.Thumbnail ~= nil
											entry.Icon.ImageTransparency = calcTrans(0, factor)
										end
									end
								end
							elseif category == "Server" then
								local cfg = mainEspConfig.Server
								for part, entry in pairs(mainState16.PCLDs) do
									if not entry.Waiting and entry.Clone and entry.Clone.Parent then
										if entry.Box and entry.Box.Parent then
											entry.Box.Visible = true
											entry.Box.Transparency = calcTrans(cfg.OutlineTransparency, factor)
											entry.Box.SurfaceTransparency = calcTrans(cfg.FillTransparency, factor)
										end
										if entry.Billboard and entry.Billboard.Parent then
											local playerState = mainRuntimeData.PCLDTracker.PartStates[part]
											local plr = playerState and playerState.Player
											local charCFrame = plr and select(2, mainActions.Char(plr))
											local offset = charCFrame and (charCFrame.Position - part.Position)
											local distOk = offset and (offset:Dot(offset) >= cfg.NameDistance * cfg.NameDistance)
											entry.Billboard.Enabled = (cfg.NameEnabled and distOk) == true
											if entry.NameLabel and entry.NameLabel.Parent then
												entry.NameLabel.TextTransparency = calcTrans(cfg.NameTransparency, factor)
												entry.NameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = calcTrans(cfg.NameOutlineTransparency, factor)
											end
										end
									end
								end
							elseif category == "Sticky" then
								local cfg = mainEspConfig.Sticky
								for _, entry in pairs(mainState16.Stickies) do
									for _, adornments in pairs(entry.Parts) do
										local lines = adornments[1]
										local box = adornments[2]
										if lines then
											local lineVisible = cfg.OutlineTransparency < 1
											local lineTrans = calcTrans(cfg.OutlineTransparency, factor)
											for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
												line.Visible = lineVisible
												line.Transparency = lineTrans
											end
										end
										if box then
											box.Visible = cfg.FillTransparency < 1
											box.Transparency = calcTrans(cfg.FillTransparency, factor)
										end
									end
								end
							elseif category == "Blackhole" then
								local cfg = mainEspConfig.Blackhole
								for _, entry in pairs(mainState16.BlackHoles) do
									if entry.Highlight and entry.Highlight.Parent then
										entry.Highlight.Enabled = true
										entry.Highlight.FillTransparency = calcTrans(cfg.FillTransparency, factor)
										entry.Highlight.OutlineTransparency = calcTrans(cfg.OutlineTransparency, factor)
									end
									if entry.Billboard and entry.Billboard.Parent then
										entry.Billboard.Enabled = cfg.NameEnabled
										if entry.Label and entry.Label.Parent then
											entry.Label.TextTransparency = calcTrans(cfg.NameTransparency, factor)
											entry.Label.TextStrokeTransparency = calcTrans(cfg.NameOutlineTransparency, factor)
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end

						mainActions.AnimateESP = function(category, isEnabled)
							local currentToken = (espAnimTokens[category] or 0) + 1
							espAnimTokens[category] = currentToken

							if isEnabled then
								espIsFadingOut[category] = false

								if category == "Player" then
									mainFeatureFlags.PlayerESP = true
									mainActions.UpdateESP("Player")
									mainActions.RefreshESP("Player")
								elseif category == "Server" then
									mainActions.SetRuntimeToggle("PCLDESP", true)
									mainActions.WakeRuntimeGate("PCLDTracking")
									mainActions.SetSmoothPCLDConnection()
									mainActions.UpdateESP("Server")
									mainActions.RefreshESP("Server")
									task.defer(mainActions.SnapPCLDESP)
								elseif category == "Sticky" then
									mainFeatureFlags.StickyESP = true
									mainActions.UpdateESP("Sticky")
									mainActions.RefreshESP("Sticky")
									task.spawn(function()
										while not mainUnloaded and mainFeatureFlags.StickyESP and espAnimTokens.Sticky == currentToken do
											task.wait(0.75)
											if mainFeatureFlags.StickyESP and espAnimTokens.Sticky == currentToken then
												pcall(function() mainActions.RefreshESP("Sticky") end)
											end
										end
									end)
								elseif category == "Blackhole" then
									mainFeatureFlags.BlackholeESP = true
									mainActions.UpdateESP("Blackhole")
								end

								task.spawn(function()
									local startTime = os.clock()
									local duration = 0.1
									while true do
										if espAnimTokens[category] ~= currentToken or espIsFadingOut[category] then
											break
										end
										local elapsed = os.clock() - startTime
										local progress = math.clamp(elapsed / duration, 0, 1)
										local factor = progress * (2 - progress)

										applyCategoryFade(category, factor)

										if progress >= 1 then
											break
										end
										mainRunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
									end
									if espAnimTokens[category] == currentToken and not espIsFadingOut[category] then
										mainActions.UpdateESP(category)
									end
								end)
							else
								espIsFadingOut[category] = true

								task.spawn(function()
									local startTime = os.clock()
									local duration = 0.1
									while true do
										if espAnimTokens[category] ~= currentToken then
											break
										end
										local elapsed = os.clock() - startTime
										local progress = math.clamp(elapsed / duration, 0, 1)
										local factor = 1 - (progress * (2 - progress))

										applyCategoryFade(category, factor)

										if progress >= 1 then
											break
										end
										mainRunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
									end
									if espAnimTokens[category] == currentToken then
										espIsFadingOut[category] = false
										if category == "Player" then
											mainFeatureFlags.PlayerESP = false
											mainActions.UpdateESP("Player")
										elseif category == "Server" then
											mainActions.SetRuntimeToggle("PCLDESP", false)
											mainActions.SetSmoothPCLDConnection()
											mainActions.UpdateESP("Server")
										elseif category == "Sticky" then
											mainFeatureFlags.StickyESP = false
											mainActions.UpdateESP("Sticky")
										elseif category == "Blackhole" then
											mainFeatureFlags.BlackholeESP = false
											mainActions.UpdateESP("Blackhole")
										end
									end
								end)
							end
						end

						mainActions.UpdateSmoothPCLD = function()
							local updateSmoothPCLDNow3 = tick()

							for updateSmoothPCLDKey in pairs(mainState17) do
								if updateSmoothPCLDKey.Moving and updateSmoothPCLDKey.Part.Parent and updateSmoothPCLDKey.Clone.Parent then
									local updateSmoothPCLDNumber36 = math.clamp((updateSmoothPCLDNow3 - updateSmoothPCLDKey.StartedAt) / updateSmoothPCLDKey.Duration, 0, 1)
									updateSmoothPCLDKey.Clone.CFrame = updateSmoothPCLDKey.From:Lerp(updateSmoothPCLDKey.Target, updateSmoothPCLDNumber36)

									if updateSmoothPCLDNumber36 >= 1 then
										updateSmoothPCLDKey.Moving = false
										mainState17[updateSmoothPCLDKey] = nil
									end
								else
									mainState17[updateSmoothPCLDKey] = nil
								end
							end

							if not next(mainState17) then
								mainActions.SetSmoothPCLDConnection()
							end

									spawnCoconutFormsHoldPart = spawnCoconutFormsHoldPart and spawnCoconutFormsHoldPart:WaitForChild("RigidConstraint", 0.5)

									if not (spawnCoconutFormsSoundPart and spawnCoconutFormsHoldPart and mainActions.BreakHoldable(spawnCoconutFormsFoodCoconut) and mainActions.SNO(spawnCoconutFormsSoundPart, 0.4)) then
										mainActions.DestroyToy(spawnCoconutFormsFoodCoconut)
										break

										for _spawnCoconutFormsUnused1, spawnCoconutFormsValue22 in spawnCoconutFormsFoodCoconut:QueryDescendants("BasePart") do

											spawnCoconutFormsValue22.CanQuery = false

										end

											spawnCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Parts[spawnCoconutFormsFoodCoconut] = { Root = spawnCoconutFormsSoundPart, Rigid = spawnCoconutFormsHoldPart }

										else
											mainActions.DestroyToy(spawnCoconutFormsFoodCoconut)
										end

										continue
									end
								end

								break
							end

							spawnCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Spawning = false

							if mainFeatureFlags.CoconutForms and #spawnCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Models < #spawnCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Offsets then
								task.delay(0.5, mainActions.SpawnCoconutForms)

						end)
					end

					mainActions.RefreshCoconutForms = function()
						local refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms = mainRuntimeData.CoconutForms
						local refreshCoconutFormsSelected = mainRuntimeData.CoconutForms.Selected
						local refreshCoconutFormsOffsets = {}
						local refreshCoconutFormsCounts = refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Counts
						local refreshCoconutFormsCape

						if refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.CapeMode == "2x3" then
							refreshCoconutFormsCape = 6
						else
							refreshCoconutFormsCape = 12
						end

						refreshCoconutFormsCounts.Cape = refreshCoconutFormsCape
						refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.WingStart = nil
						refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.CapeStart = nil

						for _refreshCoconutFormsUnused1, refreshCoconutFormsValue22 in refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Order, nil, nil do
							if refreshCoconutFormsSelected[refreshCoconutFormsValue22] and #refreshCoconutFormsOffsets + refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Counts[refreshCoconutFormsValue22] <= refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Limit then
								if refreshCoconutFormsValue22 == "Boobs" then
									local refreshCoconutFormsNumber37 = #refreshCoconutFormsOffsets + 1
									local refreshCoconutFormsNumber38 = #refreshCoconutFormsOffsets + 2
									local refreshCoconutFormsCframe = CFrame.new(-0.6, 0.5, -0.9)
									local refreshCoconutFormsCframe2 = CFrame.new(0.6, 0.5, -0.9)
									refreshCoconutFormsOffsets[refreshCoconutFormsNumber37] = refreshCoconutFormsCframe
									refreshCoconutFormsOffsets[refreshCoconutFormsNumber38] = refreshCoconutFormsCframe2
								elseif refreshCoconutFormsValue22 == "Ass" then
									local refreshCoconutFormsNumber37 = #refreshCoconutFormsOffsets + 1
									local refreshCoconutFormsNumber38 = #refreshCoconutFormsOffsets + 2
									local refreshCoconutFormsCframe = CFrame.new(-0.55, -1, 0.75)
									local refreshCoconutFormsCframe2 = CFrame.new(0.55, -1, 0.75)
									refreshCoconutFormsOffsets[refreshCoconutFormsNumber37] = refreshCoconutFormsCframe
									refreshCoconutFormsOffsets[refreshCoconutFormsNumber38] = refreshCoconutFormsCframe2
								elseif refreshCoconutFormsValue22 == "Penis" then
									local refreshCoconutFormsNumber37 = #refreshCoconutFormsOffsets + 1
									local refreshCoconutFormsNumber38 = #refreshCoconutFormsOffsets + 2
									local refreshCoconutFormsCframe = CFrame.new(-0.55, -1.2, -0.8)
									local refreshCoconutFormsCframe2 = CFrame.new(0.55, -1.2, -0.8)
									refreshCoconutFormsOffsets[refreshCoconutFormsNumber37] = refreshCoconutFormsCframe
									refreshCoconutFormsOffsets[refreshCoconutFormsNumber38] = refreshCoconutFormsCframe2

									for refreshCoconutFormsIndex = 1, refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.ShaftLength do
										refreshCoconutFormsOffsets[#refreshCoconutFormsOffsets + 1] = CFrame.new(0, -1.2, -0.8 - refreshCoconutFormsIndex * refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.ShaftSpacing)
									end
								elseif refreshCoconutFormsValue22 == "Wings" then
									refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.WingStart = #refreshCoconutFormsOffsets + 1

									for refreshCoconutFormsIndex = 1, 12 do
										refreshCoconutFormsOffsets[#refreshCoconutFormsOffsets + 1] = CFrame.identity
									end
								elseif refreshCoconutFormsValue22 == "Cape" then
									refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.CapeStart = #refreshCoconutFormsOffsets + 1
									local refreshCoconutFormsNumber37 = refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Counts.Cape / 3

									for refreshCoconutFormsIndex = 0, refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Counts.Cape - 1 do
										local refreshCoconutFormsNumber38 = refreshCoconutFormsIndex % refreshCoconutFormsNumber37 - (refreshCoconutFormsNumber37 - 1) / 2
										local refreshCoconutFormsNumber39 = #refreshCoconutFormsOffsets + 1
										local refreshCoconutFormsNumber40

										if refreshCoconutFormsIndex < refreshCoconutFormsNumber37 then
											refreshCoconutFormsNumber40 = CFrame.new(refreshCoconutFormsNumber38 * 1.3, 0.55, 0.55) * CFrame.Angles(0.1, 0, 0)
										else
											refreshCoconutFormsNumber40 = CFrame.identity
										end

										refreshCoconutFormsOffsets[refreshCoconutFormsNumber39] = refreshCoconutFormsNumber40
									end
								elseif refreshCoconutFormsValue22 == "67" then
									local refreshCoconutFormsNumber37

									if refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Display67 == "Show to Front" then
										refreshCoconutFormsNumber37 = -1
									else
										refreshCoconutFormsNumber37 = 1
									end

									for refreshCoconutFormsKey, refreshCoconutFormsValue23 in refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Points67, nil, nil do
										local refreshCoconutFormsNumber38

										if refreshCoconutFormsKey <= 7 then
											refreshCoconutFormsNumber38 = -1
										else
											refreshCoconutFormsNumber38 = 1
										end

										refreshCoconutFormsOffsets[#refreshCoconutFormsOffsets + 1] = CFrame.new((refreshCoconutFormsValue23.X + refreshCoconutFormsNumber38 * refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Spacing67 * 0.5) * refreshCoconutFormsNumber37, refreshCoconutFormsValue23.Y, 0.75)
									end
								end
							end
						end

						if not refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.CapeStart then
							refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.CapeSpeed = 0
							refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.CapeWind = Vector3.zero
						end

						local refreshCoconutFormsGeneration = refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Generation + 1
						refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Offsets = refreshCoconutFormsOffsets
						refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Generation = refreshCoconutFormsGeneration
						local refreshCoconutFormsState17 = {}

						for _refreshCoconutFormsUnused2, refreshCoconutFormsValue22 in refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Names, nil, nil do
							if not refreshCoconutFormsSelected[refreshCoconutFormsValue22] and #refreshCoconutFormsOffsets + refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Counts[refreshCoconutFormsValue22] > refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Limit then
								refreshCoconutFormsState17[#refreshCoconutFormsState17 + 1] = refreshCoconutFormsValue22
							end
						end

						if mainUiOptions.CoconutFormsDropdown then
							mainUiOptions.CoconutFormsDropdown:SetDisabledValues(refreshCoconutFormsState17)
						end

						if mainUiLibrary.Labels.CoconutFormsLimit then
							local refreshCoconutFormsCoconutFormsLimit = mainUiLibrary.Labels.CoconutFormsLimit
							local refreshCoconutFormsSetText = refreshCoconutFormsCoconutFormsLimit.SetText
							local refreshCoconutFormsText5 = ("%*/%* coconuts used"):format(#refreshCoconutFormsOffsets, refreshCoconutFormsCoconutForms.Limit)

								if not microwaveRscMicrowave then
									return
								end

								local microwavePrimaryPart = microwaveRscMicrowave.PrimaryPart
								if not (microwaveButton and microwavePrimaryPart) then
									return mainActions.DestroyToy(microwaveRscMicrowave)
								end

								if not mainActions.SNO(microwaveValue28) then
									return mainActions.DestroyToy(microwaveRscMicrowave)
								end

									task.wait(0.15)
									mainActions.Grab(microwaveButton)
									task.wait(0.15)
								end

									for _microwaveUnused1, microwaveValue29 in microwaveRscMicrowave:GetChildren() do

											microwaveValue29.CanTouch = true
											microwaveValue29.CanQuery = true
											microwaveValue29.Transparency = 1
										end
									end

									microwaveRscMicrowave.Name = "RSCMicrowave"
								end

								local microwaveNow3 = tick()

								while tick() - microwaveNow3 <= 0.1 do
									mainActions.Teleport(microwavePrimaryPart, microwaveValue26)
									mainRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
								end
							end
						end

						mainActions.Campfire = function(campfireParameter)
							local campfireValue22, campfireValue23, campfireValue24 = mainActions.Char()
							local campfireValue25, campfireValue26, campfireValue27 = mainActions.Char(campfireParameter)

									mainRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

								local clearFlingValue23 = mainFlingState
								mainFlingState.Toy = nil

								clearFlingValue23.ActiveMethod = nil

							mainActions.Fling = function(flingParameter)
								if mainFlingState.Busy then
									return
								end
								mainFlingState.Busy = true

								local flingSucceeded, flingResult = pcall(function()
									local flingValue22, flingValue23, flingValue24 = mainActions.Char()
									local flingValue25, flingValue26, flingValue27 = mainActions.Char(flingParameter)
									if not (flingValue23 and flingValue24 and flingValue24.Health > 0 and flingValue26 and flingValue27 and flingValue27.Health > 0 and mainActions.GetMagnitude(flingValue26, workspace.SpawnLocation) < 3000) then
										return
									end
									local flingMethod = mainFlingState.Method
									local flingToy = mainFlingState.Toy
									local flingPart4 = mainFlingState.Part

									if not (flingToy and flingToy.Parent and flingPart4 and flingPart4.Parent and mainFlingState.ActiveMethod == flingMethod) then
										mainActions.ClearFling()
										flingToy = mainActions.SpawnToy(flingMethod, nil, 1)
										local flingValue28

										if flingToy then
											local flingValue29 = flingToy
											local flingWaitForChild = flingValue29.WaitForChild
											local flingText5

											if flingMethod == "YouDecoy" then
												flingText5 = "HumanoidRootPart"
											else
												flingText5 = "Main"
											end

											flingValue28 = flingWaitForChild(flingValue29, flingText5, 0.5)
										else
											flingValue28 = flingToy
										end

										if flingToy then
											local flingValue29 = flingToy
											local flingWaitForChild = flingValue29.WaitForChild
											local flingText5

											if flingMethod == "YouDecoy" then
												flingText5 = "HumanoidRootPart"
											else
												flingText5 = "SoundPart"
											end

											flingPart4 = flingWaitForChild(flingValue29, flingText5, 0.5)
										else
											flingPart4 = flingToy
										end

										if not (flingValue28 and flingPart4 and mainActions.SNO(flingPart4)) or mainFlingState.Method ~= flingMethod or mainUnloaded then
											mainActions.DestroyToy(flingToy)
											return
										end
										local flingValue29 = mainFlingState
										local flingValue30 = mainFlingState
										mainFlingState.Toy = flingToy
										flingValue29.Part = flingPart4
										flingValue30.ActiveMethod = flingMethod
									elseif not mainActions.IsPartOwner(flingPart4) and not mainActions.SNO(flingPart4, 0.35) then
										mainActions.ClearFling()
										return
									end

									local flingNow3 = os.clock()
									local flingBasePart = flingToy:QueryDescendants("BasePart")
									local flingState17 = {}
									local flingNumber37 = 1

									while true do
										local flingFlag12 = mainUnloaded or mainFlingState.Toy ~= flingToy or mainFlingState.Method ~= flingMethod

										if not flingFlag12 then
											flingFlag12 = not (flingToy.Parent and flingValue26.Parent and flingValue27.Health > 0)
										end

										if not flingFlag12 then
											flingNumber37 = -flingNumber37
											mainActions.PivotTo(flingToy, mainActions.PredictCFrame(flingValue26) * CFrame.new(flingNumber37 * 0.75, 0, 0), flingBasePart, flingState17)
											flingPart4.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(flingNumber37 * 250, 120, -flingNumber37 * 250)
											flingPart4.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(flingNumber37 * 1500, 1500, -flingNumber37 * 1500)
											mainRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
											if not (os.clock() - flingNow3 >= 0.2) then
												continue
											end
										end

										break
									end

									if mainFlingState.Toy == flingToy and flingToy.Parent and flingPart4.Parent then
										mainActions.ResetVelocity(flingPart4)
										mainActions.PivotTo(flingToy, CFrame.new(0, 100000, 0), flingBasePart, flingState17)
									end

									return true
								end)

								mainFlingState.Busy = false

								if not flingSucceeded then
									error(flingResult, 0)
								end

								return flingResult
							end
						end
					end

												mainNotificationDefinitions.CharacterParts[setRuntimeConnectionParameter] = true

										end)

										end
									end

								end

								if not addCandidateParameter:IsA("Model") then

									addCandidateParameter = addCandidateParameter.Parent

							mainNotificationDefinitions.UntrackInventory = function(untrackInventoryParameter)

								for _untrackInventoryUnused1, untrackInventoryValue23 in ipairs(untrackInventoryValue22) do

								end

										mainRuntimeData.ToyAuraRoots[untrackInventoryKey] = nil
									end
								end

								end

											mainRuntimeData.ToyAuraRoots[trackInventoryDescendant] = nil
										end

									for trackInventoryIndex, trackInventoryDescendant in ipairs(trackInventoryParameter:GetDescendants()) do

											return
										end
										mainNotificationDefinitions.AddCandidate(trackInventoryDescendant, trackInventoryParameter)

										if trackInventoryIndex % 100 == 0 then
											task.wait()
										end
									end
								end)

								local setCollisionsValue22 = mainNotificationDefinitions.Movers[setCollisionsParameter]
								if not setCollisionsValue22 then
									return
								end

								if setCollisionsCanCollide == nil then
									for setCollisionsKey, setCollisionsValue23 in setCollisionsValue22.Parts, nil, nil do
										if setCollisionsKey.Parent then
											setCollisionsKey.CanCollide = setCollisionsValue23
										end
									end

									table.clear(setCollisionsValue22.Parts)
									return

									if setCollisionsValue22.Parts[setCollisionsValue23] == nil then
										setCollisionsValue22.Parts[setCollisionsValue23] = setCollisionsValue23.CanCollide
									end

									setCollisionsValue23.CanCollide = setCollisionsCanCollide
								end

								if setCollisionsParameter:IsA("BasePart") then
									if setCollisionsValue22.Parts[setCollisionsParameter] == nil then
										setCollisionsValue22.Parts[setCollisionsParameter] = setCollisionsParameter.CanCollide
									end

									setCollisionsParameter.CanCollide = setCollisionsCanCollide
								end
							end

							mainNotificationDefinitions.ClearMovers = function(clearMoversParameter)
								if not clearMoversParameter then
									for clearMoversKey in mainNotificationDefinitions.Movers, nil, nil do

									return
								end

								local clearMoversValue22 = mainNotificationDefinitions.Movers[clearMoversParameter]
								if not clearMoversValue22 then
									return
								end
								mainNotificationDefinitions.SetCollisions(clearMoversParameter, nil)
								clearMoversValue22.Position:Destroy()
								clearMoversValue22.Orientation:Destroy()
								clearMoversValue22.Attachment:Destroy()
								mainNotificationDefinitions.Movers[clearMoversParameter] = nil

							mainNotificationDefinitions.EnsureMovers = function(ensureMoversParameter, ensureMoversSecondValue)
								if mainRuntimeData.ObjectStates[ensureMoversParameter] then
									return
								end
								local ensureMoversValue22 = ensureMoversSecondValue or mainNotificationDefinitions.GetRoot(ensureMoversParameter)
								if not ensureMoversValue22 or ensureMoversValue22.Anchored then
									return
								end
								local ensureMoversState17 = mainNotificationDefinitions.Movers[ensureMoversParameter]
								local ensureMoversFlag12

								if ensureMoversState17 then
									ensureMoversFlag12 = ensureMoversState17.Root ~= ensureMoversValue22 or ensureMoversState17.Attachment.Parent ~= ensureMoversValue22 or ensureMoversState17.Position.Parent ~= ensureMoversValue22 or ensureMoversState17.Orientation.Parent ~= ensureMoversValue22
								else
									ensureMoversFlag12 = ensureMoversState17
								end

								if ensureMoversFlag12 then
									mainNotificationDefinitions.ClearMovers(ensureMoversParameter)
									ensureMoversState17 = nil
								end

								if not ensureMoversState17 then
									local ensureMoversAuraAttachment = ensureMoversValue22:FindFirstChild("AuraAttachment") or Instance.new("Attachment")
									ensureMoversAuraAttachment.Name = "AuraAttachment"
									ensureMoversAuraAttachment.Parent = ensureMoversValue22
									local ensureMoversAuraAlignPos = ensureMoversValue22:FindFirstChild("AuraAlignPos") or Instance.new("AlignPosition")
									ensureMoversAuraAlignPos.Name = "AuraAlignPos"
									ensureMoversAuraAlignPos.Attachment0 = ensureMoversAuraAttachment
									ensureMoversAuraAlignPos.Mode = Enum.PositionAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
									ensureMoversAuraAlignPos.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true
									ensureMoversAuraAlignPos.MaxForce = math.huge
									ensureMoversAuraAlignPos.MaxVelocity = math.huge
									ensureMoversAuraAlignPos.RigidityEnabled = false
									ensureMoversAuraAlignPos.Parent = ensureMoversValue22
									local ensureMoversAuraAlignOri = ensureMoversValue22:FindFirstChild("AuraAlignOri") or Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
									ensureMoversAuraAlignOri.Name = "AuraAlignOri"
									ensureMoversAuraAlignOri.Attachment0 = ensureMoversAuraAttachment
									ensureMoversAuraAlignOri.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
									ensureMoversAuraAlignOri.MaxTorque = math.huge
									ensureMoversAuraAlignOri.MaxAngularVelocity = math.huge
									ensureMoversAuraAlignOri.RigidityEnabled = false
									ensureMoversAuraAlignOri.Parent = ensureMoversValue22
									ensureMoversState17 = { Root = ensureMoversValue22, Attachment = ensureMoversAuraAttachment, Position = ensureMoversAuraAlignPos, Orientation = ensureMoversAuraAlignOri, Parts = {} }
									mainNotificationDefinitions.Movers[ensureMoversParameter] = ensureMoversState17
								end

								local ensureMoversResponsiveness = mainToysAuraSettings.Responsiveness or 55

								if ensureMoversState17.Responsiveness ~= ensureMoversResponsiveness then
									ensureMoversState17.Position.Responsiveness = ensureMoversResponsiveness
									ensureMoversState17.Orientation.Responsiveness = math.max(ensureMoversResponsiveness - 10, 10)
									ensureMoversState17.Responsiveness = ensureMoversResponsiveness
								end

								if ensureMoversState17.Collisions ~= mainToysAuraSettings.Collisions then
									mainNotificationDefinitions.SetCollisions(ensureMoversParameter, mainToysAuraSettings.Collisions)

							mainNotificationDefinitions.UpdatePhysics = function(updatePhysicsParameter, updatePhysicsSecondValue, updatePhysicsThirdValue, updatePhysicsFourthValue, updatePhysicsFifthValue)
								local updatePhysicsValue22, updatePhysicsValue23, updatePhysicsValue24, updatePhysicsValue25 = mainNotificationDefinitions.EnsureMovers(updatePhysicsParameter, updatePhysicsSecondValue)
								if not updatePhysicsValue22 then
									return
								end
								local updatePhysicsPosition = updatePhysicsThirdValue.Position

								if updatePhysicsValue25.TargetPosition ~= updatePhysicsPosition then
									updatePhysicsValue22.Position = updatePhysicsPosition
									updatePhysicsValue25.TargetPosition = updatePhysicsPosition
								end

								updatePhysicsFifthValue = updatePhysicsFifthValue and updatePhysicsFifthValue - updatePhysicsPosition
								local updatePhysicsCframe

								if updatePhysicsFourthValue and updatePhysicsFifthValue and updatePhysicsFifthValue:Dot(updatePhysicsFifthValue) > 0.0025 then
									updatePhysicsCframe = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, updatePhysicsFifthValue)
								else
									updatePhysicsCframe = updatePhysicsThirdValue.Rotation
								end

								if updatePhysicsValue25.TargetOrientation ~= updatePhysicsCframe then
									updatePhysicsValue23.CFrame = updatePhysicsCframe
									updatePhysicsValue25.TargetOrientation = updatePhysicsCframe
								end

							mainNotificationDefinitions.GetPath = function(getPathParameter, getPathSecondValue, getPathThirdValue)
								local getPathState17 = {}
								local getPathState18 = {}
								local getPathNumber37

								if getPathThirdValue then
									getPathNumber37 = #getPathParameter
								else
									getPathNumber37 = #getPathParameter - 1
								end

								local getPathNumber38 = 0

								for getPathIndex = 1, getPathNumber37 do
									local getPathMagnitude = (getPathParameter[getPathIndex % #getPathParameter + 1] - getPathParameter[getPathIndex]).Magnitude
									getPathState18[getPathIndex] = getPathMagnitude
									getPathNumber38 += getPathMagnitude
								end

								if getPathNumber38 == 0 then
									return table.create(getPathSecondValue, getPathParameter[1] or Vector3.zero)
								end

								for getPathIndex = 1, getPathSecondValue do
									local getPathNumber39 = getPathIndex - 1
									local getPathNumber40

									if getPathThirdValue then
										getPathNumber40 = getPathSecondValue
									else
										getPathNumber40 = math.max(getPathSecondValue - 1, 1)
									end

									local getPathNumber41 = getPathNumber39 / getPathNumber40 * getPathNumber38
									local getPathNumber42 = 1

									while getPathNumber42 < getPathNumber37 and getPathNumber41 > getPathState18[getPathNumber42] do
										getPathNumber41 -= getPathState18[getPathNumber42]
										getPathNumber42 += 1
									end

									local getPathNumber43

									if getPathState18[getPathNumber42] > 0 then

								if updateToysAuraFlag13 then
									mainNotificationDefinitions.ClearMovers()
									mainState17.MovePhase = 0
									return
								end

								local updateToysAuraValid = mainState17.Valid
								local updateToysAuraRoots = mainState17.Roots
								table.clear(updateToysAuraValid)
								table.clear(updateToysAuraRoots)
								mainNotificationDefinitions.UpdateCharacterRoots()

								while updateToysAuraNumber37 <= #mainToysAuraSettings.Models do
									local updateToysAuraValue25 = mainToysAuraSettings.Models[updateToysAuraNumber37]
									local updateToysAuraParent2 = updateToysAuraValue25.Parent and mainNotificationDefinitions.GetRoot(updateToysAuraValue25)

									if mainRuntimeData.ObjectStates[updateToysAuraValue25] then
										mainNotificationDefinitions.ClearMovers(updateToysAuraValue25)
										updateToysAuraNumber37 += 1
										continue
									end

									local updateToysAuraFlag14 = updateToysAuraParent2 and mainActions.IsPartOwner(updateToysAuraParent2)

									if updateToysAuraParent2 and not updateToysAuraFlag14 and mainActions.SNO(updateToysAuraParent2, 0.18) then
										mainNotificationDefinitions.UpdateCharacterRoots()
										updateToysAuraFlag14 = mainNotificationDefinitions.GetRoot(updateToysAuraValue25) == updateToysAuraParent2

									end

										mainNotificationDefinitions.ClearMovers()
										return
									end

									if mainToysAuraSettings.Models[updateToysAuraNumber37] == updateToysAuraValue25 then
										if mainRuntimeData.ObjectStates[updateToysAuraValue25] then
											mainNotificationDefinitions.ClearMovers(updateToysAuraValue25)
											updateToysAuraNumber37 += 1
										elseif updateToysAuraFlag14 then
											updateToysAuraValid[#updateToysAuraValid + 1] = updateToysAuraValue25
											updateToysAuraRoots[#updateToysAuraRoots + 1] = updateToysAuraParent2
											updateToysAuraNumber37 += 1
										else

										end

								if updateToysAuraNumber38 == 0 then

								end

									mainState17.ShapePhase = mainState17.ShapePhase % 6.2831853071795862
								end

								if mainToysAuraSettings.AutoMove then
									mainState17.MovePhase = mainState17.MovePhase + (mainToysAuraSettings.MoveSpeed or 1) * updateToysAuraParameter
									mainState17.MovePhase = mainState17.MovePhase % updateToysAuraNumber38
								else
									mainState17.MovePhase = 0
								end

								if mainToysAuraSettings.Bob then
									mainState17.BobPhase = (mainState17.BobPhase + (mainToysAuraSettings.BobSpeed or 0) * updateToysAuraParameter) % 6.2831853071795862
								else
									mainState17.BobPhase = 0
								end

								if mainToysAuraSettings.Bob then

								end

								local updateToysAuraNumber39 = #updateToysAuraValue26
								if updateToysAuraNumber39 == 0 then
									return
								end

								if mainToysAuraSettings.AutoRotate then

								end

									if mainToysAuraSettings.AutoMove and updateToysAuraNumber39 > 1 then
										local updateToysAuraNumber41 = updateToysAuraIndex + mainState17.MovePhase
										local updateToysAuraNumber42 = math.floor(updateToysAuraNumber41)
										updateToysAuraNumber40 = updateToysAuraValue26[(updateToysAuraNumber42 - 1) % updateToysAuraNumber39 + 1]:Lerp(updateToysAuraValue26[(updateToysAuraNumber42 + 1 - 1) % updateToysAuraNumber39 + 1], updateToysAuraNumber41 - updateToysAuraNumber42)
									else
										updateToysAuraNumber40 = updateToysAuraValue26[(updateToysAuraIndex - 1) % updateToysAuraNumber39 + 1]
									end

									if mainToysAuraSettings.AutoRotate then
										updateToysAuraNumber40 = updateToysAuraCframe * updateToysAuraNumber40
									end

									local updateToysAuraFaceCenter = mainToysAuraSettings.FaceCenter
									local updateToysAuraPosition = updateToysAuraValue25.Position
									mainNotificationDefinitions.UpdatePhysics(updateToysAuraValid[updateToysAuraIndex], updateToysAuraRoots[updateToysAuraIndex], updateToysAuraValue25 * CFrame.new(mainNotificationDefinitions.GetOffset(updateToysAuraNumber40)), updateToysAuraFaceCenter, updateToysAuraPosition)
								end
							end

							mainActions.StepToysAura = function(stepToysAuraParameter)
								if mainState17.Updating then
									return
								end
								mainState17.Updating = true
								local stepToysAuraSucceeded, stepToysAuraResult = pcall(mainActions.UpdateToysAura, stepToysAuraParameter)
								mainState17.Updating = false

								if not stepToysAuraSucceeded then
									warn("Toys Aura Update failed: " .. tostring(stepToysAuraResult))
								end
							end

							mainActions.SetToysAuraConnection = function(setToysAuraConnectionParameter)
								mainActions.SetRuntimeConnection("ToysAura", mainRunService.Heartbeat, setToysAuraConnectionParameter, mainActions.StepToysAura)
								if setToysAuraConnectionParameter then

									mainNotificationDefinitions.ClearCharacterRoots()
								end

								mainState17.MovePhase = 0
							end
						end
					end

				local kickServerPosition = kickServerValue23.Position

				kickServerConnection = mainRunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
					for kickServerKey, kickServerValue25 in kickServerState18, nil, nil do
						if kickServerKey.Parent then
							kickServerKey.CFrame = kickServerValue25
							mainActions.ResetVelocity(kickServerKey)
						else
							kickServerState18[kickServerKey] = nil
						end
					end
				end)

				for kickServerIndex, kickServerValue25 in ipairs(kickServerState16) do
					if not mainUnloaded then
						local kickServerValue26, kickServerValue27, kickServerValue28 = mainActions.Char(kickServerValue25)

						if kickServerValue27 and kickServerValue28 and kickServerValue28.Health > 0 then
							if kickServerParameter then
								mainRuntimeData.KickServerCooldowns[kickServerValue25] = os.clock()
							end

							if mainActions.SNO(kickServerValue27) then
								local kickServerNumber36 = kickServerIndex / #kickServerState16 * 3.1415926535897931 * 2
								local kickServerValue29 = kickServerState17
								local kickServerNumber37 = #kickServerState17 + 1
								local kickServerValue30 = kickServerState18
								local kickServerCframe = CFrame.new(kickServerPosition + Vector3.new(math.cos(kickServerNumber36) * 15, 15, math.sin(kickServerNumber36) * 15))
								kickServerValue29[kickServerNumber37] = kickServerValue27
								kickServerValue30[kickServerValue27] = kickServerCframe
								mainActions.Teleport(kickServerValue27, kickServerState18[kickServerValue27])
							end
						end

						continue
					end

					break
				end

				for kickServerIndex, kickServerValue25 in ipairs(kickServerState17) do
					local kickServerNumber36 = kickServerIndex / #kickServerState17 * 3.1415926535897931 * 2
					kickServerState18[kickServerValue25] = CFrame.new(kickServerPosition + Vector3.new(math.cos(kickServerNumber36) * 15, 15, math.sin(kickServerNumber36) * 15))
				end

				mainRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end)

			task.spawn(function()
				local kickServerNumber36 = os.clock() + 3

				while not mainUnloaded and os.clock() < kickServerNumber36 do
					mainRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end

				if kickServerConnection then
					kickServerConnection:Disconnect()
					kickServerConnection = nil
				end
			end)

			task.wait(0.15)

			for _kickServerUnused2, kickServerValue22 in ipairs(kickServerState17) do
				if kickServerValue22.Parent then
					mainActions.RNO(kickServerValue22)
				end
			end

			for _kickServerUnused3, kickServerValue22 in ipairs(kickServerState17) do
				if not mainUnloaded and kickServerValue22.Parent then
					task.spawn(mainActions.RemoveSticky, kickServerValue22.Parent)
				end
			end

			task.wait(6)

			if not mainUnloaded then
				mainUiToggles.LineLagToggle:SetDisabled(false)
				mainUiToggles.LineLagToggle:SetValue(false)
			end

			kickServerState.Running = false

			if not kickServerSucceeded then
				warn("[OwnerSigmaHub] Target Kick Server failed: " .. tostring(kickServerResult))
			end

			return kickServerSucceeded and #kickServerState17 > 0
		end

		mainActions.NormalizeServerHopServer = function(normalizeServerHopServerParameter)
			if typeof(normalizeServerHopServerParameter) ~= "table" then
				return
			end
			local normalizeServerHopServerId = normalizeServerHopServerParameter.Id or normalizeServerHopServerParameter.id
			local normalizeServerHopServerNum = tonumber(normalizeServerHopServerParameter.Playing or normalizeServerHopServerParameter.playing)
			local normalizeServerHopServerNum2 = tonumber(normalizeServerHopServerParameter.MaxPlayers or normalizeServerHopServerParameter.maxPlayers)
			if type(normalizeServerHopServerId) ~= "string" or not normalizeServerHopServerNum or not normalizeServerHopServerNum2 or normalizeServerHopServerNum2 <= 0 then
				return
			end

			return {
				Id = normalizeServerHopServerId,
				Playing = math.max(0, normalizeServerHopServerNum),
				MaxPlayers = normalizeServerHopServerNum2,
				Ping = tonumber(normalizeServerHopServerParameter.Ping or normalizeServerHopServerParameter.ping),
				FPS = tonumber(normalizeServerHopServerParameter.FPS or normalizeServerHopServerParameter.fps),
			}
		end

		mainActions.IsServerHopCandidate = function(isServerHopCandidateParameter, isServerHopCandidateSecondValue)
			if isServerHopCandidateParameter.Id == mainJobId or mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Rejected[isServerHopCandidateParameter.Id] then
				return false
			end

			if isServerHopCandidateSecondValue and not isServerHopCandidateSecondValue[isServerHopCandidateParameter.Id] then
				return false
			end
			local isServerHopCandidateNumber36 = math.min(mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopMinPlayers, mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopMaxPlayers)
			local isServerHopCandidateNumber37 = math.max(mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopMinPlayers, mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopMaxPlayers)
			if isServerHopCandidateParameter.Playing < isServerHopCandidateNumber36 or isServerHopCandidateParameter.Playing > isServerHopCandidateNumber37 then
				return false
			end

			if not mainFeatureFlags.ServerHopIncludeFull and isServerHopCandidateParameter.Playing >= isServerHopCandidateParameter.MaxPlayers then
				return false
			end
			return true
		end

		mainActions.LoadServerHopCache = function()
			if not readfile then
				return {}, nil, false, {}
			end

			if isfile and not isfile(mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.CachePath) then
				return {}, nil, false, {}
			end

			local loadServerHopCacheSucceeded, loadServerHopCacheResult = pcall(function()
				return mainHttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.CachePath))
			end)

			if not loadServerHopCacheSucceeded or typeof(loadServerHopCacheResult) ~= "table" or loadServerHopCacheResult.PlaceId ~= mainPlaceId or loadServerHopCacheResult.Schema ~= 4 then
				return {}, nil, false, {}
			end
			local loadServerHopCacheState16 = {}
			local loadServerHopCacheState17 = {}
			local loadServerHopCacheValue22 = ipairs
			local loadServerHopCacheServers = loadServerHopCacheResult.Servers or {}

			for _loadServerHopCacheUnused1, loadServerHopCacheServer in loadServerHopCacheValue22(loadServerHopCacheServers) do
				local loadServerHopCacheValue23 = mainActions.NormalizeServerHopServer(loadServerHopCacheServer)

				if loadServerHopCacheValue23 and loadServerHopCacheValue23.Id ~= mainJobId then
					loadServerHopCacheState16[#loadServerHopCacheState16 + 1] = loadServerHopCacheValue23
				end
			end

			local loadServerHopCacheValue23 = pairs
			local loadServerHopCacheRegions = loadServerHopCacheResult.Regions or {}

			for loadServerHopCacheKey, loadServerHopCacheRegion in loadServerHopCacheValue23(loadServerHopCacheRegions) do
				if type(loadServerHopCacheKey) == "string" and typeof(loadServerHopCacheRegion) == "table" then
					loadServerHopCacheState17[loadServerHopCacheKey] = {}

					for loadServerHopCacheK2, loadServerHopCacheValue24 in pairs(loadServerHopCacheRegion) do
						if type(loadServerHopCacheK2) == "string" and loadServerHopCacheValue24 == true then
							loadServerHopCacheState17[loadServerHopCacheKey][loadServerHopCacheK2] = true
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local loadServerHopCacheNumber36 = tonumber(loadServerHopCacheResult.CachedAt) or 0
			local loadServerHopCacheNumber37 = os.time() - loadServerHopCacheNumber36
			return loadServerHopCacheState16, loadServerHopCacheNumber36, loadServerHopCacheNumber37 >= 0 and loadServerHopCacheNumber37 <= 120, loadServerHopCacheState17
		end

		mainActions.SaveServerHopCache = function(saveServerHopCacheParameter, saveServerHopCacheSecondValue)
			mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.LastCacheError = nil
			if not writefile then
				mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.LastCacheError = "writefile is unavailable"
				return false
			end

			local saveServerHopCacheSucceeded, saveServerHopCacheResult = pcall(function()
				writefile(mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.CachePath, mainHttpService:JSONEncode({
					Schema = 4,
					PlaceId = mainPlaceId,
					CachedAt = saveServerHopCacheSecondValue or os.time(),
					Servers = saveServerHopCacheParameter,
					Regions = mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.CachedRegions,
				}))
			end)

			if not saveServerHopCacheSucceeded then
				mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.LastCacheError = tostring(saveServerHopCacheResult)
			end

			return saveServerHopCacheSucceeded
		end

		mainActions.FetchServerHopPage = function(fetchServerHopPageParameter, fetchServerHopPageSecondValue, fetchServerHopPageThirdValue)
			local fetchServerHopPageText5 = fetchServerHopPageThirdValue or "Roblox"

			end

			if type(fetchServerHopPageResult) ~= "string" or fetchServerHopPageResult == "" then
				return nil, fetchServerHopPageText5 .. " returned an empty response"
			end
			local fetchServerHopPageOk2, fetchServerHopPageResult2 = pcall(mainHttpService.JSONDecode, mainHttpService, fetchServerHopPageResult)
			if not fetchServerHopPageOk2 or typeof(fetchServerHopPageResult2) ~= "table" then
				return nil, fetchServerHopPageText5 .. " returned an invalid JSON response"
			end

			if fetchServerHopPageSecondValue and typeof(fetchServerHopPageResult2[fetchServerHopPageSecondValue]) ~= "table" then
				local fetchServerHopPageErrors = fetchServerHopPageResult2.errors and fetchServerHopPageResult2.errors[1]
				local fetchServerHopPageText6

				if fetchServerHopPageErrors then
					fetchServerHopPageText6 = tostring(fetchServerHopPageErrors.message)
				else
					fetchServerHopPageText6 = fetchServerHopPageText5 .. " returned no server data"
				end

				return nil, fetchServerHopPageText6
			end

			return fetchServerHopPageResult2
		end

		mainActions.RefreshServerHopRegions = function()
			local refreshServerHopRegionsList, refreshServerHopRegionsValue22 = mainActions.FetchServerHopPage("https://apis.rovalra.com/v1/datacenters/list", nil, "RoValra")
			if not refreshServerHopRegionsList then
				return false, refreshServerHopRegionsValue22
			end
			local refreshServerHopRegionsServerHop = mainRuntimeData.ServerHop
			local refreshServerHopRegionsRegionNames = mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.RegionNames
			local refreshServerHopRegionsState16 = {}
			local refreshServerHopRegionsRegions = {}

			for refreshServerHopRegionsIndex = 2, #refreshServerHopRegionsRegionNames do
				refreshServerHopRegionsRegions[refreshServerHopRegionsRegionNames[refreshServerHopRegionsIndex]] = {}
			end

			for _refreshServerHopRegionsUnused1, refreshServerHopRegionsValue23 in ipairs(refreshServerHopRegionsList) do
				local refreshServerHopRegionsLocation = refreshServerHopRegionsValue23.location
				local refreshServerHopRegionsCountry = refreshServerHopRegionsLocation and refreshServerHopRegionsLocation.country
				local refreshServerHopRegionsCity = refreshServerHopRegionsLocation and refreshServerHopRegionsLocation.city
				local refreshServerHopRegionsText5

				if type(refreshServerHopRegionsCountry) == "string" then
					refreshServerHopRegionsText5 = refreshServerHopRegionsCountry:upper()
				else
					refreshServerHopRegionsText5 = nil
				end

				local refreshServerHopRegionsText6 = refreshServerHopRegionsText5 and refreshServerHopRegionsCity and refreshServerHopRegionsText5 .. "\0" .. refreshServerHopRegionsCity
				local refreshServerHopRegionsValue24 = mainActions.GetServerHopContinent(refreshServerHopRegionsText5)

				if refreshServerHopRegionsValue23.inactive ~= true and refreshServerHopRegionsText6 and refreshServerHopRegionsValue24 and not refreshServerHopRegionsState16[refreshServerHopRegionsText6] then
					refreshServerHopRegionsState16[refreshServerHopRegionsText6] = true

					refreshServerHopRegionsRegions[refreshServerHopRegionsValue24][#refreshServerHopRegionsRegions[refreshServerHopRegionsValue24] + 1] = {
						Country = refreshServerHopRegionsText5,
						City = refreshServerHopRegionsCity,
						Latitude = tonumber(refreshServerHopRegionsLocation.latLong and refreshServerHopRegionsLocation.latLong[1]),
						Longitude = tonumber(refreshServerHopRegionsLocation.latLong and refreshServerHopRegionsLocation.latLong[2]),
					}
				end
			end

			if not next(refreshServerHopRegionsState16) then
				return false, "RoValra returned no active datacenters"
			end
			refreshServerHopRegionsServerHop.Regions = refreshServerHopRegionsRegions
			refreshServerHopRegionsServerHop.AutomaticCountry = nil
			refreshServerHopRegionsServerHop.PlayerCoordinates = nil
			table.clear(refreshServerHopRegionsServerHop.ResolvedRegions)
			return true
		end

		mainActions.GetServerHopPlayerCoordinates = function()

			if getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesServerHop.AutomaticCountry == getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesAutomaticCountry then
				local getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesPlayerCoordinates = getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesServerHop.PlayerCoordinates
				return getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesPlayerCoordinates and getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesPlayerCoordinates.X, getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesPlayerCoordinates and getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesPlayerCoordinates.Y, getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesAutomaticCountry
			end
			local getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesMatch = nil
			local getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesValue22 = nil

			for _getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesUnused1, getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesValue23 in ipairs({
				"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/google/dspl@master/samples/google/canonical/countries.csv",
				"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/dspl/master/samples/google/canonical/countries.csv",
			}) do
				local getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesOk2, getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesResult2 = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesValue23, true)

				if getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesOk2 and type(getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesResult2) == "string" then
					getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesMatch, getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesValue22 = getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesResult2:match("\n" .. getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesAutomaticCountry .. ",([%d%.%-]+),([%d%.%-]+),")
					if not getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesMatch then
						continue
					end
				else
					continue
				end

				break
			end

			local getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesNum = tonumber(getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesMatch)
			local getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesNum2 = tonumber(getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesValue22)
			local getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesValue23 = getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesServerHop.CountryCoordinates[getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesAutomaticCountry]

			if not getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesNum and getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesValue23 then
				getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesNum = getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesValue23.X
				getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesNum2 = getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesValue23.Y
			end

			getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesServerHop.AutomaticCountry = getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesAutomaticCountry
			local getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesVector2

			if getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesNum and getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesNum2 then
				getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesVector2 = Vector2.new(getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesNum, getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesNum2)
			else
				getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesVector2 = nil
			end

			getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesServerHop.PlayerCoordinates = getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesVector2
			table.clear(getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesServerHop.ResolvedRegions)
			return getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesNum, getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesNum2, getServerHopPlayerCoordinatesAutomaticCountry
		end

		mainActions.GetServerHopRegions = function()
			local getServerHopRegionsServerHop = mainRuntimeData.ServerHop
			local getServerHopRegionsServerHopRegion = mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopRegion

			if not next(getServerHopRegionsServerHop.Regions) then
				local getServerHopRegionsValue22, getServerHopRegionsValue23 = mainActions.RefreshServerHopRegions()
				if not getServerHopRegionsValue22 then
					return nil, getServerHopRegionsValue23
				end
			end

			if getServerHopRegionsServerHopRegion ~= "Automatic" and not getServerHopRegionsServerHop.Regions[getServerHopRegionsServerHopRegion] then
				mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopRegion = "Automatic"
				getServerHopRegionsServerHopRegion = "Automatic"

				if mainUiOptions.ServerHopRegion then
					mainUiOptions.ServerHopRegion:SetValue("Automatic")
				end
			end

			local getServerHopRegionsValue22, getServerHopRegionsValue23, getServerHopRegionsValue24 = mainActions.GetServerHopPlayerCoordinates()
			local getServerHopRegionsText5 = getServerHopRegionsValue24 and getServerHopRegionsValue24 .. "\0" .. getServerHopRegionsServerHopRegion
			if getServerHopRegionsText5 and getServerHopRegionsServerHop.ResolvedRegions[getServerHopRegionsText5] then
				return getServerHopRegionsServerHop.ResolvedRegions[getServerHopRegionsText5]
			end
			local getServerHopRegionsValue25 = getServerHopRegionsValue22 and math.rad(getServerHopRegionsValue22)

			local function getServerHopRegionsFunction21(getServerHopRegionsParameter)
				if not (getServerHopRegionsValue25 and getServerHopRegionsParameter.Latitude and getServerHopRegionsParameter.Longitude) then
					return math.huge
				end
				local getServerHopRegionsValue26 = math.rad(getServerHopRegionsParameter.Latitude - getServerHopRegionsValue22)
				local getServerHopRegionsValue27 = math.rad(getServerHopRegionsParameter.Longitude - getServerHopRegionsValue23)
				local getServerHopRegionsValue28 = math.sin(getServerHopRegionsValue26 / 2)
				local getServerHopRegionsValue29 = math.sin(getServerHopRegionsValue27 / 2)
				return getServerHopRegionsValue28 * getServerHopRegionsValue28 + math.cos(getServerHopRegionsValue25) * math.cos(math.rad(getServerHopRegionsParameter.Latitude)) * getServerHopRegionsValue29 * getServerHopRegionsValue29
			end

			if getServerHopRegionsServerHopRegion == "Automatic" then
				getServerHopRegionsServerHopRegion = mainActions.GetServerHopContinent(getServerHopRegionsValue24)

				if not getServerHopRegionsServerHopRegion and getServerHopRegionsValue22 then
					local getServerHopRegionsHuge = math.huge

					for getServerHopRegionsIndex = 2, #getServerHopRegionsServerHop.RegionNames do
						local getServerHopRegionsValue26 = getServerHopRegionsServerHop.RegionNames[getServerHopRegionsIndex]
						local getServerHopRegionsValue27 = ipairs
						local getServerHopRegionsState16 = getServerHopRegionsServerHop.Regions[getServerHopRegionsValue26] or {}

						for _getServerHopRegionsUnused1, getServerHopRegionsValue28 in getServerHopRegionsValue27(getServerHopRegionsState16) do
							local getServerHopRegionsValue29 = getServerHopRegionsFunction21(getServerHopRegionsValue28)

							if getServerHopRegionsValue29 < getServerHopRegionsHuge then
								getServerHopRegionsHuge = getServerHopRegionsValue29
								getServerHopRegionsServerHopRegion = getServerHopRegionsValue26
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local getServerHopRegionsValue26 = getServerHopRegionsServerHop.Regions[getServerHopRegionsServerHopRegion]
			if not getServerHopRegionsValue26 or #getServerHopRegionsValue26 == 0 then
				return
			end
			local getServerHopRegionsValue27 = table.clone(getServerHopRegionsValue26)

			table.sort(getServerHopRegionsValue27, function(sortParameter, sortSecondValue)
				local sortValue28 = getServerHopRegionsFunction21(sortParameter)
				local sortValue29 = getServerHopRegionsFunction21(sortSecondValue)

				if sortValue28 == sortValue29 then
					local sortFlag12 = sortParameter.Country == getServerHopRegionsValue24
					if sortFlag12 ~= sortSecondValue.Country == getServerHopRegionsValue24 then
						return sortFlag12
					end
					return tostring(sortParameter.City) < tostring(sortSecondValue.City)
				end

				return sortValue28 < sortValue29
			end)

			if getServerHopRegionsText5 then
				getServerHopRegionsServerHop.ResolvedRegions[getServerHopRegionsText5] = getServerHopRegionsValue27
			end

			return getServerHopRegionsValue27
		end

		mainActions.FetchServerHopRegionIds = function(fetchServerHopRegionIdsParameter)

		mainActions.FetchServerHopServersPage = function(fetchServerHopServersPageParameter, fetchServerHopServersPageSecondValue)
			local fetchServerHopServersPageNumber36 = math.min(mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopMinPlayers, mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopMaxPlayers)
			local fetchServerHopServersPageText5

			if mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopSort == "Highest Players" or fetchServerHopServersPageNumber36 >= mainPlayers.MaxPlayers / 2 then
				fetchServerHopServersPageText5 = "Desc"
			else
				fetchServerHopServersPageText5 = "Asc"
			end

			local fetchServerHopServersPageText6 = "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/" .. mainPlaceId .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=" .. fetchServerHopServersPageText5 .. "&limit=100&excludeFullGames=" .. tostring(not mainFeatureFlags.ServerHopIncludeFull)

			if type(fetchServerHopServersPageParameter) == "string" and fetchServerHopServersPageParameter ~= "" then
				fetchServerHopServersPageText6 ..= "&cursor=" .. mainHttpService:UrlEncode(fetchServerHopServersPageParameter)
			end

			local fetchServerHopServersPageValue22, fetchServerHopServersPageValue23
			local fetchServerHopRetryCount = 0

			repeat
				if mainUnloaded or fetchServerHopServersPageSecondValue ~= mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Token then
					return
				end
				fetchServerHopServersPageValue22, fetchServerHopServersPageValue23 = mainActions.FetchServerHopPage(fetchServerHopServersPageText6, "data", "Roblox")
				if mainUnloaded or fetchServerHopServersPageSecondValue ~= mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Token then
					return
				end

				if not fetchServerHopServersPageValue22 and not mainUnloaded then
					fetchServerHopRetryCount = fetchServerHopRetryCount + 1
					if fetchServerHopRetryCount >= 5 then
						break
					end
					task.wait(math.min(1.5 * fetchServerHopRetryCount, 5))
				end
			until fetchServerHopServersPageValue22 or mainUnloaded or fetchServerHopServersPageSecondValue ~= mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Token

			if mainUnloaded or fetchServerHopServersPageSecondValue ~= mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Token then
				return
			end

			if not fetchServerHopServersPageValue22 then
				mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.LastFetchError = fetchServerHopServersPageValue23
				return
			end
			local fetchServerHopServersPageState16 = {}

			for _fetchServerHopServersPageUnused1, fetchServerHopServersPageValue24 in ipairs(fetchServerHopServersPageValue22.data) do
				local fetchServerHopServersPageValue25 = mainActions.NormalizeServerHopServer(fetchServerHopServersPageValue24)

				if fetchServerHopServersPageValue25 and fetchServerHopServersPageValue25.Id ~= mainJobId then
					fetchServerHopServersPageState16[#fetchServerHopServersPageState16 + 1] = fetchServerHopServersPageValue25
				end
			end

			return fetchServerHopServersPageState16, fetchServerHopServersPageValue22.nextPageCursor
		end

		mainActions.FilterServerHopServers = function(filterServerHopServersParameter, filterServerHopServersSecondValue)
			local filterServerHopServersState16 = {}

			for _filterServerHopServersUnused1, filterServerHopServersValue22 in ipairs(filterServerHopServersParameter) do

		mainActions.SelectServerHopServer = function(selectServerHopServerParameter)
			if #selectServerHopServerParameter == 0 then
				return
			end

			if mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopSort == "Closest Datacenter" or mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopSort == "Lowest Ping" or mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopSort == "Random" then
				return selectServerHopServerParameter[math.random(1, #selectServerHopServerParameter)]
			end

			table.sort(selectServerHopServerParameter, function(sortSecondValue, sortThirdValue)
				local sortPlaying, sortPlaying2

				if mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopSort == "Lowest Players" then
					sortPlaying = sortSecondValue.Playing
					sortPlaying2 = sortThirdValue.Playing
				elseif mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopSort == "Highest Players" then
					sortPlaying = -sortSecondValue.Playing
					sortPlaying2 = -sortThirdValue.Playing
				elseif mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopSort == "Highest FPS" then
					sortPlaying = -(sortSecondValue.FPS or 0)
					sortPlaying2 = -(sortThirdValue.FPS or 0)
				else
					sortPlaying = sortSecondValue.Ping or math.huge
					sortPlaying2 = sortThirdValue.Ping or math.huge
				end

				if sortPlaying == sortPlaying2 then
					return sortSecondValue.Id < sortThirdValue.Id
				end
				return sortPlaying < sortPlaying2
			end)

			return selectServerHopServerParameter[1]
		end

		end

		mainActions.CancelServerHop = function()
