				end
			end
		end

		mainActions.ServerHop = function(serverHopParameter, serverHopSecondValue)
			if mainUnloaded then
				return false
			end

			if mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Busy or mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Pending or mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Retrying then
				mainNotify("A server-hop is already in progress.")
				return false
			end
			local serverHop = mainRuntimeData.ServerHop
			serverHop.Token = serverHop.Token + 1
			local serverHopToken = mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Token

			local function serverHopFunction21()
				return not mainUnloaded and serverHopToken == mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Token
			end

			mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Busy = true
			mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Cancelled = false
			mainActions.UpdateServerHopButton()

			local serverHopValue22 = mainUiLibrary:Notify({
				Title = "OwnerSigmaHub",
				Description = "Attempting to serverhop..",
				Persist = true,
				SoundId = mainNumber34,
				Volume = mainNumber35,
			})

			if not serverHopFunction21() then
				serverHopValue22:Destroy()
				return false
			end
			mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Notification = serverHopValue22

			local serverHopSucceeded, serverHopResult = pcall(function()
				local serverHopValue23, serverHopValue24 = mainActions.GetServerHopRegions()
				if not serverHopFunction21() then
					return false
				end

				if not serverHopValue23 then
					local serverHopValue25 = mainNotify
					local serverHopText5

					if serverHopValue24 then
						serverHopText5 = " Error: " .. serverHopValue24
					else
						serverHopText5 = ""
					end

					serverHopValue25("Couldn't determine the server-hop region; server-hop cancelled." .. serverHopText5)
					return false
				end

				local serverHopState16, serverHopNow3, serverHopValue25, serverHopCachedRegions = mainActions.LoadServerHopCache()
				if not serverHopFunction21() then
					return false
				end

				if not serverHopValue25 then
					serverHopState16 = {}
				end

				local serverHopState17 = {}
				local serverHopValue26 = nil
				local serverHopNumber36 = 0
				local serverHopNumber37 = 0
				local serverHopState18 = {}
				local serverHopState19 = {}
				local serverHop2 = mainRuntimeData.ServerHop

				if not serverHopValue25 then
					serverHopCachedRegions = {}
				end

				serverHop2.CachedRegions = serverHopCachedRegions
				mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.LastFetchError = nil

				for _serverHopUnused1, serverHopValue27 in ipairs(serverHopState16) do
					serverHopState19[serverHopValue27.Id] = true
				end

				local function serverHopFunction22(serverHopThirdValue)
					for _serverHopUnused2, serverHopValue27 in ipairs(serverHopValue23) do
						if not serverHopFunction21() then
							return {}
						end
						local serverHopText5 = serverHopValue27.Country .. "\0" .. tostring(serverHopValue27.City or "")
						local serverHopValue28 = mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.CachedRegions[serverHopText5]

						if not serverHopValue28 then
							if serverHopNumber37 > 0 then
								task.wait(1)
							end

							if not serverHopFunction21() then
								return {}
							end
							local serverHopValue29
							serverHopValue28, serverHopValue29 = mainActions.FetchServerHopRegionIds(serverHopValue27)
							serverHopValue26 = serverHopValue29
							if not serverHopFunction21() then
								return {}
							end
							serverHopNumber37 += 1
							if not serverHopValue28 then
								return {}
							end
							mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.CachedRegions[serverHopText5] = serverHopValue28
						end

						if not serverHopState18[serverHopText5] then
							serverHopState18[serverHopText5] = true
							serverHopNumber36 += 1
						end

						local serverHopValue29 = mainActions.FilterServerHopServers(serverHopThirdValue, serverHopValue28)
						if #serverHopValue29 > 0 then
							return serverHopValue29
						end
					end

					return {}
				end

				if serverHopValue25 and #mainActions.FilterServerHopServers(serverHopState16) > 0 then
					serverHopState17 = serverHopFunction22(serverHopState16)
				end

				if #serverHopState17 == 0 and not serverHopValue26 then
					table.clear(serverHopState16)
					table.clear(serverHopState19)
					local serverHopText5 = ""

					for serverHopIndex = 1, 10 do
						if serverHopIndex > 1 then
							task.wait(1)
						end

						if not serverHopFunction21() then
							return false
						end
						local serverHopValue27, serverHopValue28 = mainActions.FetchServerHopServersPage(serverHopText5, serverHopToken)
						if not serverHopFunction21() then
							return false
						end

						if not serverHopValue27 then
							break
						end
						serverHopNow3 = os.time()

						for _serverHopUnused3, serverHopValue29 in ipairs(serverHopValue27) do
							if not serverHopState19[serverHopValue29.Id] then
								serverHopState19[serverHopValue29.Id] = true
								serverHopState16[#serverHopState16 + 1] = serverHopValue29
							end
						end

						if #mainActions.FilterServerHopServers(serverHopValue27) > 0 then
							serverHopState17 = serverHopFunction22(serverHopValue27)
							if #serverHopState17 > 0 or serverHopValue26 then
								break
							end
						end

						if type(serverHopValue28) ~= "string" or serverHopValue28 == "" then
							break
						end
						serverHopText5 = serverHopValue28
					end
				end

				if not serverHopFunction21() then
					return false
				end

				if #serverHopState17 == 0 then
					if serverHopValue26 then
						mainNotify("Region search failed. Error: " .. serverHopValue26)
					elseif mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.LastFetchError then
						mainNotify("Roblox server search stopped. Error: " .. mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.LastFetchError)
					elseif #serverHopState16 == 0 then
						local serverHopValue27 = mainNotify
						local serverHopText5

						if mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.LastFetchError then
							serverHopText5 = " Error: " .. mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.LastFetchError
						else
							serverHopText5 = ""
						end

						serverHopValue27("Roblox didn't return any public servers. Try again in a few seconds." .. serverHopText5)
					else
						local serverHopRegion = mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopRegion
						mainNotify(("Checked %d servers across %d datacenters, but none matched %d-%d players in %s."):format(#serverHopState16, serverHopNumber36, math.min(mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopMinPlayers, mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopMaxPlayers), math.max(mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopMinPlayers, mainFeatureSettings.ServerHopMaxPlayers), serverHopRegion))
					end

					if serverHopNow3 then
						mainActions.SaveServerHopCache(serverHopState16, serverHopNow3)
					end

					return false
				end

				local serverHopValue27 = mainActions.SelectServerHopServer(serverHopState17)

				for serverHopIndex = #serverHopState16, 1, -1 do
					if serverHopState16[serverHopIndex].Id == serverHopValue27.Id then
						table.remove(serverHopState16, serverHopIndex)
						break
					end
				end

				local serverHopValue28 = mainActions.SaveServerHopCache(serverHopState16, serverHopNow3)
				if not serverHopFunction21() then
					return false
				end

				if not serverHopValue28 then
					mainNotify("Server cache couldn't be saved: " .. tostring(mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.LastCacheError))
				end

				mainActions.QueueTeleport(serverHopParameter, serverHopSecondValue)
				if not serverHopFunction21() then
					return false
				end
				mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Pending = { ServerId = serverHopValue27.Id, AntiLag = serverHopParameter, RestartScript = serverHopSecondValue }
				local serverHopSucceeded, serverHopResult = pcall(mainTeleportService.TeleportToPlaceInstance, mainTeleportService, mainPlaceId, serverHopValue27.Id, mainLocalPlayer)
				if not serverHopFunction21() then
					return false
				end

				if not serverHopSucceeded then
					local serverHopText5 = tostring(serverHopResult)
					if serverHopText5:lower():find("full", 1, true) then
						return mainActions.RetryFullServerHop()
					end
					mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Pending = nil
					mainNotify("Server-hop failed: " .. serverHopText5)
				end

				return serverHopSucceeded
			end)

			if not serverHopFunction21() then
				return false
			end
			mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Busy = false
			serverHopValue22:Destroy()
			mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Notification = nil
			local serverHopFlag12 = not serverHopSucceeded

			if serverHopFlag12 then
				mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Pending = nil
			end

			mainActions.UpdateServerHopButton()
			if serverHopFlag12 then
				mainNotify("Server-hop failed: " .. tostring(serverHopResult))
				return false
			end
			return serverHopResult
		end

		mainActions.RetryFullServerHop = function()
			local retryFullServerHopValue22 = mainUnloaded
			local retryFullServerHopCancelled

			if mainUnloaded then
				retryFullServerHopCancelled = retryFullServerHopValue22
			else
				retryFullServerHopCancelled = mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Cancelled
			end

			if retryFullServerHopCancelled then
				return false
			end
			local retryFullServerHopPending = mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Pending
			if not retryFullServerHopPending then
				return mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Retrying == true
			end
			mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Pending = nil
			mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Rejected[retryFullServerHopPending.ServerId] = true
			mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Busy = false
			mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Retrying = true
			local retryFullServerHopToken = mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Token
			mainActions.UpdateServerHopButton()
			mainNotify("Server is full; trying another server in the selected region.")

			task.delay(1, function()
				if mainUnloaded or retryFullServerHopToken ~= mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Token then
					return
				end
				mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Retrying = false

				if not mainUnloaded then
					mainActions.ServerHop(retryFullServerHopPending.AntiLag, retryFullServerHopPending.RestartScript)
				end
			end)

			return true
		end

		mainActions.ScheduleAutoServerHop = function(scheduleAutoServerHopParameter)
			local scheduleAutoServerHopServerHop = mainRuntimeData.ServerHop
			scheduleAutoServerHopServerHop.AutoToken = scheduleAutoServerHopServerHop.AutoToken + 1
			local scheduleAutoServerHopAutoToken = mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.AutoToken
			local scheduleAutoServerHopValue22 = mainUnloaded
			local scheduleAutoServerHopFlag12

			if mainUnloaded then
				scheduleAutoServerHopFlag12 = scheduleAutoServerHopValue22
			else
				scheduleAutoServerHopFlag12 = not mainFeatureFlags.AutoServerHop
			end

			if scheduleAutoServerHopFlag12 then
				return
			end

			task.delay(scheduleAutoServerHopParameter or mainFeatureSettings.AutoServerHopTime, function()
				if mainUnloaded or scheduleAutoServerHopAutoToken ~= mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.AutoToken or not mainFeatureFlags.AutoServerHop then
					return
				end

				if not mainActions.ServerHop(mainFeatureFlags.RejoinWithAntiLag ~= false, mainFeatureFlags.RejoinWithScript) and scheduleAutoServerHopAutoToken == mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.AutoToken and mainFeatureFlags.AutoServerHop then

				end

					Text = "Add To List",
					Mode = "Press",
					NoUI = true,
					Callback = function()
						local function getPlayerFromInstance(targetInstance)
							local current = targetInstance
							while current and current ~= workspace do
								local foundPlr = mainPlayers:GetPlayerFromCharacter(current)
								if foundPlr and foundPlr ~= mainLocalPlayer then
									return foundPlr
								end
								local byName = mainPlayers:FindFirstChild(current.Name)
								if byName and byName:IsA("Player") and byName ~= mainLocalPlayer then
									return byName
								end
								current = current.Parent
							end
							return nil
						end

						local targetPlr = nil
						local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera or mainCurrentCamera
						local mouseX = mainMouse and mainMouse.X
						local mouseY = mainMouse and mainMouse.Y
						if not mouseX or not mouseY then
							local mouseLoc = mainUserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
							mouseX = mouseLoc.X
							mouseY = mouseLoc.Y
						end

						if camera and mouseX and mouseY then

								local candidateChars = {}
								for _plrIndex, plr in ipairs(mainPlayers:GetPlayers()) do
									if plr ~= mainLocalPlayer and plr.Character then
										table.insert(candidateChars, plr.Character)
									end
								end

								if #candidateChars > 0 then

									rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

									if hitResult and hitResult.Instance then
										targetPlr = getPlayerFromInstance(hitResult.Instance)
									end
								end
							end
						end

						if not targetPlr and camera and mouseX and mouseY then
							local mousePos = Vector2.new(mouseX, mouseY)
							local minDistance = 80
							local closestPlr = nil

							for _plrIndex, plr in ipairs(mainPlayers:GetPlayers()) do
								if plr ~= mainLocalPlayer and plr.Character then

										local screenPoint, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
										if onScreen and screenPoint.Z > 0 then
											local dist = (Vector2.new(screenPoint.X, screenPoint.Y) - mousePos).Magnitude
											if dist < minDistance then
												minDistance = dist
												closestPlr = plr
											end
										end
									end
								end
							end

							targetPlr = closestPlr
						end

						if not targetPlr and mainMouse and mainMouse.Target then
							targetPlr = getPlayerFromInstance(mainMouse.Target)
						end

						if targetPlr then
							createPlayerDropdownFunction21(targetPlr)
						end
					end,
				})
			end

			return createPlayerDropdownValue22
		end

		mainUiLibrary.ForceCheckbox = false

		mainWindow = mainUiLibrary:CreateWindow({
			Title = "<b>Owner sigma hub</b> <font color='#B8A989'>[FTAP]</font>",
			Footer = "Owner sigma hub • Fling Things and People",
			ToggleKeybind = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
			Center = true,
			AutoShow = true,
			EnableSidebarResize = true,
			Icon = "crown",
			IconSize = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40),
			CornerRadius = 5,
			Compact = true,
			-- Keep interactions instant: large tabs can contain hundreds of controls,
			-- so animating the whole hierarchy can stall lower-end devices.
			Animations = {
				ToggleWindow = false,
				TabSwitch = false,
				Dropdown = true,
				Groupbox = false,
				KeyPicker = false,
			},
			TabSwipeFrom = "Auto",
			TabButtonsStyle = {
				Gap = 4,
				Padding = 8,
				CornerRadius = 5,
				Indicator = true,
				IndicatorWidth = 2,
				IndicatorHeight = 19,
			},

		})

		-- A stable, centered workspace: keep the window inside small screens without
		-- repeatedly recalculating its dimensions while toggling it visible/hidden.
		pcall(function()
			local viewport = mainCurrentCamera and mainCurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
			local width = math.max(260, math.min(960, viewport.X - 20, math.floor(viewport.X * 0.88)))
			local height = math.max(300, math.min(660, viewport.Y - 20, math.floor(viewport.Y * 0.82)))
			mainWindow.MainFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			mainWindow.MainFrame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			mainWindow.MainFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
		end)

		-- Full Minimal visual system.
		-- This styles the window, navigation, content surfaces and controls while preserving
		-- the existing control callbacks and hierarchy owned by the UI library.
		do
			local skin = {
				Base = Color3.fromRGB(12, 11, 9),
				Sidebar = Color3.fromRGB(18, 16, 12),
				Panel = Color3.fromRGB(25, 22, 16),
				PanelAlt = Color3.fromRGB(31, 27, 19),
				Selection = Color3.fromRGB(72, 54, 23),
				Accent = Color3.fromRGB(230, 180, 65),
				AccentSoft = Color3.fromRGB(139, 103, 37),
				Text = Color3.fromRGB(248, 242, 225),
				Muted = Color3.fromRGB(184, 169, 137),
				Border = Color3.fromRGB(91, 69, 31),
			}
			local root = mainWindow and mainWindow.MainFrame
			local pending = {}
			local pendingHead, pendingTail = 1, 0
			local queued = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
			local workerRunning = false
			local skinAlive = true
			local startWorker

			local function contains(value, token)
				return string.find(string.lower(value or ""), token, 1, true) ~= nil
			end

			local function isSelectedName(name)
				return contains(name, "selected") or contains(name, "activeindicator") or contains(name, "tabindicator") or contains(name, "currenttab")
			end

			-- Obsidian color swatches are small, empty TextButtons parented to a TextLabel.
			-- Keep their actual selected color, checkerboard overlay and darker outline intact.
			local function isColorPickerSwatch(object)
				if not object or not object:IsA("TextButton") or object.Text ~= "" then
					return false
				end
				local size = object.Size
				return size.X.Scale == 0 and size.Y.Scale == 0
					and size.X.Offset >= 14 and size.X.Offset <= 24
					and size.Y.Offset >= 14 and size.Y.Offset <= 24
					and object.Parent ~= nil and object.Parent:IsA("TextLabel")
			end

			local function findColorPickerSwatch(object)
				local current = object
				while current and current ~= root do
					if isColorPickerSwatch(current) then return current end
					current = current.Parent
				end
				return nil
			end

			local function isColorPickerSubtree(object)
				local current = object
				while current and current ~= root do
					local name = string.lower(current.Name or "")
					if contains(name, "colorpicker") or contains(name, "colormenu")
						or contains(name, "saturationmap") or contains(name, "hueselector")
						or contains(name, "transparencyselector") then
						return true
					end
					current = current.Parent
				end
				return false
			end

			local function surfaceColor(object)
				local name = string.lower(object.Name or "")
				if object == root or contains(name, "mainframe") or contains(name, "windowbackground") then
					return skin.Base
				elseif contains(name, "sidebar") or contains(name, "tablist") or contains(name, "navigation") or contains(name, "tabcontainer") then
					return skin.Sidebar
				elseif isSelectedName(name) then
					return skin.Selection
				elseif contains(name, "header") or contains(name, "titlebar") or contains(name, "topbar") then
					return skin.Base
				elseif contains(name, "groupbox") or contains(name, "section") or contains(name, "card") or contains(name, "panel") then
					return skin.PanelAlt
				end
				return skin.Panel
			end

			local function ensureCorner(object, radius)
				local corner = object:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
				if not corner then
					corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
					corner.Name = "MinimalSkinCorner"
					corner.Parent = object
				end
				corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
			end

			local function ensureStroke(object, color, transparency)
				local stroke = object:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
				if not stroke then
					stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
					stroke.Name = "MinimalSkinStroke"
					stroke.Parent = object
				end
				stroke.Color = color or skin.Border
				stroke.Thickness = 1
				stroke.Transparency = transparency or 0.2
			end

			local function styleOne(object)
				if not object or not object.Parent then return end
				-- Preserve color values, but give the swatch a neutral outline so dark colors
				-- (especially black) still remain visible on the graphite interface.
				local swatch = findColorPickerSwatch(object)
				if swatch then
					pcall(function()
						if object == swatch then
							object.BorderSizePixel = 0
							local corner = object:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
							if corner then corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) end
						end
						if object:IsA("UIStroke") and object.Parent == swatch then
							object.Color = skin.Border
							object.Thickness = 1
							object.Transparency = 0
						end
					end)
					return
				end
				-- Color menus own their gradients/textures. Generic theming must not hide them.
				if isColorPickerSubtree(object) then return end
				pcall(function()
					local name = string.lower(object.Name or "")
					local parentName = object.Parent and string.lower(object.Parent.Name or "") or ""

					if object:IsA("UICorner") then
						local parent = object.Parent
						local radius = 5
						if parent == root or contains(parentName, "window") or contains(parentName, "mainframe") then radius = 7 end
						object.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
					elseif object:IsA("UIStroke") then
						object.Color = skin.Border
						object.Thickness = 1
						object.Transparency = 0.22
					elseif object:IsA("UIGradient") then
						-- Do not disable gradients globally: some controls (including color inputs)
						-- rely on them to display their actual value and remain usable.
					elseif object:IsA("Frame") or object:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
						if contains(name, "ownersigmatoggletrack") then
							-- The UI library's UIGradient selects the visual OFF/ON color.
							-- Keep the track's base white so the gradient is not multiplied by graphite.
							object.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
						elseif contains(name, "ownersigmatoggleknob") then
							-- Keep the library-controlled contrasting light/dark knob as-is.
						elseif object.BackgroundTransparency < 0.98 then
							object.BackgroundColor3 = surfaceColor(object)
						end
						if object:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
							object.ScrollBarImageColor3 = skin.AccentSoft
							object.ScrollBarThickness = 4
						end
						if object == root then
							object.BorderSizePixel = 0
							ensureCorner(object, 7)
							ensureStroke(object, skin.Border, 0.08)
						elseif (contains(name, "groupbox") or contains(name, "section") or contains(name, "card") or contains(name, "sidebar")) and object.BackgroundTransparency < 0.98 then
							ensureCorner(object, 5)
							ensureStroke(object, skin.Border, 0.25)
						end
					elseif object:IsA("TextLabel") then
						if contains(name, "subtitle") or contains(name, "description") or contains(name, "hint") or contains(name, "footer") or contains(name, "version") then
							object.TextColor3 = skin.Muted
						elseif contains(name, "title") or contains(name, "sectionheader") or contains(name, "brand") then
							object.TextColor3 = skin.Text
						else
							object.TextColor3 = skin.Text
						end
						object.Font = (contains(name, "title") or contains(name, "header")) and Enum.Font.GothamMedium or Enum.Font.Gotham
					elseif object:IsA("TextBox") then
						object.BackgroundColor3 = skin.Base
						object.TextColor3 = skin.Text
						object.PlaceholderColor3 = skin.Muted
						object.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
						ensureCorner(object, 5)
						ensureStroke(object, skin.Border, 0.25)
					elseif object:IsA("TextButton") then
						if object.BackgroundTransparency < 0.98 then
							if isSelectedName(name) or isSelectedName(parentName) then
								object.BackgroundColor3 = skin.Selection
							else
								object.BackgroundColor3 = skin.PanelAlt
							end
							ensureCorner(object, 5)
						end
						object.TextColor3 = skin.Text
						object.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
						if contains(name, "tabbutton") or contains(parentName, "tabcontainer") or contains(parentName, "tablist") then ensureStroke(object, skin.Border, 0.48) end
					elseif object:IsA("ImageButton") then
						if object.BackgroundTransparency < 0.98 then
							object.BackgroundColor3 = (isSelectedName(name) or isSelectedName(parentName)) and skin.Selection or skin.PanelAlt
							ensureCorner(object, 5)
						end
						-- Preserve image colors for thumbnails, textures and value previews.
						if contains(name, "icon") or contains(name, "logo") then object.ImageColor3 = skin.Accent end
					elseif object:IsA("ImageLabel") then
						-- Never tint every ImageLabel: avatar art, checkerboards and previews must
						-- keep their native color. Only explicitly named decorative icons are tinted.
						if contains(name, "icon") or contains(name, "logo") then
							object.ImageColor3 = skin.Accent
						end
					end
				end)
			end

			local function resetQueue()
				pending = {}
				pendingHead, pendingTail = 1, 0
				queued = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
			end

			local function queueObject(object)
				if object and not queued[object] then
					queued[object] = true
					pendingTail += 1
					pending[pendingTail] = object
					if startWorker then startWorker() end
				end
			end

			startWorker = function()
				if workerRunning or not skinAlive or mainUnloaded then return end
				workerRunning = true
				task.spawn(function()
					while skinAlive and not mainUnloaded and pendingHead <= pendingTail do
						local stopAt = math.min(pendingTail, pendingHead + 59)
						while pendingHead <= stopAt do
							local object = pending[pendingHead]
							pending[pendingHead] = nil
							pendingHead += 1
							styleOne(object)
						end
						if pendingHead <= pendingTail then mainRunService.Heartbeat:Wait() end
					end
					workerRunning = false
					if pendingHead > pendingTail then
						resetQueue()
					elseif skinAlive and not mainUnloaded then
						startWorker()
					end
				end)
			end

			if root then
				root.BackgroundColor3 = skin.Base
				root.BorderSizePixel = 0
				ensureCorner(root, 7)
				ensureStroke(root, skin.Border, 0.08)
				local skinConnection = root.DescendantAdded:Connect(queueObject)
				if mainUiLibrary and mainUiLibrary.GiveSignal then mainUiLibrary:GiveSignal(skinConnection) end
				mainUiLibrary:GiveSignal(root.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
					if parent == nil then skinAlive = false; resetQueue() end
				end))
				for _, object in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do queueObject(object) end
				startWorker()
			end
		end

		-- FPS is sampled locally; ping comes from Roblox Stats when it is available.
		task.spawn(function()
			local fpsSampleStart = os.clock()
			local fpsSampleFrames = 0
			local fallbackFPS = 60
			local fpsConnection
			pcall(function()
				fpsConnection = mainRunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
					fpsSampleFrames += 1
					local now = os.clock()
					local elapsed = now - fpsSampleStart
					if elapsed >= 1 then
						fallbackFPS = math.clamp(math.floor(fpsSampleFrames / elapsed + 0.5), 1, 1000)
						fpsSampleFrames = 0
						fpsSampleStart = now
					end
				end)
			end)

			while Watermark and Watermark.Label and Watermark.Label.Parent and not mainUnloaded do
				local fpsValue, pingValue = fallbackFPS, nil
				pcall(function()
					local heartbeatStat = mainStats2.Workspace:FindFirstChild("Heartbeat")
					if heartbeatStat then
						local statValue = math.floor(heartbeatStat:GetValue() + 0.5)
						if statValue > 0 then fpsValue = statValue end
					end
				end)
				pcall(function()
					local networkFolder = mainStats2:FindFirstChild("Network")
					local serverStats = networkFolder and networkFolder:FindFirstChild("ServerStatsItem")
					local pingItem = serverStats and serverStats:FindFirstChild("Data Ping")
					if pingItem then pingValue = math.max(0, math.floor(pingItem:GetValue() + 0.5)) end
				end)

				local targetPlayers = #mainPlayers:GetPlayers()
				local maxPlayers = tonumber(mainPlayers.MaxPlayers) or 25
				local fpsColor = fpsValue >= 90 and "#7FFFD4" or (fpsValue >= 45 and "#FFD580" or "#FF8095")
				local pingColor = not pingValue and "#AAB4C5" or (pingValue <= 80 and "#7FFFD4" or (pingValue <= 150 and "#FFD580" or "#FF8095"))
				local pingText = pingValue and (tostring(pingValue) .. " ms") or "PING N/A"
				-- The icon uses its own left column; the text itself contains no icon or spacer characters.
				local watermarkSections = {}
				if mainFeatureFlags.V12WatermarkTitle ~= false then table.insert(watermarkSections, '<font color="#DCE8FF">Owner sigma hub [1.2]</font>') end
				if mainFeatureFlags.V12WatermarkFPS ~= false then table.insert(watermarkSections, ('<font color="%s">%d FPS</font>'):format(fpsColor, math.max(1, fpsValue))) end
				if mainFeatureFlags.V12WatermarkPing ~= false then table.insert(watermarkSections, ('<font color="%s">PING %s</font>'):format(pingColor, pingText)) end
				if mainFeatureFlags.V12WatermarkPlayers ~= false then table.insert(watermarkSections, ('<font color="#CDB5FF">PLAYERS %d/%d</font>'):format(targetPlayers, maxPlayers)) end
				local statusText = table.concat(watermarkSections, " | ")
				pcall(function() Watermark:SetText(statusText) end)
				task.wait(math.clamp(tonumber(mainFeatureSettings.WatermarkUpdateRate) or 0.75, 0, 1))
			end
			if fpsConnection then pcall(function() fpsConnection:Disconnect() end) end
		end)

		local mainStreamerState = {
			OriginalNames = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
			Connections = {},
		}

		local function mainStreamerMatchesPlayer(mainStreamerPlayer)
			local mainStreamerTarget = mainFeatureSettings.StreamerTarget or "Everyone"
			if mainStreamerTarget == "Yourself" then
				return mainStreamerPlayer == mainLocalPlayer
			elseif mainStreamerTarget == "Friends" then
				if mainStreamerPlayer == mainLocalPlayer then
					return false
				end
				local mainStreamerSuccess, mainStreamerFriend = pcall(mainLocalPlayer.IsFriendsWith, mainLocalPlayer, mainStreamerPlayer.UserId)
				return mainStreamerSuccess and mainStreamerFriend
			end
			return true
		end

		local function mainStreamerRestoreNames()
			for mainStreamerHumanoid, mainStreamerOriginalName in pairs(mainStreamerState.OriginalNames) do
				if mainStreamerHumanoid and mainStreamerHumanoid.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						mainStreamerHumanoid.DisplayName = mainStreamerOriginalName
					end)
				end
			end
			table.clear(mainStreamerState.OriginalNames)
		end

		local function mainStreamerApplyPlayer(mainStreamerPlayer)
			if not (mainFeatureFlags.StreamerMode and mainStreamerPlayer and mainStreamerMatchesPlayer(mainStreamerPlayer)) then
				return
			end
			local mainStreamerCharacter = mainStreamerPlayer.Character
			local mainStreamerHumanoid = mainStreamerCharacter and mainStreamerCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not mainStreamerHumanoid then
				return
			end
			if mainStreamerState.OriginalNames[mainStreamerHumanoid] == nil then
				mainStreamerState.OriginalNames[mainStreamerHumanoid] = mainStreamerHumanoid.DisplayName
			end
			local mainStreamerReplacement = tostring(mainFeatureSettings.StreamerReplacementName or "Player")
			pcall(function()
				mainStreamerHumanoid.DisplayName = mainStreamerReplacement
			end)
		end

		mainActions.RefreshStreamerMode = function()
			mainStreamerRestoreNames()
			if not mainFeatureFlags.StreamerMode then
				return
			end
			for _, mainStreamerPlayer in ipairs(mainPlayers:GetPlayers()) do
				mainStreamerApplyPlayer(mainStreamerPlayer)
			end
		end

		mainActions.SetStreamerMode = function(mainStreamerEnabled)
			mainFeatureFlags.StreamerMode = mainStreamerEnabled and not mainUnloaded
			for _, mainStreamerConnection in ipairs(mainStreamerState.Connections) do
				pcall(function()
					mainStreamerConnection:Disconnect()
				end)
			end
			table.clear(mainStreamerState.Connections)
			mainActions.RefreshStreamerMode()
			if not mainFeatureFlags.StreamerMode then
				return
			end
			for _, mainStreamerPlayer in ipairs(mainPlayers:GetPlayers()) do
				table.insert(mainStreamerState.Connections, mainStreamerPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
					task.defer(mainStreamerApplyPlayer, mainStreamerPlayer)
				end))
			end
			table.insert(mainStreamerState.Connections, mainPlayers.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(mainStreamerPlayer)
				table.insert(mainStreamerState.Connections, mainStreamerPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
					task.defer(mainStreamerApplyPlayer, mainStreamerPlayer)
				end))
				task.defer(mainStreamerApplyPlayer, mainStreamerPlayer)
			end))
		end

		-- Main tab icon animation. The UI library exposes every AddTab button directly as Tab.Button.
		-- This attaches to the same MouseButton1Click event that opens Defense, Music, and every other tab.
		do
			local tabIconConnections = {}
			local tabIconTweens = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

			local function spinTabIcon(tabIcon)
				if not tabIcon or not tabIcon.Parent then return end
				local previousTween = tabIconTweens[tabIcon]
				if previousTween then pcall(function() previousTween:Cancel() end) end
				local baseRotation = tabIcon:GetAttribute("SigmaTabBaseRotation")
				if type(baseRotation) ~= "number" then
					baseRotation = tabIcon.Rotation
					tabIcon:SetAttribute("SigmaTabBaseRotation", baseRotation)
				end
				tabIcon.Rotation = baseRotation
				local spinTween = mainTweenService:Create(
					tabIcon,
					TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					{ Rotation = baseRotation + 360 }
				)
				tabIconTweens[tabIcon] = spinTween
				spinTween:Play()
				task.delay(0.48, function()
					if tabIconTweens[tabIcon] == spinTween and tabIcon and tabIcon.Parent then
						tabIcon.Rotation = baseRotation
						tabIconTweens[tabIcon] = nil
					end
				end)
			end

			local function bindMainTab(tab)
				local tabButton = tab and tab.Button
				if not tabButton or not tabButton:IsA("GuiButton") then return end
				local tabIcon = tabButton:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ImageLabel", true)
				if not tabIcon then return end
				table.insert(tabIconConnections, tabButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					spinTabIcon(tabIcon)
				end))
			end

			-- mainTabs includes Home, Defense, Music, and all other top-level sidebar tabs.
			for _, tab in pairs(mainTabs) do
				bindMainTab(tab)
			end

			pcall(function()
				mainRegisterCleanup(function()
					for _, connection in ipairs(tabIconConnections) do
						pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
					end
					for _, tween in pairs(tabIconTweens) do
						pcall(function() tween:Cancel() end)
					end
				end)
			end)
		end

	do
		local mainAccountTabbox = mainTabs.Home:AddTabbox({ Side = "Left" })
		local mainAccountTab = mainAccountTabbox:AddTab("Account", "user")

		local mainThumbnail = string.format("rbxthumb://type=AvatarBust&id=%d&w=180&h=180", mainLocalPlayer.UserId)
		local mainAvatar = mainAccountTab:AddImage("MyIcon", {
			Image = mainThumbnail,
			Height = 180,
			Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			Transparency = 0,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
		})

		task.spawn(function()
			local mainHolder = mainAvatar and mainAvatar.Holder
			local mainImage = mainHolder and mainHolder:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ImageLabel", true)
			if not mainImage then return end
			for mainAttempt = 1, 6 do
				if mainUnloaded or mainAvatar.Destroyed or not mainImage.Parent then return end

				if mainImage.IsLoaded then return end

						serverDeathTrackedHumanoids[serverDeathHumanoid] = true
						mainUiLibrary:GiveSignal(serverDeathHumanoid.Died:Connect(function()
							if not mainUnloaded then
								mainRuntimeData.ServerDeathCount += 1
							end
						end))
					end)
				end

				mainUiLibrary:GiveSignal(serverDeathPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(trackServerDeathCharacter))
				if serverDeathPlayer.Character then
					trackServerDeathCharacter(serverDeathPlayer.Character)

			for _serverDeathUnused, serverDeathPlayer in ipairs(mainPlayers:GetPlayers()) do
				trackServerDeathPlayer(serverDeathPlayer)
			end

		end

		task.spawn(function()

					lastElapsedSeconds = currentElapsedSeconds

		do
			local mainMusicGroup = mainTabs.Music:AddLeftGroupbox("Music Player", "music")
			local mainMusicSoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
			local mainMusicContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")

			local previousMusic = mainMusicSoundService:FindFirstChild("OwnerSigmaMusicPlayer")
			if previousMusic then
				pcall(function() previousMusic:Stop() end)
				pcall(function() previousMusic:Destroy() end)
			end

			local mainMusicSound = Instance.new("Sound")
			mainMusicSound.Name = "OwnerSigmaMusicPlayer"
			mainMusicSound.Looped = true
			mainMusicSound.Volume = 0.35
			mainMusicSound.Parent = mainMusicSoundService

			local mainMusicAssetId = ""
			local mainMusicEnabled = true
			local mainMusicLooped = true
			local mainMusicRequest = 0
			local mainMusicAssetInput, mainMusicVolumeSlider
			local mainMusicProgressLabel
			local mainMusicStatusLabel = mainMusicGroup:AddLabel({
				Text = "Ready - enter a Roblox audio ID",
				DoesWrap = true,
			})

			local function mainSetMusicStatus(status)
				pcall(function() mainMusicStatusLabel:SetText("Music Status: " .. tostring(status)) end)
			end

			local function mainFormatMusicTime(seconds)
				seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(seconds) or 0))
				return string.format("%02d:%02d", math.floor(seconds / 60), seconds % 60)
			end

			local function mainNormalizeMusicAsset(value)
				local text = tostring(value or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
				local digits = text:match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)$")
					or text:match("^(%d+)$")
					or text:match("[?&]id=(%d+)")
					or text:match("/asset/(%d+)")
					or text:match("/library/(%d+)")
				if not digits or digits == "0" then return nil end
				return "rbxassetid://" .. digits
			end

			local function mainSetMusicControlVisible(control, isVisible)
				if control then pcall(function() control:SetVisible(isVisible) end) end
			end

			local function mainSyncMusic(forceReload)
				if mainUnloaded then return end
				local asset = mainNormalizeMusicAsset(mainMusicAssetId)
				mainMusicSound.Looped = mainMusicLooped

				if not mainMusicEnabled then
					mainMusicRequest += 1
					pcall(function() mainMusicSound:Pause() end)
					mainSetMusicStatus("paused - enable Music to resume")
					return
				end

				if not asset then
					mainMusicRequest += 1
					pcall(function() mainMusicSound:Stop() end)
					mainSetMusicStatus("enter a valid Roblox audio ID or asset URL")
					return
				end

				local shouldLoad = forceReload or mainMusicSound.SoundId ~= asset
				if shouldLoad then
					mainMusicRequest += 1
					local requestId = mainMusicRequest
					pcall(function() mainMusicSound:Stop() end)
					mainMusicSound.SoundId = asset
					pcall(function() mainMusicSound.TimePosition = 0 end)
					mainSetMusicStatus("loading audio...")
					task.spawn(function()
						local fetchFailure
						local preloadSucceeded = pcall(function()
							mainMusicContentProvider:PreloadAsync({ mainMusicSound }, function(_, status)
								if status ~= Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
									fetchFailure = tostring(status)
								end
							end)
						end)
						if mainUnloaded or requestId ~= mainMusicRequest or mainMusicSound.SoundId ~= asset then return end
						if not preloadSucceeded or fetchFailure then
							mainSetMusicStatus("audio unavailable - check the ID and Roblox audio permissions")
							return
						end
						local started = pcall(function()
							mainMusicSound:Play()
						end)
						if not started then
							mainSetMusicStatus("playback failed - audio may be unavailable")
						elseif mainMusicSound.IsLoaded then
							mainSetMusicStatus("playing - loop " .. (mainMusicLooped and "on" or "off"))
						else
							mainSetMusicStatus("requested - waiting for Roblox audio delivery")
						end
					end)
				else
					local playbackState = mainMusicSound.PlaybackState
					if playbackState ~= Enum.PlaybackState.Playing then
						local started = pcall(function() mainMusicSound:Play() end)
						if started then mainSetMusicStatus("playing - loop " .. (mainMusicLooped and "on" or "off"))
						else mainSetMusicStatus("playback failed - check audio availability") end
					end
				end
			end

			local function mainSeekMusic(delta)
				if not mainMusicSound.IsLoaded or mainMusicSound.TimeLength <= 0 then
					mainSetMusicStatus("track is not ready to seek")
					return
				end
				mainMusicSound.TimePosition = math.clamp(mainMusicSound.TimePosition + delta, 0, mainMusicSound.TimeLength)
				mainSetMusicStatus("position " .. mainFormatMusicTime(mainMusicSound.TimePosition))
			end

			mainMusicGroup:AddLabel({ Text = "Local playback - no external player required", DoesWrap = true })
			mainMusicGroup:AddToggle("SigmaMusicEnabled", {
				Text = "Music Enabled",
				Default = true,
				Callback = function(isEnabled)
					mainMusicEnabled = isEnabled
					mainSetMusicControlVisible(mainMusicAssetInput, isEnabled)
					mainSetMusicControlVisible(mainMusicVolumeSlider, isEnabled)
					mainSyncMusic(false)
				end,
			})

			mainMusicGroup:AddToggle("SigmaMusicLoop", {
				Text = "Loop Track",
				Default = true,
				Callback = function(isEnabled)
					mainMusicLooped = isEnabled
					mainMusicSound.Looped = isEnabled
					mainSetMusicStatus("loop " .. (isEnabled and "enabled" or "disabled"))
				end,
			})

			mainMusicAssetInput = mainMusicGroup:AddInput("SigmaMusicAssetId", {
				Text = "Roblox Audio ID / Asset URL",
				Default = "",
				ClearTextOnFocus = false,
				Callback = function(assetValue)
					mainMusicAssetId = tostring(assetValue or "")
					mainSyncMusic(false)
				end,
			})

			mainMusicVolumeSlider = mainMusicGroup:AddSlider("SigmaMusicVolume", {
				Text = "Volume",
				Default = 35,
				Min = 0,
				Max = 100,
				Rounding = 0,
				Suffix = "%",
				Callback = function(volumePercent)
					mainMusicSound.Volume = math.clamp((tonumber(volumePercent) or 35) / 100, 0, 1)
				end,
			})

			mainMusicProgressLabel = mainMusicGroup:AddLabel({ Text = "Track Position: 00:00 / 00:00", DoesWrap = true })
			mainMusicGroup:AddDivider("Playback")

			mainMusicGroup:AddButton({
				Text = "Play / Pause",
				Func = function()
					if not mainMusicEnabled then
						mainSetMusicStatus("enable Music first")
						return
					end
					if mainMusicSound.IsPlaying then
						pcall(function() mainMusicSound:Pause() end)
						mainSetMusicStatus("paused")
					else
						mainSyncMusic(false)
					end
				end,
			})

			mainMusicGroup:AddButton({
				Text = "Restart Track",
				Func = function()
					if not mainMusicEnabled or not mainNormalizeMusicAsset(mainMusicAssetId) then
						mainSetMusicStatus("enable Music and enter a valid audio ID")
						return
					end
					mainSyncMusic(true)
				end,
			})

			mainMusicGroup:AddButton({
				Text = "Back 10 Seconds",
				Func = function() mainSeekMusic(-10) end,
			})

			mainMusicGroup:AddButton({
				Text = "Forward 10 Seconds",
				Func = function() mainSeekMusic(10) end,
			})

			mainMusicGroup:AddButton({
				Text = "Stop Track",
				Func = function()
					mainMusicRequest += 1
					pcall(function()
						mainMusicSound:Stop()
						mainMusicSound.TimePosition = 0
					end)
					mainSetMusicStatus("stopped")
				end,
			})

			mainSetMusicControlVisible(mainMusicAssetInput, mainMusicEnabled)
			mainSetMusicControlVisible(mainMusicVolumeSlider, mainMusicEnabled)
			mainSetMusicStatus("ready - enter a Roblox audio ID")

			mainUiLibrary:GiveSignal(mainMusicSound.Loaded:Connect(function()
				if not mainUnloaded and mainMusicEnabled then
					mainSetMusicStatus(mainMusicSound.IsPlaying and "playing" or "audio loaded - press Play / Pause")
				end
			end))
			mainUiLibrary:GiveSignal(mainMusicSound.Ended:Connect(function()
				if mainUnloaded or not mainMusicEnabled then return end
				if mainMusicLooped then
					pcall(function() mainMusicSound:Play() end)
				else
					mainSetMusicStatus("track ended")
				end
			end))

			task.spawn(function()
				while not mainUnloaded and mainMusicSound.Parent do
					local current = mainMusicSound.TimePosition
					local duration = mainMusicSound.TimeLength
					local progress = string.format("Track Position: %s / %s", mainFormatMusicTime(current), mainFormatMusicTime(duration))
					pcall(function() mainMusicProgressLabel:SetText(progress) end)
					task.wait(0.35)
				end
			end)

			if type(mainRegisterCleanup) == "function" then
				mainRegisterCleanup(function()
					mainMusicRequest += 1
					pcall(function() mainMusicSound:Stop() end)
					pcall(function() mainMusicSound:Destroy() end)
				end)
			end
		end
		do
			local mainScriptGroup = mainTabs.Home:AddRightGroupbox("Helper", "square-plus")

			mainScriptGroup:AddButton({
				Text = "Unload Script",
				Func = function()
					mainUiLibrary:Unload()
				end,
				DoubleClick = true,
			})

			mainScriptGroup:AddButton({
				Text = "Rejoin",
				Func = function()
					mainActions.Rejoin(mainFeatureFlags.RejoinWithAntiLag ~= false, mainFeatureFlags.RejoinWithScript)
				end,
				DoubleClick = true,
			})

			mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Button = mainScriptGroup:AddButton({
				Text = "Server Hop",
				Func = function()
					if mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Busy or mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Pending or mainRuntimeData.ServerHop.Retrying then
						mainActions.CancelServerHop()
					else
						task.defer(mainActions.ServerHop, mainFeatureFlags.RejoinWithAntiLag ~= false, mainFeatureFlags.RejoinWithScript)
					end
				end,
				DoubleClick = true,
			})

			mainScriptGroup:AddDivider("Settings")

			mainScriptGroup:AddToggle("AutoRj", {

			local frozenAnimationTracks = {}
			local frozenAnimateScript = nil

			local function getLocalAnimationTracks()
				local tracks = {}
				local freezeChar, _, freezeHumanoid = mainActions.Char()
				if freezeHumanoid then
					local animator = freezeHumanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
					if animator then
						for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
							table.insert(tracks, track)
						end
					else
						for _, track in ipairs(freezeHumanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
							table.insert(tracks, track)
						end
					end
				end
				if freezeChar then
					local animController = freezeChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController")
					if animController then
						local animator = animController:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
						if animator then
							for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
								table.insert(tracks, track)
							end
						end
					end
				end
				return tracks
			end

			mainLocalPlayerValuesGroup:AddToggle("FreezeT", {
				Text = "Freeze",
				Default = false,
				Callback = function(freeze)
					mainFeatureFlags.Freeze = freeze

					if freeze then
						local freezeChar = mainActions.Char()
						if freezeChar then
							local animScript = freezeChar:FindFirstChild("Animate")
							if animScript and (animScript:IsA("LocalScript") or animScript:IsA("Script")) and animScript.Enabled then
								frozenAnimateScript = animScript
								animScript.Enabled = false
							end
						end

						local initialTracks = getLocalAnimationTracks()
						for _, track in ipairs(initialTracks) do
							if not frozenAnimationTracks[track] then
								local speed = track.Speed
								frozenAnimationTracks[track] = (speed ~= 0 and speed or 1)
							end
							track:AdjustSpeed(0)
						end
					end

					mainActions.SetRuntimeConnection("FreezePlayer", mainRunService.Heartbeat, freeze, function()
						local freezeChar, freezeRoot = mainActions.Char()
						if freezeRoot then
							if not freezeRoot.Anchored then
								freezeRoot.Anchored = true
							end
							freezeRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
							freezeRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
						end

						if freezeChar and (not frozenAnimateScript or frozenAnimateScript.Parent ~= freezeChar) then
							local animScript = freezeChar:FindFirstChild("Animate")
							if animScript and (animScript:IsA("LocalScript") or animScript:IsA("Script")) and animScript.Enabled then
								frozenAnimateScript = animScript
								animScript.Enabled = false
							end
						end

						local currentTracks = getLocalAnimationTracks()
						for _, track in ipairs(currentTracks) do
							if not frozenAnimationTracks[track] then
								local speed = track.Speed
								frozenAnimationTracks[track] = (speed ~= 0 and speed or 1)
							end
							if track.Speed ~= 0 then
								track:AdjustSpeed(0)
							end
						end
					end)

					if not freeze then
						local freezeChar, freezeRoot = mainActions.Char()
						if freezeRoot then
							freezeRoot.Anchored = false
						end

						if frozenAnimateScript and frozenAnimateScript.Parent then
							frozenAnimateScript.Enabled = true
							frozenAnimateScript = nil
						end

						for track, originalSpeed in pairs(frozenAnimationTracks) do
							pcall(function()
								if track.IsPlaying then
									track:AdjustSpeed(originalSpeed or 1)
								end
							end)
						end
						table.clear(frozenAnimationTracks)
					end
				end,
			}):AddKeyPicker("FreezeKey", { Text = "Freeze", Mode = "Toggle", NoUI = false, SyncToggleState = true })
		end

		-- Local-only animation controls for Fling Things and People.
		do
			local removeAnimationGroup = mainTabs.Player:AddRightGroupbox("Remove Animation", "ban")
			local removeAnimationEnabled = false
			local removeFoodAnimation = false
			local removePlayerAnimation = false
			local animationConnections = {}
			local frozenFoodTracks = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

			local function getCharacterAnimator()
				local character = mainLocalPlayer.Character
				local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				return humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
			end

			local function isFoodAnimation(track)
				local animation = track and track.Animation
				local animationName = string.lower((track and track.Name or "") .. " " .. (animation and animation.Name or ""))
				return animationName:find("eat", 1, true) or animationName:find("food", 1, true)
					or animationName:find("drink", 1, true) or animationName:find("consume", 1, true)
					or animationName:find("snack", 1, true)
			end

			local function applyAnimationRemoval(track)
				if not track or not removeAnimationEnabled then return end
				if removePlayerAnimation then
					pcall(function() track:Stop(0) end)
				elseif removeFoodAnimation and isFoodAnimation(track) then
					-- Freeze the track at its current pose instead of stopping it, so the food pose stays visible.
					frozenFoodTracks[track] = true
					pcall(function() track:AdjustSpeed(0) end)
				end
			end

			local function bindCharacterAnimations()
				for _, connection in ipairs(animationConnections) do connection:Disconnect() end
				table.clear(animationConnections)
				local animator = getCharacterAnimator()
				if not animator then return end
				table.insert(animationConnections, animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
					applyAnimationRemoval(track)
				end))
				for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
					applyAnimationRemoval(track)
				end
			end

			local foodDropdown = removeAnimationGroup:AddDropdown("RemoveAnimationFood", {
				Text = "Remove Animation food",
				Values = { "Off", "On" },
				Default = "Off",
				Multi = false,
				Callback = function(value)
					removeFoodAnimation = value == "On"
					if removeAnimationEnabled then bindCharacterAnimations() end
				end,
			})

			local playerDropdown = removeAnimationGroup:AddDropdown("RemoveAnimationPlayer", {
				Text = "Remove Animation player",
				Values = { "Off", "On" },
				Default = "Off",
				Multi = false,
				Callback = function(value)
					removePlayerAnimation = value == "On"
					if removeAnimationEnabled then bindCharacterAnimations() end
				end,
			})

			foodDropdown:SetVisible(false)
			playerDropdown:SetVisible(false)
			removeAnimationGroup:AddToggle("RemoveAnimationMaster", {
				Text = "Enable Remove Animation",
				Default = false,
				Callback = function(value)
					removeAnimationEnabled = value
					foodDropdown:SetVisible(value)
					playerDropdown:SetVisible(value)
					if value then
						bindCharacterAnimations()
					else
						for track in pairs(frozenFoodTracks) do
							if track and track.IsPlaying then pcall(function() track:AdjustSpeed(1) end) end
							frozenFoodTracks[track] = nil
						end
					end
				end,
			})

			mainUiLibrary:GiveSignal(mainLocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
				task.wait(1)
				if removeAnimationEnabled then bindCharacterAnimations() end
			end))
		end
	end

        -- Anti Sticky-Exploits: event-driven local protection with bounded scan work.
        -- It only removes touch transmitters from a StickyPart welded to the local character.
        local antiStickyExploitGeneration = 0
        local antiStickyExploitConnections = {}
        local antiStickyExploitPartSeen = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        local antiStickyExploitWeldSeen = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

        local function disconnectAntiStickyExploitConnections()
            for _, connection in ipairs(antiStickyExploitConnections) do
                pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
            end
            table.clear(antiStickyExploitConnections)
            antiStickyExploitPartSeen = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
            antiStickyExploitWeldSeen = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        end
        pcall(function() mainRegisterCleanup(disconnectAntiStickyExploitConnections) end)

        local function antiStickyExploitTrackWeld(part, weld)
            if not part or not part.Parent or not weld or antiStickyExploitWeldSeen[weld] then return end
            antiStickyExploitWeldSeen[weld] = true
            for _, propertyName in ipairs({ "Part0", "Part1" }) do
                pcall(function()
                    table.insert(antiStickyExploitConnections, weld:GetPropertyChangedSignal(propertyName):Connect(function()
                        task.defer(function()
                            if mainFeatureFlags.AntiStickyExploits and not mainUnloaded then
                                -- Re-run against this part after a weld endpoint changes.
                                task.defer(function()
                                    local currentCharacter = mainLocalPlayer.Character
                                    if not currentCharacter or not part or not part.Parent then return end
                                    local currentWeld = part:FindFirstChild("StickyWeld")
                                    if not currentWeld then return end
                                    local part0, part1
                                    pcall(function() part0 = currentWeld.Part0 end)
                                    pcall(function() part1 = currentWeld.Part1 end)
                                    local attached = (part0 and part0:IsDescendantOf(currentCharacter)) or (part1 and part1:IsDescendantOf(currentCharacter))
                                    if attached then
                                        for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
                                            if child.Name == "TouchInterest" or child:IsA("TouchTransmitter") then
                                                pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end)
                            end
                        end)
                    end))
                end)
            end
        end

        local function antiStickyExploitScrub(part)
            if mainUnloaded or not mainFeatureFlags.AntiStickyExploits or not part or not part.Parent then return end
            if not part:IsA("BasePart") or part.Name ~= "StickyPart" then return end

            -- Always attach the ChildAdded watcher BEFORE requiring StickyWeld to exist.
            -- This fixes the race where the StickyPart appears one frame before its weld.
            if not antiStickyExploitPartSeen[part] then
                antiStickyExploitPartSeen[part] = true
                table.insert(antiStickyExploitConnections, part.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                    if child.Name == "StickyWeld" then
                        antiStickyExploitTrackWeld(part, child)
                        task.defer(antiStickyExploitScrub, part)
                    elseif child.Name == "TouchInterest" or child:IsA("TouchTransmitter") then
                        task.defer(antiStickyExploitScrub, part)
                    end
                end))
                table.insert(antiStickyExploitConnections, part.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
                    if parent == nil then antiStickyExploitPartSeen[part] = nil end
                end))
            end

            local weld = part:FindFirstChild("StickyWeld")
            if not weld then return end
            antiStickyExploitTrackWeld(part, weld)

            local target0, target1
            pcall(function() target0 = weld.Part0 end)
            pcall(function() target1 = weld.Part1 end)
            local character = mainLocalPlayer.Character
            if not character or not character.Parent then return end
            local attachedToLocalCharacter = (target0 and target0:IsDescendantOf(character)) or (target1 and target1:IsDescendantOf(character))
            if not attachedToLocalCharacter then return end

            for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
                if child.Name == "TouchInterest" or child:IsA("TouchTransmitter") then
                    pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
        end

        local function antiStickyExploitProcessDescendant(instance)
            if not instance then return end
            if instance:IsA("BasePart") and instance.Name == "StickyPart" then
                antiStickyExploitScrub(instance)
            elseif instance.Name == "StickyWeld" or instance.Name == "TouchInterest" or instance:IsA("TouchTransmitter") then
                local parent = instance.Parent
                if parent and parent:IsA("BasePart") and parent.Name == "StickyPart" then
                    antiStickyExploitScrub(parent)
                end
            end
        end

        mainAntisGroup:AddToggle("AntiStickyExploits", {
            Text = "Anti Sticky Exploit",
            Default = false,
            Callback = function(enabled)
                antiStickyExploitGeneration += 1
                local generation = antiStickyExploitGeneration
                mainFeatureFlags.AntiStickyExploits = enabled
                disconnectAntiStickyExploitConnections()
                if not enabled or mainUnloaded then return end

                table.insert(antiStickyExploitConnections, workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(antiStickyExploitProcessDescendant))
                table.insert(antiStickyExploitConnections, mainLocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                    -- Recheck currently tracked parts on respawn; no workspace-wide poll loop.
                    task.spawn(function()
                        task.wait(0.15)
                        if generation ~= antiStickyExploitGeneration or not mainFeatureFlags.AntiStickyExploits or mainUnloaded then return end
                        for part in pairs(antiStickyExploitPartSeen) do
                            if part and part.Parent then antiStickyExploitScrub(part) end
                        end
                    end)
                end))

                -- One initial scan, yielded in small batches so large maps do not hitch.
                task.spawn(function()
                    local ok, descendants = pcall(function() return workspace:GetDescendants() end)
                    if not ok or type(descendants) ~= "table" then return end
                    for index, instance in ipairs(descendants) do

                            antiStickyExploitScrub(instance)
                        end
                        if index % 250 == 0 then task.wait() end
                    end
                end)
            end,

        -- Anti-Kick House controller isolated to avoid collisions with the main hub locals.

        local mainPlateAntiKickController = (function()
            local Players = game:GetService("Players")
            local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
            local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
            local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
            local lp = _G.LP or Players.LocalPlayer
            local ws = _G.WS or Workspace
            local repS = _G.RepS or ReplicatedStorage
            local rs = _G.RS or RunService
            local setNetworkOwner = _G.SNO or (_G.GE and _G.GE:FindFirstChild("SetNetworkOwner"))
                or repS:WaitForChild("GrabEvents"):FindFirstChild("SetNetworkOwner")
            local spawnRemote = _G.SpawnRemote or repS:WaitForChild("MenuToys"):WaitForChild("SpawnToyRemoteFunction")
            local destroyRemote = _G.DestroyRemote or repS:WaitForChild("MenuToys"):WaitForChild("DestroyToy")
            local canSpawn = _G.CanSpawn or lp:FindFirstChild("CanSpawnToy") or lp:WaitForChild("CanSpawnToy")
            local state = { enabled = false, target = nil, plate = nil, plateCF = nil, history = {}, slots = {}, connections = {}, render = nil, highlight = nil, billboard = nil, worker = nil }
            local function inPlot()
                local plots = ws:FindFirstChild("PlotItems")
                local playersInPlots = plots and plots:FindFirstChild("PlayersInPlots")
                return playersInPlots and playersInPlots:FindFirstChild(lp.Name) ~= nil
            end
            local function playerPosition()
                local char = lp.Character
                local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                return hrp and hrp.Position
            end
            local function closeToHistory(pos)
                for _, item in ipairs(state.history) do
                    if math.abs(pos.X-item.pos.X)<=0.5 and math.abs(pos.Y-item.pos.Y)<=0.5 and math.abs(pos.Z-item.pos.Z)<=0.5 then return true end
                end
                return false
            end
            local function cleanupPlate(plate)
                if plate and plate.Parent then pcall(function() if destroyRemote then destroyRemote:FireServer(plate) end end) end
            end
            local function clearVisuals()
                if state.billboard then pcall(function() state.billboard:Destroy() end) end
                state.billboard = nil
                if state.highlight then pcall(function() state.highlight:Destroy() end) end
                state.highlight = nil
            end
            local function findDetector()
                for _, item in ipairs(ws:GetDescendants()) do
                    if item:IsA("BasePart") and item.Name == "PlayerCharacterLocationDetector" and closeToHistory(item.Position) then
                        return item
                    end
                end
            end
            local function setTarget(part)
                state.target = part
                if state.billboard then pcall(function() state.billboard:Destroy() end) end
                state.billboard = nil
            end
            local function getSoundPart(plate)
                return plate and (plate:FindFirstChild("SoundPart") or plate:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))
            end
            local function takeOwnership(plate)
                local part = getSoundPart(plate)
                if not part then cleanupPlate(plate); return nil end
                for _=1,12 do
                    pcall(function() if setNetworkOwner then setNetworkOwner:FireServer(part, part.CFrame) end end)
                    task.wait()
                end
                for _, d in ipairs(plate:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.CanCollide, d.CanQuery = false, false end
                end
                if state.highlight then state.highlight:Destroy() end
                local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
                h.Adornee, h.FillTransparency, h.OutlineColor, h.OutlineTransparency = plate, 1, Color3.new(1,1,1), 0.3
                h.DepthMode, h.Parent = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop, plate
                state.highlight = h
                return part
            end
            local function spawnPlate()
                local target = state.target
                if not target or not target.Parent or inPlot() or (canSpawn and not canSpawn.Value) then return nil end
                local cf = CFrame.new(target.Position + Vector3.new(0,1,20))
                task.spawn(function() pcall(function() spawnRemote:InvokeServer("FoodPlate", cf, Vector3.zero) end) end)
                local toys = ws:FindFirstChild(lp.Name.."SpawnedInToys")
                for _=1,20 do
                    if toys then
                        for _, child in ipairs(toys:GetChildren()) do
                            if child.Name=="FoodPlate" and child~=state.plate then
                                local already=false
                                for _, slot in ipairs(state.slots) do if slot==child then already=true; break end end
                                if not already then
                                    local part=takeOwnership(child)
                                    if part then
                                        part.CFrame=target.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)
                                        part.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
                                        return child
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    task.wait(0.05)
                end
            end
            local function stopRender()
                if state.render then state.render:Disconnect(); state.render=nil end
            end
            local function attach(plate)
                local target=state.target
                local part=getSoundPart(plate)
                if not part or not target then return false end
                state.plate, state.plateCF = plate, target.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)
                part.CanCollide, part.CanTouch = false, false
                part.CFrame=state.plateCF
                stopRender()
                state.render=rs.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                    if not state.enabled or not state.plate or not state.plate.Parent or not state.target or not state.target.Parent or inPlot() then return end
                    local p=getSoundPart(state.plate)
                    if p then
                        state.plateCF=state.plateCF:Lerp(state.target.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0),0.25)
                        p.CFrame=state.plateCF
                        p.AssemblyLinearVelocity, p.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero,Vector3.zero
                    end
                end)
                return true
            end
            local function clearSlots()
                for _, plate in ipairs(state.slots) do cleanupPlate(plate) end
                table.clear(state.slots)
            end
            local function stop()
                state.enabled=false
                for _, c in ipairs(state.connections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
                table.clear(state.connections)
                stopRender()
                if state.worker then pcall(task.cancel,state.worker); state.worker=nil end
                clearSlots()
                cleanupPlate(state.plate)
                state.plate=nil
                setTarget(nil)
                table.clear(state.history)
            end
            local function start()
                if state.enabled then return end
                state.enabled=true
                table.clear(state.history)
                table.insert(state.connections, ws.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
                    if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name=="PlayerCharacterLocationDetector" then task.defer(function() if state.enabled and closeToHistory(d.Position) then setTarget(d) end end) end
                end))
                table.insert(state.connections, ws.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(d) if d==state.target then setTarget(nil) end end))
                state.worker=task.spawn(function()
                    while state.enabled do
                        local pos=playerPosition()
                        if pos then
                            table.insert(state.history,{pos=pos,time=tick()})
                            for i=#state.history,1,-1 do if tick()-state.history[i].time>3 then table.remove(state.history,i) end end
                        end
                        if not state.target or not state.target.Parent then setTarget(findDetector()) end
                        if state.target and state.target.Parent and not inPlot() then
                            local char=lp.Character
                            local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                            if not hum or hum.Health<=0 then
                                stopRender(); cleanupPlate(state.plate); state.plate=nil
                            elseif not state.plate or not state.plate.Parent then
                                local hrp=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                if not hrp or (hrp.Position-state.target.Position).Magnitude<=30 then
                                    clearSlots()
                                    local plate=spawnPlate()
                                    if plate then attach(plate) end
                                elseif #state.slots == 0 then
                                    local plate=spawnPlate()
                                    if plate then
                                        table.insert(state.slots,plate)
                                    end
                                end
                            else
                                local part=getSoundPart(state.plate)
                                local owner=part and part:FindFirstChild("PartOwner")
                                if owner and owner.Value~="" and owner.Value~=lp.Name then
                                    cleanupPlate(state.plate); state.plate=nil; stopRender()
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        task.wait(0.05)
                    end
                end)
            end
            return { Start=start, Stop=stop }
        end)()

	do
		local mainCameraGroup = mainTabs.Visual:AddRightGroupbox("Camera", "camera")

		mainCameraGroup:AddToggle("DisableBlurT", {
			Text = "Disable Ragdoll Blur",
			Default = false,
			Callback = function(disableRagdollBlur)
				local disableRagdollBlurBlur = mainCurrentCamera.Blur

				if disableRagdollBlurBlur then
					disableRagdollBlurBlur.Enabled = not disableRagdollBlur
				end
			end,
		})

		local fireFadeState = {
			Enabled = false,
			Connections = {},
			Tracked = {},
		}

		mainActions.SetDisableFireFade = function(disableFireFade)
			mainFeatureFlags.DisableFireFade = disableFireFade
			fireFadeState.Enabled = disableFireFade

			for _, conn in ipairs(fireFadeState.Connections) do
				conn:Disconnect()
			end
			table.clear(fireFadeState.Connections)

			if not disableFireFade then
				for inst, data in pairs(fireFadeState.Tracked) do
					for _, conn in ipairs(data.Connections) do
						conn:Disconnect()
					end
					if inst.Parent then
						if data.Original.Visible ~= nil then
							pcall(function()
								inst.Visible = data.Original.Visible
							end)
						end
						if data.Original.ImageTransparency ~= nil then
							pcall(function()
								inst.ImageTransparency = data.Original.ImageTransparency
							end)
						end
						if data.Original.Enabled ~= nil then
							pcall(function()
								inst.Enabled = data.Original.Enabled
							end)
						end
					end
				end
				table.clear(fireFadeState.Tracked)
				return
			end

			local function suppressInstance(inst)
				if not inst or not inst.Parent or inst.Name ~= "FireFade" then
					return
				end
				if not fireFadeState.Tracked[inst] then
					local original = {}
					pcall(function()
						original.Visible = inst.Visible
					end)
					pcall(function()
						original.ImageTransparency = inst.ImageTransparency
					end)
					pcall(function()
						original.Enabled = inst.Enabled
					end)

					local conns = {}
					table.insert(conns, inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
						if fireFadeState.Enabled and inst.Visible then
							pcall(function()
								inst.Visible = false
							end)
						end
					end))
					table.insert(conns, inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ImageTransparency"):Connect(function()
						if fireFadeState.Enabled and inst.ImageTransparency < 1 then
							pcall(function()
								inst.ImageTransparency = 1
							end)
						end
					end))
					table.insert(conns, inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
						if fireFadeState.Enabled and inst.Enabled then
							pcall(function()
								inst.Enabled = false
							end)
						end
					end))
					table.insert(conns, inst.Destroying:Connect(function()
						if fireFadeState.Tracked[inst] then
							for _, c in ipairs(fireFadeState.Tracked[inst].Connections) do
								c:Disconnect()
							end
							fireFadeState.Tracked[inst] = nil
						end
					end))

					fireFadeState.Tracked[inst] = {
						Original = original,
						Connections = conns,
					}
				end

				pcall(function()
					inst.Visible = false
				end)
				pcall(function()
					inst.ImageTransparency = 1
				end)
				pcall(function()
					inst.Enabled = false
				end)
			end

			local function hookContainer(container)
				if not container then
					return
				end
				table.insert(fireFadeState.Connections, container.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
					if descendant.Name == "FireFade" then
						suppressInstance(descendant)
					end
				end))
				for _, desc in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
					if desc.Name == "FireFade" then
						suppressInstance(desc)
					end
				end
			end

			if mainCurrentCamera then
				hookContainer(mainCurrentCamera)
			end
			table.insert(fireFadeState.Connections, workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
				if workspace.CurrentCamera then
					hookContainer(workspace.CurrentCamera)
				end
			end))

			local pGui = mainPlayerGui or mainLocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or mainLocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
			if pGui then
				hookContainer(pGui)
			end
			table.insert(fireFadeState.Connections, mainLocalPlayer.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
				if child:IsA("PlayerGui") then
					hookContainer(child)
				end
			end))
		end

		mainCameraGroup:AddToggle("DisableFireFadeT", {
			Text = "Disable Fire Fade",
			Default = false,
			Callback = function(disableFireFade)
				mainActions.SetDisableFireFade(disableFireFade)
			end,
		})

		mainCameraGroup:AddDivider()

		mainCameraGroup:AddToggle("ThirdpersonT", {

					mainLocalPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
				else
					mainLocalPlayer.CameraMode = "LockFirstPerson"
				end
			end,
		}):AddKeyPicker("ThirdPersonK", {

			Default = "Three",

		mainCameraGroup:AddToggle("CameraNoclip", { Text = "Camera Noclip", Default = false, Callback = mainActions.SetCameraNoclip })

		local function mainFunction21(mainLocalTransparencyModifier)
			if not mainLocalTransparencyModifier then
				return
			end
			local mainValue20 = mainActions.Char()
			if not (mainValue20 and mainValue20:FindFirstChild("Head")) then
				return
			end

			if (mainCurrentCamera.CFrame.Position - mainCurrentCamera.Focus.Position).Magnitude > 1.5 then
				mainLocalTransparencyModifier = 0
			end

			for _mainUnused54, mainChild in ipairs(mainValue20:GetChildren()) do
				if mainChild:IsA("BasePart") and mainChild.Name ~= "Head" and mainChild.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and mainChild.Name ~= "Torso" then
					mainChild.LocalTransparencyModifier = mainLocalTransparencyModifier
				end
			end
		end

		local function mainFunction22()

				else

		})

		mainCameraGroup:AddSlider("RFPTransparency", {
			Text = "Limb Transparency",
