	do
		local mainGraphicsGroup = mainTabs.Visual:AddRightGroupbox("Ambient", "mountain")
		local mainNumber36 = 0
		local mainNumber37 = 0.004
		local mainNumber38 = 96

		local function mainFunction21(mainParameter2)
			if os.clock() - mainParameter2 < mainNumber37 then
				return mainParameter2
			end
			mainRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			return os.clock()
		end

		local function mainFunction22(mainParameter2)
			local mainNow2 = os.clock()

			for mainIndex = #mainRuntimeData.WaterParts, 1, -1 do
				if mainParameter2 ~= mainNumber36 then
					return false
				end
				local mainValue20 = mainRuntimeData.WaterParts[mainIndex]
				local mainValue21 = mainValue20[1]
				local mainTransparency = mainValue20[2]

				if mainValue21 and mainValue21.Parent then
					local mainParameter = mainUiToggles.WaterWalk and mainUiToggles.WaterWalk.Value

					if mainParameter and mainTransparency ~= 1 then
						mainTransparency = 0.5
					end

					mainValue21.Transparency = mainTransparency

					if not mainParameter and mainRuntimeData.WaterPartStates[mainValue21] then
						mainValue21.CanCollide = mainRuntimeData.WaterPartStates[mainValue21][1]
						mainRuntimeData.WaterPartStates[mainValue21] = nil
					end
				end

				mainRuntimeData.WaterParts[mainIndex] = nil
				mainNow2 = mainFunction21(mainNow2)
			end

			for mainIndex = #mainRuntimeData.WaterRegions, 1, -1 do
				if mainParameter2 ~= mainNumber36 then
					return false
				end
				mainTerrain:FillRegion(mainRuntimeData.WaterRegions[mainIndex], 4, Enum.Material.Air)
				mainRuntimeData.WaterRegions[mainIndex] = nil
				mainNow2 = mainFunction21(mainNow2)
			end

			table.clear(mainRuntimeData.WaterRegions)
			table.clear(mainRuntimeData.WaterParts)
			return true
		end

		local function mainFunction23(mainParameter2, mainSecondValue, mainThirdValue, mainFourthValue)
			local mainValue20 = Region3.new(mainParameter2, mainSecondValue):ExpandToGrid(4)
			local mainNumber39 = mainValue20.CFrame.Position - mainValue20.Size / 2
			local mainNumber40 = mainValue20.CFrame.Position + mainValue20.Size / 2
			local mainX = mainNumber39.X

			while mainX < mainNumber40.X do
				local mainNumber41 = math.min(mainX + mainNumber38, mainNumber40.X)
				local mainY = mainNumber39.Y
				local mainExitTo = nil

				while true do
					if not (mainY < mainNumber40.Y) then
						mainExitTo = 1
						break
					else
						local mainNumber42 = math.min(mainY + mainNumber38, mainNumber40.Y)
						local mainZ = mainNumber39.Z
						local mainExitTo2 = nil

						while true do
							if not (mainZ < mainNumber40.Z) then
								mainExitTo2 = 1
								break
							else
								if mainThirdValue == mainNumber36 then
									local mainNumber43 = math.min(mainZ + mainNumber38, mainNumber40.Z)
									local mainValue21 = Region3.new(Vector3.new(mainX, mainY, mainZ), Vector3.new(mainNumber41, mainNumber42, mainNumber43))
									mainRuntimeData.WaterRegions[#mainRuntimeData.WaterRegions + 1] = mainValue21
									mainTerrain:FillRegion(mainValue21, 4, Enum.Material.Water)
									mainFourthValue = mainFunction21(mainFourthValue)
									mainZ = mainNumber43
									continue
								end

								break
							end
						end

						if mainExitTo2 == 1 then
							mainY = mainNumber42
							continue
						end
						break
					end
				end

				if mainExitTo == 1 then
					mainX = mainNumber41
					continue
				end
				return mainFourthValue, false
			end

			return mainFourthValue, true
		end

		local function mainFunction24(mainParameter2)
			mainNumber36 += 1
			local mainValue20 = mainNumber36

			task.spawn(function()
				if not mainFunction22(mainValue20) or not mainParameter2 then
					return
				end
				local mainObjectModel = workspace.Map.AlwaysHereTweenedObjects.Ocean.Object.ObjectModel
				local mainVector = Vector3.new(0, mainFeatureSettings.WaterYOffset, 0)
				local mainState16 = {}

				for _mainUnused55, mainValue21 in ipairs(mainObjectModel:QueryDescendants("BasePart")) do
					local mainState17 = mainRuntimeData.WaterPartStates[mainValue21]

					if not mainState17 then
						if mainValue21.Transparency == 1 then
							continue
						end
						mainState17 = { mainValue21.CanCollide, mainValue21.Transparency }
						mainRuntimeData.WaterPartStates[mainValue21] = mainState17
					end

					if mainState17[2] ~= 1 then
						mainState16[#mainState16 + 1] = { mainValue21, mainState17[2], mainValue21.Position - mainValue21.Size / 2 + mainVector, mainValue21.Position + mainValue21.Size / 2 + mainVector }
					end
				end

				for _mainUnused56, mainValue21 in ipairs(mainState16) do
					local mainValue22 = mainValue21[1]

					if mainValue22.Parent then
						mainRuntimeData.WaterParts[#mainRuntimeData.WaterParts + 1] = { mainValue22, mainValue21[2] }
						mainValue22.Transparency = 1
					end
				end

				local mainNow2 = os.clock()
				local mainWaterTotal = #mainState16
				local mainWaterProgress = 0
				if mainWaterTotal > 0 then
					mainNotify("Water generation: 0%", "Graphics")
				end

				for mainWaterIndex, mainValue21 in ipairs(mainState16) do
					if mainValue20 ~= mainNumber36 then
						return
					end
					local mainValue22, mainValue23 = mainFunction23(mainValue21[3], mainValue21[4], mainValue20, mainNow2)
					if not mainValue23 then
						return
					end
					mainNow2 = mainValue22
					local mainWaterPercent = math.floor(mainWaterIndex / mainWaterTotal * 100)
					if mainWaterPercent >= mainWaterProgress + 25 or mainWaterIndex == mainWaterTotal then
						mainWaterProgress = mainWaterPercent
						mainNotify(("Water generation: %d%%"):format(mainWaterPercent), "Graphics")
					end
				end
			end)
		end

		local function mainFunction25(mainParameter2, mainHumanoid)
			if mainState16.Humanoid ~= mainHumanoid or not mainParameter2 then
				if mainState16.Connection then
					mainState16.Connection:Disconnect()
				end

				if mainState16.Humanoid and mainState16.Humanoid.Parent and mainState16.Enabled ~= nil then
					mainState16.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming, mainState16.Enabled)
				end

				table.clear(mainState16)
			end

			if not mainParameter2 or not mainHumanoid then
				return
			end

			if not mainState16.Humanoid then
				mainState16.Humanoid = mainHumanoid
				mainState16.Enabled = mainHumanoid:GetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming)

				mainState16.Connection = mainHumanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(mainOld, mainNew)
					if mainNew == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming and mainFeatureFlags.NonSwimmableWater and mainUiToggles.CustomWaterT.Value then
						mainHumanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
					end
				end)
			end

			mainHumanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming, false)
			local mainSwimming = Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming

			if mainHumanoid:GetState() == mainSwimming then
				mainHumanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
			end
		end

		local function mainShaderColorToTable(mainShaderColor)
			return { R = mainShaderColor.R, G = mainShaderColor.G, B = mainShaderColor.B }
		end

		local function mainShaderReadColor(mainShaderColor)
			if typeof(mainShaderColor) == "Color3" then
				return mainShaderColor
			end
			if type(mainShaderColor) == "table" then
				local mainShaderR = tonumber(mainShaderColor.R or mainShaderColor[1])
				local mainShaderG = tonumber(mainShaderColor.G or mainShaderColor[2])
				local mainShaderB = tonumber(mainShaderColor.B or mainShaderColor[3])
				if mainShaderR and mainShaderG and mainShaderB then
					return Color3.new(math.clamp(mainShaderR, 0, 1), math.clamp(mainShaderG, 0, 1), math.clamp(mainShaderB, 0, 1))
				end
			end
		end

		local function mainBuildShaderPreset()
			local mainShaderPreset = {}
			for _, mainShaderKey in ipairs({ "Exposure", "Brightness", "Contrast", "Saturation", "BloomIntensity", "BloomSize", "BloomThreshold", "SunRaysIntensity", "SunRaysSpread" }) do
				mainShaderPreset[mainShaderKey] = mainState17.Settings[mainShaderKey]
			end
			mainShaderPreset.TintColor = mainShaderColorToTable(mainState17.Settings.TintColor)
			return mainShaderPreset
		end

		local function mainApplyShaderPreset(mainShaderPreset)
			if type(mainShaderPreset) ~= "table" then
				return false
			end
			for _, mainShaderKey in ipairs({ "Exposure", "Brightness", "Contrast", "Saturation", "BloomIntensity", "BloomSize", "BloomThreshold", "SunRaysIntensity", "SunRaysSpread" }) do
				local mainShaderValue = tonumber(mainShaderPreset[mainShaderKey])
				if mainShaderValue then
					mainState17.Settings[mainShaderKey] = mainShaderValue
				end
			end
			local mainShaderTint = mainShaderReadColor(mainShaderPreset.TintColor)
			if mainShaderTint then
				mainState17.Settings.TintColor = mainShaderTint
			end
			if mainFeatureFlags.Shaders then
				mainLighting.Brightness = mainState17.Settings.Brightness
				mainLighting.ExposureCompensation = mainState17.Settings.Exposure
				local mainShaderBloom = mainState17.Effects.BloomEffect
				local mainShaderColorCorrection = mainState17.Effects.ColorCorrectionEffect
				local mainShaderSunRays = mainState17.Effects.SunRaysEffect
				if mainShaderBloom then
					mainShaderBloom.Intensity = mainState17.Settings.BloomIntensity
					mainShaderBloom.Size = mainState17.Settings.BloomSize
					mainShaderBloom.Threshold = mainState17.Settings.BloomThreshold
				end
				if mainShaderColorCorrection then
					mainShaderColorCorrection.Contrast = mainState17.Settings.Contrast
					mainShaderColorCorrection.Saturation = mainState17.Settings.Saturation
					mainShaderColorCorrection.TintColor = mainState17.Settings.TintColor
				end
				if mainShaderSunRays then
					mainShaderSunRays.Intensity = mainState17.Settings.SunRaysIntensity
					mainShaderSunRays.Spread = mainState17.Settings.SunRaysSpread
				end
			end
			return true
		end

		local function mainSyncShaderCustomPresets()
			local mainShaderNames = {}
			for mainShaderName in pairs(mainShaderCustomPresets) do
				table.insert(mainShaderNames, mainShaderName)
			end
			table.sort(mainShaderNames)
			if mainUiOptions.ShaderCustomPreset then
				mainUiOptions.ShaderCustomPreset:SetValues(mainShaderNames)
			end
		end

		local mainParticleCustomPresets = {}
		local function mainParticleColorToTable(mainParticleColor)
			return { R = mainParticleColor.R, G = mainParticleColor.G, B = mainParticleColor.B }
		end
		local function mainParticleReadColor(mainParticleColor)
			if typeof(mainParticleColor) == "Color3" then return mainParticleColor end
			if type(mainParticleColor) == "table" then
				local mainParticleR, mainParticleG, mainParticleB = tonumber(mainParticleColor.R or mainParticleColor[1]), tonumber(mainParticleColor.G or mainParticleColor[2]), tonumber(mainParticleColor.B or mainParticleColor[3])
				if mainParticleR and mainParticleG and mainParticleB then return Color3.new(math.clamp(mainParticleR, 0, 1), math.clamp(mainParticleG, 0, 1), math.clamp(mainParticleB, 0, 1)) end
			end
		end
		local function mainBuildParticlePreset()
			return { Texture = mainParticleSettings.Texture, Color = mainParticleColorToTable(mainParticleSettings.Color), Transparency = mainParticleSettings.Transparency, ParticleSize = mainParticleSettings.ParticleSize, Count = mainParticleSettings.Count, SpeedMin = mainParticleSettings.SpeedMin, SpeedMax = mainParticleSettings.SpeedMax, LifeTime = mainParticleSettings.LifeTime, BoxSize = mainParticleSettings.BoxSize }
		end
		local function mainApplyParticlePreset(mainParticlePreset)
			if type(mainParticlePreset) ~= "table" then return false end
			for _, mainParticleKey in ipairs({ "Texture", "Transparency", "ParticleSize", "Count", "SpeedMin", "SpeedMax", "LifeTime", "BoxSize" }) do
				if mainParticlePreset[mainParticleKey] ~= nil then mainParticleSettings[mainParticleKey] = mainParticlePreset[mainParticleKey] end
			end
			mainParticleSettings.SpeedMin = math.min(mainParticleSettings.SpeedMin, mainParticleSettings.SpeedMax)
			local mainParticleColor = mainParticleReadColor(mainParticlePreset.Color)
			if mainParticleColor then mainParticleSettings.Color = mainParticleColor end
			if mainParticleSettings.Enabled then mainActions.UpdateParticles() end
			return true
		end
		local function mainSyncParticleCustomPresets()
			local mainParticleNames = {}
			for mainParticleName in pairs(mainParticleCustomPresets) do table.insert(mainParticleNames, mainParticleName) end
			table.sort(mainParticleNames)
			if mainUiOptions.ParticleCustomPreset then mainUiOptions.ParticleCustomPreset:SetValues(mainParticleNames) end
		end

		local function mainGetSky()
			if mainSky and mainSky.Parent == mainLighting then
				return mainSky
			end
			mainSky = mainLighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky") or Instance.new("Sky")
			local mainValue20 = mainSky
			local mainName

			if mainSky.Name ~= "Sky" then
				mainName = mainSky.Name
			else
				mainName = "OwnerSigmaHubSky"
			end

			mainValue20.Name = mainName
			mainSky.Parent = mainLighting
			return mainSky
		end

		local function mainUpdateSkybox(mainParameter2)

				SkyboxBk = mainState16.SkyboxBk,
				SkyboxDn = mainState16.SkyboxDn,
				SkyboxFt = mainState16.SkyboxFt,
				SkyboxLf = mainState16.SkyboxLf,
				SkyboxRt = mainState16.SkyboxRt,
				SkyboxUp = mainState16.SkyboxUp,
			}

			for mainKey, mainValue21 in pairs(mainState17) do
				mainValue20[mainKey] = mainValue21
			end
		end

				mainActions.SetRuntimeConnection("SyncRealTime", mainRunService.Heartbeat, syncRealTime, function()
					local now = os.date("*t")
					local currentMins = now.hour * 60 + now.min
					if currentMins == 0 then
						currentMins = 1440
					end
					if mainUiOptions.TimeOfDay and mainUiOptions.TimeOfDay.Value ~= currentMins then
						mainUiOptions.TimeOfDay:SetValue(currentMins)
					end
					mainLighting.ClockTime = now.hour + (now.min / 60) + (now.sec / 3600)
				end)

				if syncRealTime then
					local now = os.date("*t")
					local currentMins = now.hour * 60 + now.min
					if currentMins == 0 then
						currentMins = 1440
					end
					if mainUiOptions.TimeOfDay then
						mainUiOptions.TimeOfDay:SetValue(currentMins)
					end
					mainLighting.ClockTime = now.hour + (now.min / 60) + (now.sec / 3600)
				end
			end,
		})

		mainGraphicsGroup:AddSlider("TimeOfDay", {
			Text = "Time Of Day",
			Default = defaultClockTimeMinutes,
			Min = 1,
			Max = 1440,
			Rounding = 0,
			FormatDisplayValue = function(slider, value)
				local totalMinutes = math.floor(value) % 1440
				local hours = math.floor(totalMinutes / 60)
				local mins = math.floor(totalMinutes % 60)

		local function trackRainbowMapPart(object)
			if not (object and object:IsA("BasePart") and object.Parent) then
				return
			end
			if mainLocalPlayer.Character and object:IsDescendantOf(mainLocalPlayer.Character) then
				return
			end
			if rainbowMapOriginalColors[object] == nil then
				rainbowMapOriginalColors[object] = object.Color
			end
		end

		mainActions.RestoreRainbowMap = function()
			rainbowMapEnabled = false
			if rainbowMapConnection then
				rainbowMapConnection:Disconnect()
				rainbowMapConnection = nil
			end
			if rainbowMapDescendantConnection then
				rainbowMapDescendantConnection:Disconnect()
				rainbowMapDescendantConnection = nil
			end
			for object, originalColor in pairs(rainbowMapOriginalColors) do
				if object and object.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						object.Color = originalColor
					end)
				end
			end
			table.clear(rainbowMapOriginalColors)
		end

		mainWorldGroup:AddToggle("RainbowMap", {

					return
				end

				rainbowMapEnabled = true
				for _, object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
					trackRainbowMapPart(object)
				end
				rainbowMapDescendantConnection = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
					if rainbowMapEnabled then
						trackRainbowMapPart(object)
					end

							end)
						end
					end
				end)

		local function updateTargetHud()
			if mainUnloaded or not mainFeatureFlags.TargetHud then
				targetHudFrame.Visible = false
				return
			end

			local activePlayer = nil
			if mainFeatureFlags.TargetHudMouseTrack then
				local mouseTarget = mainActions.GetTarget()
				if mouseTarget and mouseTarget.Parent then
					activePlayer = mainPlayers:GetPlayerFromCharacter(mouseTarget.Parent) or mainPlayers:GetPlayerFromCharacter(mouseTarget.Parent.Parent)
				end
			end

			if not activePlayer then
				for selPlayer in pairs(mainRuntimeData.SelectedPlayers) do
					if selPlayer and selPlayer.Parent then
						activePlayer = selPlayer
						break
					end
				end
			end

			local localRoot = localChar and localChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			targetHudHealthFill.Size = UDim2.new(hpRatio, 0, 1, 0)

			end

	mainActions.GetTarget = function()
		if not mainUiLibrary.IsMobile and mainMouse then
			return mainMouse.Target
		end
		local getTargetViewportSize = mainCurrentCamera.ViewportSize
		local getTargetValue20 = mainCurrentCamera:ViewportPointToRay(getTargetViewportSize.X / 2, getTargetViewportSize.Y / 2)
		local getTargetRaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
		getTargetRaycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		local getTargetValue21 = mainActions.Char()

		if getTargetValue21 then
			getTargetRaycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { getTargetValue21 }
		end

		local getTargetHit = workspace:Raycast(getTargetValue20.Origin, getTargetValue20.Direction * 1000, getTargetRaycastParams)
		return getTargetHit and getTargetHit.Instance
	end

	mainActions.GetHit = function()
		if not mainUiLibrary.IsMobile and mainMouse then
			return mainMouse.Hit
		end
		local getHitViewportSize = mainCurrentCamera.ViewportSize
		local getHitValue20 = mainCurrentCamera:ViewportPointToRay(getHitViewportSize.X / 2, getHitViewportSize.Y / 2)
		local getHitRaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
		getHitRaycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		local getHitValue21 = mainActions.Char()

		if getHitValue21 then
			getHitRaycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { getHitValue21 }
		end

		local getHitHit = workspace:Raycast(getHitValue20.Origin, getHitValue20.Direction * 1000, getHitRaycastParams)
		local getHitCframe

		if getHitHit then
			getHitCframe = CFrame.new(getHitHit.Position)
		else
			getHitCframe = CFrame.new(getHitValue20.Origin + getHitValue20.Direction * 1000)
		end

		return getHitCframe
	end

	do
		local function mainFunction21(mainParameter2)
			if typeof(mainParameter2) ~= "UDim2" then
				return
			end
			return { mainParameter2.X.Scale, mainParameter2.X.Offset, mainParameter2.Y.Scale, mainParameter2.Y.Offset }
		end

		local function mainFunction22(mainParameter2)
			if typeof(mainParameter2) ~= "table" then
				return
			end

			for mainIndex = 1, 4 do
				if typeof(mainParameter2[mainIndex]) ~= "number" then
					return
				end
			end

			return UDim2.new(mainParameter2[1], mainParameter2[2], mainParameter2[3], mainParameter2[4])
		end

		local function mainFunction23(mainParameter2)
			local mainViewportSize = mainCurrentCamera.ViewportSize
			local mainNumber36 = mainParameter2.AbsolutePosition + mainParameter2.AbsoluteSize / 2
			local mainState16 = {}
			local mainNumber37 = mainNumber36.X / math.max(mainViewportSize.X, 1)
			local mainNumber38 = mainNumber36.Y / math.max(mainViewportSize.Y, 1)
			mainState16[1] = mainNumber37
			mainState16[2] = mainNumber38
			return mainState16
		end

		local function mainFunction24(mainParameter2, mainSecondValue, mainPosition)
			if not mainParameter2 or not mainParameter2.Parent then
				return
			end

			if mainPosition then
				mainParameter2.Position = mainPosition
			end

			local mainViewportSize = mainCurrentCamera.ViewportSize
			local mainAbsoluteSize = mainParameter2.AbsoluteSize
			local mainX = mainParameter2.AbsolutePosition.X
			local mainY = mainParameter2.AbsolutePosition.Y

			if typeof(mainSecondValue) == "table" and typeof(mainSecondValue[1]) == "number" and typeof(mainSecondValue[2]) == "number" then
				mainX = mainSecondValue[1] * mainViewportSize.X - mainAbsoluteSize.X / 2
				mainY = mainSecondValue[2] * mainViewportSize.Y - mainAbsoluteSize.Y / 2
			end

			local mainNumber36 = math.clamp(mainX, 6, math.max(6, mainViewportSize.X - mainAbsoluteSize.X - 6))
			local mainNumber37 = math.clamp(mainY, 6, math.max(6, mainViewportSize.Y - mainAbsoluteSize.Y - 6))
			local mainAbsolutePosition

			if mainParameter2.Parent:IsA("GuiObject") then
				mainAbsolutePosition = mainParameter2.Parent.AbsolutePosition
			else
				mainAbsolutePosition = Vector2.zero
			end

			mainParameter2.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.round(mainNumber36 - mainAbsolutePosition.X + mainParameter2.AnchorPoint.X * mainAbsoluteSize.X), math.round(mainNumber37 - mainAbsolutePosition.Y + mainParameter2.AnchorPoint.Y * mainAbsoluteSize.Y))
		end

		local function mainFunction25(mainParameter2, mainSecondValue)

			local mainNumber37 = math.min(1, (mainViewportSize.X - 12) / math.max((mainAbsoluteSize.X * mainSecondValue.X.Scale + mainSecondValue.X.Offset) * mainUiScale, 1), (mainViewportSize.Y - 12) / math.max(mainNumber36, 1))
			local mainNumber38 = mainSecondValue.Y.Scale * mainNumber37
			local mainRound = math.round
			local mainNumber39 = mainSecondValue.Y.Offset * mainNumber37
			mainParameter2.Size = UDim2.new(mainSecondValue.X.Scale * mainNumber37, math.round(mainSecondValue.X.Offset * mainNumber37), mainNumber38, mainRound(mainNumber39))
		end

ownerSigmaHubSources.Bootstrap = [====[
local bootstrapSources = ...
local bootstrapEnvironment = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
if bootstrapEnvironment.OwnerSigmaHubRunning or bootstrapEnvironment.OwnerSigmaHubStarting then
    warn("OwnerSigmaHub is already running or starting")
    return
end
assert(type(loadstring) == "function", "This executor does not support loadstring")
assert(type(getgenv) == "function", "This executor does not support getgenv")
bootstrapEnvironment.OwnerSigmaHubStarting = true
local bootstrapHasNativeQuery = pcall(function() return game:QueryDescendants("BasePart") end)
if not bootstrapHasNativeQuery then
    local function bootstrapPolyfillQueryDescendants(rootInstance, query)
        local results = {}
        local descendants = rootInstance:GetDescendants()
        if type(query) ~= "string" or query == "" then
            return descendants
        end
        local clauses = {}
        for clause in string.gmatch(query, "([^,]+)") do
            clause = string.match(clause, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
            if clause and clause ~= "" then
                table.insert(clauses, clause)
            end
        end
        for _, desc in ipairs(descendants) do
            local matched = false
            for _, clause in ipairs(clauses) do
                local baseClass, notClass = string.match(clause, "^([^:]+):not%(([^%)]+)%)%s*$")
                if baseClass and notClass then
                    if desc:IsA(baseClass) and not desc:IsA(notClass) then
                        matched = true
                        break
                    end
                else
                    local className, partName = string.match(clause, "^([^#]+)#(.*)$")
                    if className and partName then
                        if desc:IsA(className) and desc.Name == partName then
                            matched = true
                            break
                        end
                    else
                        if desc:IsA(clause) then
                            matched = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if matched then
                table.insert(results, desc)
            end
        end
        return results
    end
    if hookmetamethod and type(hookmetamethod) == "function" and getnamecallmethod and type(getnamecallmethod) == "function" then
        local oldBootstrapNamecall
        oldBootstrapNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", function(self, ...)
            if getnamecallmethod() == "QueryDescendants" and typeof(self) == "Instance" then
                return bootstrapPolyfillQueryDescendants(self, ...)
            end
            return oldBootstrapNamecall(self, ...)
        end)
    end
    if getrawmetatable and type(getrawmetatable) == "function" then
        local meta = getrawmetatable(game)
        if meta and type(meta) == "table" then
            local oldIndex = meta.__index
            if setreadonly and type(setreadonly) == "function" then setreadonly(meta, false) end
            if hookfunction and type(hookfunction) == "function" and type(oldIndex) == "function" then
                local hookedIndex
                hookedIndex = hookfunction(oldIndex, function(self, key)
                    if key == "QueryDescendants" and typeof(self) == "Instance" then
                        return bootstrapPolyfillQueryDescendants
                    end
                    return hookedIndex(self, key)
                end)
            elseif type(oldIndex) == "function" then
                meta.__index = function(self, key)
                    if key == "QueryDescendants" and typeof(self) == "Instance" then
                        return bootstrapPolyfillQueryDescendants
                    end
                    return oldIndex(self, key)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
local bootstrapCleanup
local function bootstrapRegisterCleanup(registerCleanupFn) bootstrapCleanup = registerCleanupFn end
local bootstrapModuleCache = {}
local bootstrapLoadingModules = {}
local function bootstrapRequireModule(requireModuleName)
    if bootstrapModuleCache[requireModuleName] then return bootstrapModuleCache[requireModuleName] end
    assert(not bootstrapLoadingModules[requireModuleName], "Circular module dependency: " .. tostring(requireModuleName))
    assert(type(bootstrapSources[requireModuleName]) == "string", "Missing module: " .. tostring(requireModuleName))
    bootstrapLoadingModules[requireModuleName] = true
    local requireModuleChunk, requireModuleMessage = loadstring(bootstrapSources[requireModuleName], "@OwnerSigmaHub/" .. requireModuleName)
    assert(requireModuleChunk, requireModuleMessage)
    local requireModuleSucceeded, requireModuleResult = pcall(requireModuleChunk, bootstrapRequireModule)
    bootstrapLoadingModules[requireModuleName] = nil
    assert(requireModuleSucceeded, requireModuleResult)
    assert(type(requireModuleResult) == "table", "Invalid module: " .. requireModuleName)
    bootstrapModuleCache[requireModuleName] = requireModuleResult
    return requireModuleResult
end
local bootstrapReloadPath
local bootstrapSucceeded, bootstrapResult = xpcall(function()
    if type(writefile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" then
        local bootstrapSuccess = pcall(function()
            local bootstrapLines = {"local ownerSigmaHubSources = {}"}
            for _bootstrapUnused1, bootstrapName in ipairs({"Library", "ThemeManager", "SaveManager", "Icons", "MM2", "Main", "Bootstrap", "Notices"}) do
                bootstrapLines[#bootstrapLines + 1] = string.format("ownerSigmaHubSources[%q] = %q", bootstrapName, bootstrapSources[bootstrapName])
            end
            bootstrapLines[#bootstrapLines + 1] = 'local ownerSigmaHubBootstrapChunk, ownerSigmaHubBootstrapError = loadstring(ownerSigmaHubSources.Bootstrap, "@OwnerSigmaHub/Bootstrap"); assert(ownerSigmaHubBootstrapChunk, ownerSigmaHubBootstrapError); return ownerSigmaHubBootstrapChunk(ownerSigmaHubSources)'
            writefile("OwnerSigmaHubRestored.lua", table.concat(bootstrapLines, "\n"))
            assert(type(readfile("OwnerSigmaHubRestored.lua")) == "string")
        end)
        if bootstrapSuccess then bootstrapReloadPath = "OwnerSigmaHubRestored.lua" end
    end
    local bootstrapChunk, bootstrapMessage = loadstring(bootstrapSources.Main, "@OwnerSigmaHub/Main")
    assert(bootstrapChunk, bootstrapMessage)
    return bootstrapChunk(bootstrapRequireModule, bootstrapReloadPath, bootstrapRegisterCleanup)
end, function(bootstrapMessage)
    if debug and debug.traceback then return debug.traceback(tostring(bootstrapMessage), 2) end
    return tostring(bootstrapMessage)
end)
bootstrapEnvironment.OwnerSigmaHubStarting = false
if not bootstrapSucceeded then
    if bootstrapCleanup then pcall(bootstrapCleanup) end
    bootstrapEnvironment.OwnerSigmaHubRunning = false
    warn("OwnerSigmaHub initialization failed: " .. tostring(bootstrapResult))
    return nil, bootstrapResult
end
return bootstrapResult

local function buildCaptures(registers, inherited, registry, spec, count)
    local captures = count > 0 and {}
    if captures then
        for i = 1, count do
            local offset = (i - 1) * 2
            local kind, slot = spec[offset + 1], spec[offset + 2]
            if kind == 0 then
                registry = if not registry then {} else registry
                local cell = registry[slot]
                if not cell then
                    cell = {[6] = registers, [3] = slot}
                    registry[slot] = cell
                end
                captures[i] = cell
            elseif kind == 3 then
                captures[i] = registers[slot]
            elseif kind == 1 then
                captures[i] = {[6] = registers, [3] = slot}
            elseif kind == 2 then
                captures[i] = inherited[slot]
            end
        end
    end
    return captures, registry
end

    local cell = openUpvalues[index]
    if not cell then
        cell = {[6] = registers, [3] = index}

    end
    return cell
end

    if cell then
        cell[6] = cell
        cell[5] = registers[index]
        cell[3] = 5
        openUpvalues[index] = nil
    end
end

    if not openUpvalues then
        return
    end

end
